info.description: Cypherpunk Technologies, Inc. is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company focused on developing targeted and immuno-oncology therapeutics. Its novel therapies are designed to treat patients with cancer. The company was founded on January 3, 2011 and is headquartered in Cambridge, MA.
info.description_zh: Cypherpunk Technologies, Inc.是一家臨床階段的生物製藥公司，專注於開發標靶和免疫腫瘤療法。其新穎療法旨在治療癌症患者。該公司成立於2011年1月3日，總部位於麻薩諸塞州劍橋。

info.description: Strive, Inc. engages in the provision of an asset management Bitcoin treasury. It is focused on maximizing value for shareholders, accumulating bitcoin and outperforming bitcoin over the long run. The company was founded by Arshia Sarkhani, Jackson Fairbanks, Arman Sarkhani, and Kyle Fairbanks on March 9, 2022 and is headquartered in Dallas, TX.
info.description_zh: Strive, Inc. 從事提供資產管理比特幣金庫業務。它專注於為股東實現價值最大化、累積比特幣並從長遠來看超越比特幣。該公司由 Arshia Sarkhani、Jackson Fairbanks、Arman Sarkhani 和 Kyle Fairbanks 於 2022 年 3 月 9 日創立，總部位於德克薩斯州達拉斯。

info.description: Simplify Bitcoin Strategy PLUS Income ETF seeks income and capital gains. The fund is an actively managed exchange-traded fund (an "ETF"). The fund's adviser seeks to achieve its investment objective by using three strategies: (1) a Bitcoin futures strategy, (2) an income strategy, and (3) an option overlay strategy. Even though the adviser employs three strategies, the fund's portfolio is composed primarily of income producing securities. It is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: 簡化比特幣策略加收入 ETF 尋求收入和資本利得。該基金為主動式管理型交易所交易基金（“ETF”）。該基金的顧問尋求透過使用三種策略來實現其投資目標：（1）比特幣期貨策略，（2）收入策略，以及（3）選擇權覆蓋策略。儘管顧問採用三種策略，但該基金的投資組合主要由創收證券組成。它是非多元化的。

info.description: 2x XRP ETF seeks daily investment results, before fees and expenses, that correspond to two times (2x) the daily performance of XRP. The fund is an exchange-traded fund ("ETF") that seeks to achieve its investment objective primarily through managed exposure to XRP futures contracts that trade only on an exchange registered with the Commodity Futures Trading Commission ("XRP Futures Contracts"), and cash, cash-like instruments or high-quality securities that serve as collateral to the fund's investments in XRP Futures Contracts ("Collateral Investments"). The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: 2x XRP ETF 尋求扣除費用和開支之前的每日投資結果，相當於 XRP 每日表現的兩倍 (2x)。該基金是一檔交易所交易基金（「ETF」），主要透過管理 XRP 期貨合約（僅在商品期貨交易委員會註冊的交易所交易）（「XRP 期貨合約」）以及作為基金 XRP 期貨合約投資抵押品的現金、類現金工具或高品質證券（「抵押投資」）來實現其投資目標。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: The Hain Celestial Group, Inc. engages in the production and distribution of organic and natural products. It operates through North America and International geographical segments. The North America segment consists of the United States and Canada. The International segment includes the United Kingdom, Ella's Kitchen UK, and Europe. The company was founded by Irwin David Simon on May 19, 1993 and is headquartered in Hoboken, NJ.
info.description_zh: Hain Celestial Group, Inc. 從事有機和天然產品的生產和分銷。它透過北美和國際地理部門開展業務。北美部分包括美國和加拿大。國際部分包括英國、Ella's Kitchen UK 和歐洲。該公司由 Irwin David Simon 於 1993 年 5 月 19 日創立，總部位於新澤西州霍博肯。

info.description: Leverage Shares 2X Long CRCL Daily ETF seeks daily levered investment results, before fees and expenses, of two times (200%) of the daily percentage change in the price of the common stock of CRCL. The fund is an actively managed ETF. The fund invests at least 80% of its net assets (plus borrowings for investment purposes) in financial instruments with economic characteristics that, in combination, provide 200% daily leveraged exposure to the price of CRCL, consistent with the fund's investment objective. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: 槓桿股票 2 倍多頭 CRCL 每日 ETF 尋求每日槓桿投資結果（未計費用和開支）為 CRCL 普通股價格每日百分比變化的兩倍 (200%)。該基金是主動式管理ETF。該基金將至少 80% 的淨資產（加上用於投資目的的借款）投資於具有經濟特徵的金融工具，這些金融工具綜合起來為 CRCL 的價格提供 200% 的每日槓桿敞口，這與基金的投資目標一致。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: 21Shares 2x Long HYPE ETF is a leveraged exchange-traded fund that seeks to provide 200% of the daily price performance of Hyperliquid (HYPE). The fund does not invest directly in the underlying digital asset; instead, it utilizes derivative instruments-primarily swap agreements, futures, and options-to achieve its target exposure. Designed as a tactical trading vehicle, the fund resets its leverage daily and is intended for sophisticated investors to manage short-term directional views.
info.description_zh: 21Shares 2x Long HYPE ETF 是一款槓桿交易所交易基金，旨在提供 Hyperliquid (HYPE) 200% 的每日價格表現。該基金不直接投資於標的數位資產；相反，它利用衍生性工具——主要是掉期協議、期貨和選擇權——來實現其目標敞口。該基金被設計為戰術交易工具，每日重置槓桿，旨在幫助經驗豐富的投資者管理短期方向觀點。

info.description: GraniteShares 2x Long MSTR Daily ETF seeks daily investment results, before fees and expenses, of 2 times (200%) the daily percentage change of the common stock of MicroStrategy Inc. (NASDAQ: MSTR). The fund is an actively managed exchange traded fund that attempts to replicate 2 times (200%) daily percentage change of the underlying stock by entering into financial instruments such as swaps and options on the underlying stock. At the end of each trading day, the notional exposure against the underlying stock obtained through the combination of these instruments will be approximately 200% of the fund's net asset value. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: GraniteShares 2x Long MSTR Daily ETF 尋求每日投資結果（扣除費用和開支）為 MicroStrategy Inc.（納斯達克股票代碼：MSTR）普通股每日百分比變化的 2 倍（200%）。該基金是一種主動管理的交易所交易基金，試圖透過進入標的股票的掉期和選擇權等金融工具來複製標的股票每日百分比變化的兩倍（200%）。在每個交易日結束時，透過這些工具的組合獲得的標的股票的名義曝險將約為基金資產淨值的200%。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Defiance Daily Target 2X Long MSTR ETF seeks daily leveraged investment results of 2.00 (200%) the daily percentage change in the share price of MSTR. The fund will enter into one or more swap agreements with financial institutions for a specified period, which may range from one day to longer than a year. The advisor has adopted a policy to have at least 80% exposure to financial instruments with economic characteristics that should perform 2X the daily performance of the underlying security's shares. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Defiance Daily Target 2X Long MSTR ETF 尋求每日槓桿投資結果為 MSTR 股價每日百分比變化的 2.00 (200%)。該基金將與金融機構簽訂一項或多項在指定期限內的掉期協議，期限可能從一天到一年以上。顧問已採取一項政策，要求至少 80% 的金融工具具有經濟特徵，其表現應是基礎證券股票每日表現的 2 倍。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Maravai Lifesciences Holdings, Inc. engages in providing products to enable the development of drug therapies, diagnostics, and novel vaccines and to support research on human diseases. The firm's brands include TriLink BioTechnologies, Cygnus, Glen Research, and Alphazyme. It operates through the TriLink and Cygnus segments. The TriLink segment manufactures and sells products used in the fields of gene therapy, vaccines, nucleoside chemistry, oligonucleotide therapy and molecular diagnostics, including reagents used in the chemical synthesis, modification, labelling, and purification of deoxyribonucleic acid (DNA) and ribonucleic acid (RNA). The Cygnus segment sells biologic safety testing products and highly specialized analytical products for use in biologic manufacturing process development, including custom product-specific antibody and assay development services. It also operates through the following geographical segments: North America, Asia Pacific, Europe, the Middle East, and Africa, and Latin and Central America. The company was founded by Eric Tardif and Carl W. Hull in March 2014 and is headquartered in San Diego, CA.
info.description_zh: Maravai Lifesciences Holdings, Inc. 致力於提供產品，以促進藥物治療、診斷和新型疫苗的開發，並支持人類疾病的研究。該公司的品牌包括 TriLink BioTechnologies、Cygnus、Glen Research 和 Alphazyme。它透過 TriLink 和 Cygnus 部門運作。 TriLink部門生產和銷售用於基因治療、疫苗、核苷化學、寡核苷酸治療和分子診斷領域的產品，包括用於脫氧核糖核酸（DNA）和核糖核酸（RNA）的化學合成、修飾、標記和純化的試劑。 Cygnus 部門銷售生物安全測試產品和高度專業化的分析產品，用於生物製造製程開發，包括客製化產品特定抗體和檢測開發服務。它也透過以下地理區域開展業務：北美、亞太地區、歐洲、中東、非洲以及拉丁美洲和中美洲。該公司由 Eric Tardif 和 Carl W. Hull 於 2014 年 3 月創立，總部位於加州聖地牙哥。

info.description: SuperX AI Technology Ltd. engages in providing artificial intelligence infrastructure solutions. It offers integrated systems that include computation, model hosting, data pipelines, and orchestration tools to facilitate enterprise AI deployment on a global scale. The company was founded on August 25, 2021, and is headquartered in Singapore.
info.description_zh: SuperX AI Technology Ltd. 致力於提供人工智慧基礎設施解決方案。它提供包括運算、模型託管、資料管道和編排工具的整合系統，以促進全球範圍內的企業人工智慧部署。該公司成立於2021年8月25日，總部位於新加坡。

info.description: Forward Industries, Inc. is a Solana focused digital asset treasury company, with the strategy to buy, hold, stake, trade, invest in, and grow SOL and SOL related digital assets, protocols and businesses. The firm mission is to expand and strengthen the Solana ecosystem by acquiring and staking SOL and engaging with, providing tools to and investing in the Solana network, Solana developers and Solana related projects in order to increase shareholder value. It operates through the following segments: Design and Digital Assets. The Design segment consists of two operating segments that provide a full spectrum of hardware and software product design and engineering services to customers predominantly located in the U.S. The Digital Assets segment captures SOL-based yield generated by participating in the Solana network's staking protocol, which currently comprises rewards received from native staking. The company was founded in 1961 and is headquartered in Austin, TX.
info.description_zh: Forward Industries, Inc. 是一家專注於 Solana 的數位資產財務公司，其策略是購買、持有、入股、交易、投資和發展 SOL 以及 SOL 相關的數位資產、協議和業務。該公司的使命是透過收購和質押 SOL 以及與 Solana 網路、Solana 開發人員和 Solana 相關項目互動、提供工具和投資來擴大和加強 Solana 生態系統，以增加股東價值。它透過以下部門運作：設計和數位資產。設計部門由兩個營運部門組成，為主要位於美國的客戶提供全方位的硬體和軟體產品設計和工程服務。數位資產部門捕獲透過參與 Solana 網路的質押協議產生的基於 SOL 的收益，目前包括從本地質押獲得的獎勵。該公司成立於 1961 年，總部位於德克薩斯州奧斯汀。

info.description: Defiance Leveraged Long + Income MSTR ETF seeks long-term capital appreciation. The fund is an actively-managed exchange-traded fund ("ETF") that seeks to achieve its investment objective by entering into derivatives transactions (i.e., swap agreements and options contracts) to gain long exposure to MicroStrategy Incorporated ("MSTR," or the "Underlying Security"). The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Defiance Leverged Long + Income MSTR ETF 尋求長期資本增值。該基金是一種主動管理的交易所交易基金（「ETF」），旨在透過進行衍生性商品交易（即掉期協議和選擇權合約）以獲得 MicroStrategy Incorporated（「MSTR」或「基礎證券」）的長期風險來實現其投資目標。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: DeFi Technologies, Inc. engages in the provision of investment services. It plans to acquire equity, debt, or other securities of publicly traded or private companies or other entities. The firm offers DeFi ETNs, DeFi Governance, DeFi Venture and DeFi Treasury. The company was founded by Olivier Francois Roussy Newton and Wouter Witvoet on April 14, 1986 and is headquartered in Toronto, Canada.
info.description_zh: DeFi Technologies, Inc.從事提供投資服務。它計劃收購上市公司或私人公司或其他實體的股權、債務或其他證券。該公司提供 DeFi ETN、DeFi 治理、DeFi Venture 和 DeFi Treasury。該公司由 Olivier Francois Roussy Newton 和 Wouter Witvoet 於 1986 年 4 月 14 日創立，總部位於加拿大多倫多。

info.description: American Bitcoin Corp. engages in the management of a bitcoin accumulation platform. It offers exposure to bitcoin through an industry-first business model that integrates scaled self-mining operations with disciplined accumulation strategies. The company was founded by Eric Trump and Donald John Trump Jr. on October 3, 2018 and is headquartered in Miami, FL.
info.description_zh: 美國比特幣公司從事比特幣累積平台的管理。它透過行業首創的商業模式提供比特幣投資，該商業模式將規模化的自挖礦業務與嚴格的積累策略相結合。該公司由埃里克·川普和小唐納德·約翰·川普於2018年10月3日創立，總部位於佛羅裡達州邁阿密。

info.description: Upexi, Inc. engages in the development, manufacturing, and distribution of consumer products through direct-to-consumer network, wholesale partnerships, and major third-party platforms like Amazon. Its brands include LuckyTail, Prax, Cure Mushrooms, Moonwlkr, and Gumi Labs. The company was founded on September 5, 2018 and is headquartered in Tampa, FL.
info.description_zh: Upexi, Inc. 透過直接面向消費者的網路、批發合作夥伴以及亞馬遜等主要第三方平台從事消費品的開發、製造和分銷。其品牌包括 LuckyTail、Prax、Cure Mushrooms、Moonwlkr 和 Gumi Labs。該公司成立於2018年9月5日，總部位於佛羅裡達州坦帕。

info.description: Direxion Daily COIN Bull 2X ETF seeks daily investment results, before fees and expenses, of 200% of the daily performance of COIN. The fund, under normal circumstances, invests at least 80% of its net assets (plus any borrowings for investment purposes) in the securities of COIN and financial instruments, such as swap agreements and options, that, in combination, provide 2X daily leveraged exposure to COIN, consistent with the fund's investment objective. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Direxion Daily COIN Bull 2X ETF 尋求每日投資結果（未計費用和開支）為 COIN 每日表現的 200%。在正常情況下，該基金將至少 80% 的淨資產（加上任何用於投資目的的借款）投資於 COIN 證券和金融工具，例如掉期協議和期權，這些組合起來提供 2 倍的每日 COIN 槓桿敞口，這與基金的投資目標一致。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: 21Shares Hyperliquid ETF provides direct exposure to HYPE tokens, the native digital asset of the decentralized, layer-1 Hyperliquid Network, which features a fully on-chain real-time order book and execution system. The strategy seeks passive tracking of the token's pricing performance while factoring in fund expenses and incorporating staking rewards generated by committing a portion of its digital holdings to validate the underlying blockchain network.
info.description_zh: 21Shares Hyperliquid ETF 提供對 HYPE 代幣的直接投資，HYPE 代幣是去中心化第一層 Hyperliquid 網路的原生數位資產，具有完全鏈上的即時訂單簿和執行系統。該策略尋求被動追蹤代幣的定價表現，同時考慮基金費用，並納入透過承諾部分數位資產來驗證底層區塊鏈網路而產生的質押獎勵。

info.description: NEOS Boosted Bitcoin High Income ETF seeks to boost performance by generating high monthly income with the potential for appreciation based on exposure to exchange-traded products (ETPs) that have direct exposure to Bitcoin. The fund implements a multi-part strategy including a 100% core exposure to spot Bitcoin ETPs and an additional synthetic options strategy designed to create approximately 150% notional portfolio exposure, while generating income through a data-driven call option overlay.
info.description_zh: NEOS Boosted Bitcoin High Income ETF 尋求透過產生高額月收入來提高業績，並且基於直接接觸比特幣的交易所交易產品 (ETP) 的升值潛力。該基金實施多部分策略，包括 100% 核心敞口為現貨比特幣 ETP，以及額外的合成期權策略，旨在創建約 150% 名義投資組合敞口，同時透過數據驅動的看漲期權疊加產生收入。

info.description: Tron, Inc. engages in the provision of designing, manufacturing, and sale of toys, souvenirs, and plushies. It offers its services to theme parks and other entertainment ventures. The company was founded on April 22, 2022 and is headquartered in Winter Park, FL.
info.description_zh: Tron, Inc. 從事玩具、紀念品和毛絨玩具的設計、製造和銷售。它為主題公園和其他娛樂企業提供服務。該公司成立於 2022 年 4 月 22 日，總部位於佛羅裡達州溫特帕克。

info.description: CoinShares Altcoins ETF seeks to provide capital appreciation. Under normal circumstances, the fund will invest at least 80% of its net assets in the securities of investment vehicles that offer exposure to the digital assets that comprise the CoinShares-Compass Crypto Market 35% Capped Index. The index is a diversified digital asset index which seeks to track the performance of the ten largest digital assets by market capitalization, weighted according to their market capitalization with a maximum weighting of 35%. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: CoinShares Altcoins ETF 旨在提供資本增值。在正常情況下，該基金將至少 80% 的淨資產投資於投資工具的證券，這些投資工具提供構成 CoinShares-Compass 加密貨幣市場 35% 上限指數的數位資產的曝險。該指數是一個多元化的數位資產指數，旨在追蹤市值最大的十大數位資產的表現，並根據其市值進行加權，最大權重為35%。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: ProQR Therapeutics NV is a clinical stage biopharmaceutical company, which engages in the discovery and development of RNA therapies for the treatment of severe genetic rare diseases with a focus on inherited retinal diseases. The company was founded by Daniel Anton de Boer, Gerard J. Platenburg, Henri A. Termeer, and Domenico Valerio on February 21, 2012, and is headquartered in Leiden, the Netherlands.
info.description_zh: ProQR Therapeutics NV 是一家臨床階段的生物製藥公司，致力於發現和開髮用於治療嚴重遺傳性罕見疾病（尤其是遺傳性視網膜疾病）的 RNA 療法。該公司由 Daniel Anton de Boer、Gerard J. Platenburg、Henri A. Termeer 和 Domenico Valerio 於 2012 年 2 月 21 日創立，總部位於荷蘭萊頓。

info.description: Marker Therapeutics, Inc. is a clinical-stage immuno-oncology company, which engages in the development and commercialization of novel cell-based immunotherapies and peptide-based vaccines for the treatment of hematological malignancies and solid tumor indications. The company was founded on October 22, 1991 and is headquartered in Houston, TX.
info.description_zh: Marker Therapeutics, Inc.是一家臨床階段的免疫腫瘤公司，致力於新型細胞免疫療法和勝肽疫苗的開發和商業化，用於治療血液惡性腫瘤和實體瘤適應症。該公司成立於1991年10月22日，總部位於德州休士頓。

info.description: Canary HBAR ETF seeks to seek to provide exposure to the value of the fund held by the Trust, less the expenses of the Trust's operations. In seeking to achieve the investment objective, the Trust will hold the fund and will value its net assets and the Shares daily based on the Pricing Benchmark. HBAR will be the only digital asset held by the Trust. The Pricing Benchmark is a U.S. dollar-denominated composite reference rate for the price of the fund.
info.description_zh: Canary HBAR ETF 旨在尋求提供信託持有的基金價值減去信託營運費用的曝險。為了實現投資目標，信託將持有該基金，並根據定價基準每日對其淨資產和股份進行估值。 HBAR 將是該信託持有的唯一數位資產。定價基準是以美元計價的基金價格的綜合參考利率。

info.description: Oramed Pharmaceuticals, Inc. engages in the provision of oral delivery solutions for drugs delivered via injection. It concentrates on the research and development of pharmaceutical solutions, including an oral insulin capsule to be used for the treatment of individuals with diabetes, and the use of orally ingestible capsules or pills for delivery of other polypeptides. The company was founded by Nadav Kidron and Miriam Kidron on April 12, 2002 and is headquartered in New York, NY.
info.description_zh: Oramed Pharmaceuticals, Inc. 致力於為注射藥物提供口服給藥解決方案。它專注於藥物解決方案的研究和開發，包括用於治療糖尿病患者的口服胰島素膠囊，以及使用口服膠囊或藥丸來輸送其他多肽。該公司由 Nadav Kidron 和 Miriam Kidron 於 2002 年 4 月 12 日創立，總部位於紐約州紐約市。

info.description: Compugen Ltd. engages in the research, development, and commercialization of therapeutic and diagnostic biomarker product candidates including proteins and monoclonal antibodies. It focuses on research and development on immuno-oncology and autoimmune diseases. The company was founded by Eli Mintz, Simchon Faigler, and Amir Natan on February 10, 1993 and is headquartered in Holon, Israel.
info.description_zh: Compugen Ltd. 從事治療和診斷生物標記候選產品（包括蛋白質和單株抗體）的研究、開發和商業化。它專注於免疫腫瘤學和自體免疫疾病的研究和開發。該公司由 Eli Mintz、Simchon Faigler 和 Amir Natan 於 1993 年 2 月 10 日創立，總部位於以色列霍隆。

info.description: Pangaea Logistics Solutions Ltd. engages in the provision of seaborne dry bulk logistics and transportation services to industrial customers worldwide. It provides services to customers that require transportation of dry bulk cargoes, including grains, coal, iron ore, pig iron, hot briquetted iron, bauxite, alumina, cement clinker, dolomite, and limestone. The company was founded by Edward Coll, Carl Claus Boggild, and Anthony Laura in 1996 and is headquartered in Newport, RI.
info.description_zh: Pangea Logistics Solutions Ltd. 致力於為全球工業客戶提供海運乾散貨物流和運輸服務。它為需要運輸乾散貨的客戶提供服務，包括穀物、煤炭、鐵礦石、生鐵、熱壓鐵、鋁土礦、氧化鋁、水泥熟料、白雲石和石灰石。該公司由 Edward Coll、Carl Claus Boggild 和 Anthony Laura 於 1996 年創立，總部位於羅德島州紐波特。

info.description: TJGC Group Ltd. is a holding company, which engages in the provision of marketing and advertising services. It offers one-stop advertising services to clients throughout the entire advertising process, which comprises the planning, creating, launching, managing, and performance monitoring of the advertisements. The company was founded by Kai Kwan Lam, Chi Fung Lau, and Chun Pong Siu on May 13, 2022 and is headquartered in Hong Kong.
info.description_zh: TJGC Group Ltd. 是一家控股公司，從事提供行銷和廣告服務。為客戶提供廣告規劃、創作、投放、管理、成效監控等整個廣告流程的一站式廣告服務。該公司由林啟君、劉志峰和俊邦蕭於2022年5月13日創立，總部位於香港。

info.description: 21Shares Sui ETF is a passive investment fund designed to provide direct, regulated exposure to SUI, the native token of the Sui Network, by tracking its performance via a specific pricing benchmark. The strategy involves holding physical SUI tokens in institutional-grade custody and seeks to reflect additional rewards generated from staking a portion of the Trust's SUI holdings, net of expenses and liabilities.
info.description_zh: 21Shares Sui ETF 是一款被動投資基金，旨在透過特定定價基準追蹤其表現，為 Sui 網路的原生代幣 SUI 提供直接、受監管的投資。該策略涉及以機構級託管方式持有實體 SUI 代幣，並尋求反映透過質押信託的部分 SUI 持有量（扣除費用和負債）而產生的額外獎勵。

info.description: Global X Blockchain & Bitcoin Strategy ETF seeks long-term capital appreciation. The fund is an actively managed ETF that seeks to achieve its investment objective by investing directly or indirectly in equity securities of U.S. and non-U.S. "Blockchain Companies" and in long positions in U.S. listed bitcoin futures contracts. Under normal circumstances, the fund will invest at least 80% of its net assets, plus the amount of any borrowings for investment purposes, in Blockchain Companies and in long positions on U.S. listed Bitcoin Futures contracts. It is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Global X 區塊鏈和比特幣策略 ETF 尋求長期資本增值。該基金是一檔主動管理的 ETF，旨在透過直接或間接投資於美國和非美國「區塊鏈公司」的股本證券以及美國上市的比特幣期貨合約的多頭部位來實現其投資目標。在正常情況下，該基金將至少 80% 的淨資產以及用於投資目的的任何借款金額投資於區塊鏈公司以及美國上市的比特幣期貨合約的多頭部位。它是非多元化的。

info.description: Janux Therapeutics, Inc. operates a preclinical stage biopharmaceutical company which engages in developing therapeutics based on the Tumor Activated T Cell Engager platform technology. The company was founded by David Campbell in June 2017 and is headquartered in San Diego, CA.
info.description_zh: Janux Therapeutics, Inc. 經營一家臨床前階段生物製藥公司，致力於開發基於腫瘤活化 T 細胞接合器平台技術的療法。該公司由 David Campbell 於 2017 年 6 月創立，總部位於加州聖地牙哥。

info.description: 21shares Polkadot ETF is a passively managed exchange-traded fund that provides direct, physically backed exposure to DOT, the native cryptocurrency of the Polkadot network. The fund seeks to track the performance of its underlying digital asset by holding DOT in secure, institutional-grade cold storage, while uniquely incorporating a staking component to capture network rewards that may be used to offset fund expenses or contribute to the net asset value.
info.description_zh: 21shares Polkadot ETF 是一款被動管理的交易所交易基金，提供直接、實物支援的 DOT（Polkadot 網路的原生加密貨幣）曝險。該基金尋求透過將 DOT 保存在安全的機構級冷庫中來追蹤其基礎數位資產的表現，同時獨特地納入質押組件來獲取網路獎勵，這些獎勵可用於抵消基金費用或貢獻淨資產價值。

info.description: IAC is a media and Internet company comprised of some of the world's most recognized brands and products, such as HomeAdvisor, Vimeo, About.com, Dictionary.com, The Daily Beast, Investopedia, and Match Group's online dating portfolio, which includes Match, OkCupid and Tinder. Ranked by Fortune magazine's annual standing of the world's most admired companies in the Internet Services & Retailing sector for many years, IAC's family of websites is one of the largest in the world, with over two billion monthly visits reaching users in more than 190 countries. The company is headquartered in the Chelsea neighborhood of New York City and has business operations and satellite offices around the world. In December 2004, Expedia split from IAC as a separate publicly traded company. In December 2011, TripAdvisor spun out from Expedia. In August 2008, IAC split into five separate publicly traded companies. The four spun-off companies were HSN, Ticketmaster, Interval Leisure Group, and Tree.com. IAC's notable acquisitions include: - 2012: [The About Group](http://www.crunchbase.com/organization/about-com) - 2011: [OkCupid](http://www.crunchbase.com/organization/okcupid) - 2011: [Meetic](http://www.crunchbase.com/organization/meetic) - 2006: [Connected Ventures](http://www.crunchbase.com/organization/connectedventures), the parent company of [CollegeHumor](http://www.crunchbase.com/organization/collegehumor) - 2005: [Ask Jeeves](http://www.crunchbase.com/organization/ask-com) - 2004: [TripAdvisor](http://www.crunchbase.com/organization/tripadvisor) - 2003: LendingTree and remaining interest in Ticketmaster, Expedia and Hotels.com. - 2002: [Expedia](http://www.crunchbase.com/organization/expedia) - 1999: [Match.com](http://www.crunchbase.com/organization/match-com) - 1998: [Citysearch](http://www.crunchbase.com/organization/citysearch)

info.description: Portfolio Building Block World Pharma And Biotech Index ETF seeks to track the performance, before fees and expenses, of the BITA Global Pharma and Biotech Select Index. The fund uses a "passive management" approach to track the performance, before fees and expenses, of the index. The index is constructed using a rules-based methodology that identifies companies in the pharmaceutical and/or biotechnology industries with publicly traded ordinary shares listed on major stock exchanges in developed markets, as classified by BITA GmbH. Under normal circumstances, the fund will invest at least 80% of the fund's net assets in component securities that make up the index. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: 投資組合建構模組世界製藥和生技指數 ETF 旨在追蹤 BITA 全球製藥和生技精選指數（未計費用和開支）的表現。該基金採用「被動管理」方法來追蹤該指數未計費用和開支之前的表現。該指數採用基於規則的方法構建，該方法識別在已開發市場主要證券交易所上市的公開交易普通股的製藥和/或生物技術行業的公司（按 BITA GmbH 的分類）。一般情況下，基金將至少80%的基金淨資產投資於構成指數的成分證券。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Freenome, Inc. operates as a biotechnology company. It engages in the development of an early cancer detection platform. The company was founded in 2014 and is headquartered in New York, NY.
info.description_zh: Freenome, Inc. 是一家生技公司。它從事早期癌症檢測平台的開發。該公司成立於2014年，總部位於紐約州紐約市。

info.description: Pilgrim's Pride Corp. engages in the production, processing, marketing, and distribution of fresh, frozen and value-added chicken and pork products to retailers, distributors, and foodservice operators. It operates through the following geographical segments: U.S., Europe, and Mexico. The company was founded by Lonnie A. Pilgrim and Aubrey Pilgrim on October 2, 1946, and is headquartered in Greeley, CO.
info.description_zh: Pilgrim's Pride Corp. 從事新鮮、冷凍和加值雞肉和豬肉產品的生產、加工、行銷和分銷給零售商、分銷​​商和餐飲服務業者。它透過以下地理區域開展業務：美國、歐洲和墨西哥。該公司由 Lonnie A. Pilgrim 和 Aubrey Pilgrim 於 1946 年 10 月 2 日創立，總部位於科羅拉多州格里利。

info.description: Funko, Inc. engages in designing, sourcing, and distributing licensed pop culture products. Its product lines include media and entertainment content, which refer to movies, TV shows, video games, music, and sports. It operates through the United States, Europe, and Other International geographic segments. The company was founded in 1998 and is headquartered in Everett, WA.
info.description_zh: Funko, Inc. 從事設計、採購和分銷授權流行文化產品。其產品線包括媒體和娛樂內容，包括電影、電視節目、電玩、音樂和體育。它透過美國、歐洲和其他國際地理區域開展業務。該公司成立於 1998 年，總部位於華盛頓州埃弗里特。

info.description: Plains GP Holdings LP owns and operates midstream energy infrastructure and provides logistics services primarily for crude oil, natural gas liquids and natural gas through its indirect investment in Plains All American Pipeline, L.P. The firm operates through the following segments: Transportation, Facilities and Supply and Logistics. The Transportation segment consists of fee-based activities associated with transporting crude oil and NGL on pipelines, gathering systems, trucks and barges. The Facilities segment consists of fee-based activities associated with providing storage, terminalling and throughput services primarily for crude oil, NGL and natural gas, as well as NGL fractionation and isomerization services and natural gas and condensate processing services. The Supply and Logistics segment consists of storage of inventory during contango market conditions and the seasonal storage of NGL, purchase of NGL from producers, refiners, processors and other marketers, extraction of NGL from gas processed at the facilities. The company was founded in July 2013 and is headquartered in Houston, TX.
info.description_zh: Plains GP Holdings LP 擁有並經營中游能源基礎設施，並透過其對 Plains All American Pipeline, L.P. 的間接投資，主要為原油、液化天然氣和天然氣提供物流服務。該公司透過以下部門運作：運輸、設施、供應和物流。運輸部門包括與透過管道、收集系統、卡車和駁船運輸原油和液化天然氣相關的收費活動。設施部門包括與主要為原油、液化天然氣和天然氣提供儲存、終端和吞吐量服務相關的收費活動，以及液化天然氣分餾和異構化服務以及天然氣和凝析油加工服務。供應和物流部門包括在期貨溢價市場條件下儲存庫存以及液化天然氣的季節性儲存，從生產商、煉油商、加工商和其他營銷商購買液化天然氣，從設施加工的天然氣中提取液化天然氣。該公司成立於2013年7月，總部位於德州休士頓。

info.description: Suja Life, Inc. is a modern beverage platform at the forefront of the functional, better-for-you beverage revolution. The company is on a mission to change what beverages bring to the table by delivering delicious, nutritious products that support healthier daily rituals for consumers nationwide. Suja Life offers a portfolio of trusted brands, including Suja Organic, Vive Organic, and Slice, with organic cold-pressed juices and wellness shots enjoyed nationwide. It operates as a vertically integrated manufacturer, utilizing organic, non-GMO, and plant-based ingredients to create beverages that deliver superior taste and functional wellness benefits without compromise. The company was founded in 2012 and is headquartered in Oceanside, CA.

info.description_zh: Suja Life, Inc. 是一個現代飲料平台，處於功能性、有益健康飲料革命的前沿。該公司的使命是透過提供美味、營養的產品來改變餐桌上的飲料，並支持全國消費者更健康的日常習慣。 Suja Life 提供一系列值得信賴的品牌，包括 Suja Organic、Vive Organic 和 Slice，以及全國享有盛譽的有機冷壓果汁和健康飲品。它作為一家垂直一體化製造商運營，利用有機、非基因改造和植物成分生產飲料，在不妥協的情況下提供卓越的口味和功能性健康益處。該公司成立於 2012 年，總部位於加州歐申賽德。

info.description: UP Fintech Holding Ltd. is an online brokerage firm that focuses on global investors. It provides an online trading platform that enables investors to trade in equities and other financial instruments on multiple exchanges around the world. The firm offers products and services, as well as a user experience to customers through its mobile first strategy. The company was founded by Tian Hua Wu in June 2014 and is headquartered in Singapore.
info.description_zh: UP Fintech Holding Ltd.是一家專注於全球投資者的線上經紀公司。它提供了一個線上交易平台，使投資者能夠在世界各地的多個交易所進行股票和其他金融工具的交易。該公司透過其行動優先策略為客戶提供產品和服務以及用戶體驗。該公司由吳天華於2014年6月創立，總部位於新加坡。

info.description: Chicago Atlantic Real Estate Finance, Inc. is a commercial mortgage real estate investment trust. It engages in a series of transactions of senior secured loans and other real estate related assets. The company was founded on March 30, 2021 and is headquartered in Miami Beach, FL.
info.industry_zh: 房地產投資信託基金 - 抵押貸款
info.description_zh: 芝加哥大西洋房地產金融公司是一家商業抵押房地產投資信託公司。它從事一系列優先擔保貸款和其他房地產相關資產的交易。該公司成立於2021年3月30日，總部位於佛羅裡達州邁阿密海灘。

info.description: Nkarta, Inc. is a biopharmaceutical company, which engages in the discovery, development, and commercialization of natural killer cell therapies for the treatment of cancer. The firm's product include NKX101, which is in Phase I clinical trials for the treatment of relapsed/refractory acute myeloid leukemia or higher risk myelodysplastic syndromes, and NKX019, a pre-clinical product, which is based on the ability to treat various B cell malignancies by targeting the CD19 antigen found on these types of cancerous cells. The company was founded by Dario Campana in 2005 and is headquartered in South San Francisco, CA.

info.description_zh: Nkarta, Inc. 是一家生物製藥公司，致力於癌症治療的自然殺手細胞療法的發現、開發和商業化。該公司的產品包括NKX101和NKX019，NKX101處於I期臨床試驗中，用於治療復發/難治性急性髓性白血病或高風險骨髓增生異常綜合徵，NKX019是一種臨床前產品，其基於通過靶向這些類型的癌細胞上發現的CD19抗原來治療各種B細胞惡性腫瘤的能力。該公司由 Dario Campana 於 2005 年創立，總部位於加州南舊金山。

info.description: Tuttle Capital Daily 2X Inverse Regional Banks ETF seeks daily investment results, before fees and expenses, of 200% of the inverse (or opposite) of the daily performance of the KRE ETF. The fund, under normal circumstances, invests in swap agreements that provide 200% inverse (opposite) daily exposure to TSLA equal to at least 80% of the fund's net assets (plus any borrowings for investment purposes ). The fund advisor seeks daily leveraged inverse investment results and the fund is very different from most other exchange-traded funds and presents different and greater risks. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Tuttle Capital Daily 2X Inverse Regional Banks ETF 尋求每日投資結果（未計費用和開支）為 KRE ETF 每日表現的 200% 倒數（或相反）。在正常情況下，該基金投資於掉期協議，該協議提供 200% 的 TSLA 每日反向（相反）敞口，相當於該基金淨資產（加上任何用於投資目的的借款）的至少 80%。基金顧問尋求每日槓桿反向投資結果，該基金與大多數其他交易所交易基金有很大不同，並呈現不同且更大的風險。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: GraniteShares Autocallable MSTR ETF is an income-generation strategy designed to distribute potential monthly coupons by investing in a rolling, laddered portfolio of single-stock autocallable option-linked derivatives. The fund manages positions through an ongoing rolling architecture targeting conditional yields and limited downside protection benchmarked strictly to the price action of an individual corporate reference equity.
info.description_zh: GraniteShares Autocallable MSTR ETF 是一種創收策略，旨在透過投資滾動、階梯式的單股可自動贖回選擇權掛鉤衍生性商品投資組合來分配潛在的每月票面利率。該基金透過持續滾動架構管理頭寸，目標是有條件收益率和嚴格以個別公司參考股票的價格走勢為基準的有限下行保護。

info.description: Direxion Daily AVGO Bear 1X Shares seeks daily investment results, before fees and expenses, of 100% of the inverse (or opposite) of the daily performance of AVGO. The fund, under normal circumstances, invests at least 80% of the fund's net assets (plus borrowings for investment purposes) in financial instruments, including swap agreements and options, that, in combination, provide 1X daily inverse (opposite) or short exposure to AVGO, consistent with the fund's investment objective. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Direxion Daily AVGO Bear 1X Shares 寻求与 AVGO 每日表现相反（或相反）的 100% 的每日投资结果（扣除费用和开支）。在正常情況下，該基金將至少 80% 的基金淨資產（加上投資目的借款）投資於金融工具，包括掉期協議和選擇權，這些金融工具結合起來提供 1 倍的每日反向（相反）或空頭敞口，與基金的投資目標一致。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Krispy Kreme, Inc. produces and distributes doughnuts. It offers yeast-raised doughnuts, pies, coffees and espresso drinks, chillers and iced beverages. It operates through the following segments: U.S. and Canada, International, and Market Development. The U.S. and Canada segment includes all Krispy Kreme's company-owned operations in the U.S. and Canada, Insomnia-branded retail shops and consumer packaged goods operations. The International segment consists of all Krispy Kreme's company-owned operations in the United Kingdom, Ireland, Australia, New Zealand, and Mexico. The Market Development segment handles the franchise operations across the globe, as well as Krispy Kreme company-owned shops in Japan. The firm sells its products through mass merchant, grocery and convenience stores. The company was founded in 1937 and is headquartered in Charlotte, NC.
info.description_zh: Krispy Kreme, Inc. 生產和分銷甜甜圈。它提供酵母甜甜圈、餡餅、咖啡和濃縮咖啡、冰鎮飲料和冰鎮飲料。它透過以下部門運作：美國和加拿大部門、國際部門和市場開發部門。美國和加拿大部門包括 Krispy Kreme 公司在美國和加拿大的所有業務、Insomnia 品牌零售店和消費品業務。國際部門包括 Krispy Kreme 公司在英國、愛爾蘭、澳洲、紐西蘭和墨西哥的所有業務。市場開發部門負責全球範圍內的特許經營業務以及 Krispy Kreme 公司在日本的自營商店。該公司透過大型商家、雜貨店和便利商店銷售其產品。該公司成立於 1937 年，總部位於北卡羅來納州夏洛特。

info.description: Recursion Pharmaceuticals, Inc. is a clinical-stage biotechnology company that combines automation, artificial intelligence, machine learning, and in vivo validation capabilities to discover novel medicines. Its Recursion operating system enables advanced machine learning approaches to reveal drug candidates, mechanisms of action, novel chemistry, and potential toxicity, with the eventual goal of decoding biology and advancing new therapeutics that radically improve people's lives. The company was founded by Blake Borgeson, Christopher C. Gibson, and Dean Y. Li on November 4, 2013 and is headquartered in Salt Lake City, UT.
info.description_zh: Recursion Pharmaceuticals, Inc. 是一家臨床階段生物技術公司，結合自動化、人工智慧、機器學習和體內驗證能力來發現新藥。其遞歸操作系統使先進的機器學習方法能夠揭示候選藥物、作用機制、新穎的化學物質和潛在的毒性，最終目標是解碼生物學並推進新的治療方法，從根本上改善人們的生活。該公司由 Blake Borgeson、Christopher C. Gibson 和 Dean Y. Li 於 2013 年 11 月 4 日創立，總部位於猶他州鹽湖城。

info.description: Solid Biosciences, Inc. is a life science company, which engages in the development of treatments for patients with Duchenne muscular dystrophy. It also focuses on developing treatments for neuromuscular and cardiac diseases. The company was founded by Ilan Ganot, Andrey J. Zarur, Matthew Bennett Arnold, Annie Ganot, and Gilad David Hayeem in March 2013 and is headquartered in Charlestown, MA.
info.description_zh: Solid Biosciences, Inc.是一家生命科學公司，致力於開發杜氏肌肉營養不良症患者的治療方法。它還專注於開發神經肌肉和心臟病的治療方法。該公司由 Ilan Ganot、Andrey J. Zarur、Matthew Bennett Arnold、Annie Ganot 和 Gilad David Hayeem 於 2013 年 3 月創立，總部位於馬薩諸塞州查爾斯敦。

info.description: First Trust Indxx Global Agriculture ETF seeks investment results that correspond generally to the price and yield (before the fund's fees and expenses) of an equity index called the Indxx Global Agriculture Index. The fund will normally invest at least 90% of its net assets (including investment borrowings) in the common stocks and depositary receipts that comprise the index. The index is a market capitalization weighted index designed to measure the performance of companies that are directly or indirectly engaged in improving agricultural yields. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: First Trust Indxx 全球農業 ETF 尋求的投資結果通常與名為 Indxx 全球農業指數的股票指數的價格和收益率（基金費用和開支之前）相對應。該基金通常將至少 90% 的淨資產（包括投資借款）投資於構成該指數的普通股和存託憑證。該指數是市值加權指數，旨在衡量直接或間接從事提高農業產量的公司的表現。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: GraniteShares YieldBOOST Biotech ETF is designed to maximize weekly income by executing an options strategy focused primarily on selling short-term put options on leveraged exchange-traded funds that track the 3x daily performance of the biotechnology sector. The fund targets three times the income stream compared to standard options writing on its underlying industry exposure while providing capped secondary capital appreciation and implementing a discretionary downside protection layer.
info.description_zh: GraniteShares YieldBOOST 生物技術 ETF 旨在透過執行選擇策略來最大化每週收入，該策略主要側重於出售槓桿交易所交易基金的短期看跌期權，該基金追蹤生物技術行業 3 倍的每日表現。該基金的目標是其基礎產業曝險的收入流是標準選擇權的三倍，同時提供有上限的二次資本增值並實施酌情下行保護層。

info.description: Leishen Energy Holding Co., Ltd. is engaged in the oil and gas industry. It operates through the following business segments; Clean-Energy Equipment; Oil and Gas Engineering Technical Services; New Energy Production and Operation; and Digitalization and Integration Equipment. The Clean-Energy Equipment segment supplies wellhead heating systems, wellhead safety control systems, oil-water separation systems, natural gas online sampling systems, oil and gas skid-mounted equipment and polymer flexible composite pipes. The Oil and Gas Engineering Technical Services segment provides technical solutions for oil and gas production. The New Energy Production and Operation segment focuses on the production, storage and transportation of natural gas, traditional fuels, development of distributed energy, and the planning and operation of new energy and new energy industries. The Digitalization and Integration Equipment segment is designed to provide informatization solutions for industrial intelligence, mobility, industrial interconnection and big data trends. The company was founded by Hongqi Li in 2007 and is headquartered in Beijing, China.
info.industry_zh: 石油和天然氣設備與服務
info.description_zh: 雷神能源控股股份有限公司從事石油和天然氣行業。它透過以下業務部門運作；清潔能源設備；石油天然氣工程技術服務；新能源生產經營；以及數位化和整合設備。清潔能源設備部門提供井口加熱系統、井口安全控制系統、油水分離系統、天然氣線上採樣系統、油氣撬裝設備和聚合物柔性複合管。油氣工程技術服務部門為油氣生產提供技術解決方案。新能源生產營運板塊專注於天然氣、傳統燃料的生產、儲運、分散式能源開發以及新能源及新能源產業的規劃與營運。數位化及整合設備板塊旨在為工業智慧化、行動化、工業互聯和大數據趨勢提供資訊化解決方案。該公司由李紅旗於2007年創立，總部位於中國北京。

info.description: CTW operates as a web-based gaming platform. It provides game distribution services and related services to game developers. The company was founded by Ryuichi Sasaki on August 14, 2013 and is headquartered in Minato, Japan.

info.description: Cabaletta Bio, Inc. is a clinical-stage biotechnology company, which engages in the discovery and development of engineered T cell therapies for B cell-mediated autoimmune diseases. Its proprietary technology utilizes chimeric autoantibody receptor to selectively bind and eliminate B cells that produce disease-causing autoantibodies. The company was founded by Michael C. Milone, Steven Nichtberger, and Aimee Payne in April 2017 and is headquartered in Philadelphia, PA.
info.description_zh: Cabaletta Bio, Inc.是一家臨床階段的生物技術公司，致力於發現和開發針對 B 細胞介導的自身免疫性疾病的工程 T 細胞療法。其專有技術可利用嵌合自體抗體受體選擇性結合並消除產生致病自體抗體的 B 細胞。該公司由 Michael C. Milone、Steven Nichtberger 和 Aimee Payne 於 2017 年 4 月創立，總部位於賓夕法尼亞州費城。

info.description: Journey Medical Corporation is a commercial-stage pharmaceutical company, which focuses on the development and commercialization of pharmaceutical products for the treatment of dermatological conditions. Its brands include QBREXZA, Accutane, Targadox, AMZEEQ, Ximino, ZILXI, Exelderm, and Luxamend. The company was founded by Claude Maraoui in October 2014 and is headquartered in Scottsdale, AZ.
info.industry_zh: 藥品製造商 - 特用藥品和非專利藥品
info.description_zh: Journey Medical Corporation 是一家商業階段的製藥公司，專注於治療皮膚病的藥品的開發和商業化。其品牌包括 QBREXZA、Accutane、Targadox、AMZEEQ、Ximino、ZILXI、Exelderm 和 Luxamend。該公司由 Claude Maraoui 於 2014 年 10 月創立，總部位於亞利桑那州斯科茨代爾。

info.description: Baillie Gifford International Alpha ETF is an actively managed, unconstrained portfolio that invests in growth equities across developed and emerging markets, excluding the United States. Utilizing a research-driven, bottom-up fundamental selection process with a typical investment horizon of at least five years, the fund seeks long-term capital appreciation by targeting companies with strong structural advantages and distinct growth potential outside its primary benchmark, the MSCI ACWI ex USA Index.
info.description_zh: Baillie Gifford International Alpha ETF 是一種主動管理、不受約束的投資組合，投資於已開發市場和新興市場（美國除外）的成長型股票。該基金採用研究驅動、自下而上的基本面選擇流程，典型投資期限至少為五年，透過瞄準在其主要基準 MSCI ACWI（美國除外）指數之外具有強大結構優勢和明顯增長潛力的公司來尋求長期資本增值。

info.description: Bicycle Therapeutics Plc is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company, which engages in the development of a novel class of medicines, which the company refers to as bicycles, for diseases that are underserved by existing therapeutics. Its portfolio includes internal product candidates that are directed to oncology applications. The company was founded by Gregory Winter, John Tite, and Christian Heinis in 2009 and is headquartered in Cambridge, the United Kingdom.
info.description_zh: Bicycle Therapeutics Plc 是一家臨床階段的生物製藥公司，致力於開發一類新型藥物，該公司稱之為“自行車”，用於治療現有療法治療不足的疾病。其產品組合包括針對腫瘤學應用的內部候選產品。該公司由 Gregory Winter、John Tite 和 Christian Heinis 於 2009 年創立，總部位於英國劍橋。

info.description: Plains All American Pipeline LP engages in the operation of midstream energy infrastructure and provides logistics services for crude oil, natural gas liquids, and natural gas. It operates through the following business segments: Crude Oil and Natural Gas Liquids. The Crude Oil segment includes its crude oil pipelines, crude oil storage and marine terminals, and related crude oil marketing activities. The Natural Gas Liquids (NGL) segment refers to NGL pipelines, NGL storage, natural gas processing and NGL fractionation facilities, and related NGL marketing activities. The company was founded by Greg L. Armstrong in 1981 and is headquartered in Houston, TX.
info.description_zh: Plains All American Pipeline LP 從事中游能源基礎設施運營，並為原油、液化天然氣和天然氣提供物流服務。它透過以下業務部門運作：原油和液化天然氣。原油部門包括原油管道、原油儲存和海運碼頭以及相關的原油行銷活動。液化天然氣（NGL）部門是指液化天然氣管道、液化天然氣儲存、天然氣加工和液化天然氣分餾設施以及相關液化天然氣行銷活動。該公司由 Greg L. Armstrong 於 1981 年創立，總部位於德克薩斯州休士頓。

info.description: Chicago Atlantic BDC, Inc. operates as a closed-end, non-diversified management investment company. The company invests across the cannabis ecosystem through investments in the form of direct loans and equity ownership of privately held cannabis companies. The company was founded on January 25, 2021 and is headquartered in New York, NY.
info.description_zh: 芝加哥大西洋 BDC, Inc. 作為一家封閉式、非多元化的管理投資公司運作。該公司透過直接貸款和私人大麻公司股權形式的投資來投資整個大麻生態系統。該公司成立於2021年1月25日，總部位於紐約州紐約。

info.description: Defiance Daily Target 2X Long SOFI ETF seeks daily investment results, before fees and expenses, of two times (200%) the daily percentage change in the share price of SoFi Technologies, Inc. (Nasdaq: SOFI). The fund is an actively managed exchange traded fund ("ETF") that attempts to achieve two times (200%) the daily percentage change in the share price of the underlying security by employing derivatives, namely swap agreements and/or listed options contracts. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Defiance 每日目標 2 倍多頭 SOFI ETF 尋求每日投資結果（扣除費用和開支）為 SoFi Technologies, Inc.（納斯達克股票代碼：SOFI）每日股價變化百分比的兩倍（200%）。該基金是一種主動管理的交易所交易基金（「ETF」），試圖透過使用衍生性商品（即掉期協議和/或上市選擇權合約）來實現標的證券股價每日百分比變化的兩倍（200%）。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: FortuneX Acquisition Corp is a blank check company. It was formed to effect a merger, share exchange, asset acquisition, share purchase, reorganization, or similar business combination with one or more businesses. The company was founded on February 16, 2026 and is headquartered in New York, NY.
info.description_zh: FortuneX Acquisition Corp 是一家空白支票公司。它的成立是為了與一個或多個企業進行合併、股份交換、資產收購、股份購買、重組或類似的業務合併。該公司成立於2026年2月16日，總部位於紐約州紐約。

info.description: Corteva, Inc. is a global pure-play agriculture company that combines innovative technologies, high-touch customer engagement and operational execution to profitably deliver solutions for the world's most pressing agriculture challenges. It generates advantaged market preference through its unique distribution strategy, together with its balanced and globally diverse mix of seed, crop protection, and digital products and services. The company leverages recognized agricultural brands and a robust technology pipeline to maximize productivity for farmers while working with stakeholders throughout the food system to fulfill its promise of enriching the lives of those who produce and those who consume, ensuring progress for generations to come. Corteva was founded in 1802 and is headquartered in Indianapolis, IN.

info.description_zh: Corteva, Inc. 是一家全球性的纯农业公司，它将创新技术、高接触客户参与和运营执行相结合，为世界上最紧迫的农业挑战提供可盈利的解决方案。它通过其独特的分销策略以及平衡且全球多样化的种子、作物保护以及数字产品和服务组合，产生了有利的市场偏好。该公司利用公认的农业品牌和强大的技术渠道，最大限度地提高农民的生产力，同时与整个粮食系统的利益相关者合作，履行其丰富生产者和消费者生活的承诺，确保子孙后代的进步。 Corteva 成立於 1802 年，總部位於印第安納州印第安納波利斯。

info.description: iShares MBS ETF seeks to track the investment results of the Bloomberg U.S. MBS Index composed of investment-grade mortgage-backed pass-through securities issued and/or guaranteed by U.S. government agencies. The fund will invest at least 80% of its assets in the component securities of the underlying index and TBAs that have economic characteristics that are substantially identical to the economic characteristics of the component securities of the index, and the fund will invest at least 90% of its assets in fixed income securities of the types included in the underlying index that BFA believes will help the fund track the index.
info.description_zh: iShares MBS ETF 旨在追蹤彭博美國 MBS 指數的投資結果，該指數由美國政府機構發行和/或擔保的投資等級抵押貸款支持傳遞證券組成。該基金將至少 80% 的資產投資於標的指數的組成證券以及經濟特徵與該指數組成證券的經濟特徵基本相同的 TBA，並且該基金將至少 90% 的資產投資於 BFA 認為將有助於基金跟踪該指數的標的指數中包含的固定收益證券類型。

info.description: Imperial Petroleum, Inc. is a ship-owning company, which engages in the provision of petroleum products and crude oil seaborne transportation services. It offers international seaborne transportation services to oil producers, refineries, and commodities traders. The company has a fleet of three medium range product tankers that carry refined petroleum products, such as gasoline, diesel, fuel oil and jet fuel, as well as edible oils and chemicals, and one Aframax tanker, which is used for carrying crude oil. Imperial Petroleum was founded on May 14, 2021 and is headquartered in Athens, Greece.
info.description_zh: Imperial Petroleum, Inc.是一家船舶公司，從事提供石油產品和原油海運服務。它為石油生產商、煉油廠和大宗商品貿易商提供國際海運服務。該公司擁有一支由三艘中程成品油輪組成的船隊，運載汽油、柴油、燃料油和噴射燃料等精煉石油產品，以及食用油和化學品，以及一艘用於運載原油的阿芙拉型油輪。帝國石油成立於2021年5月14日，總部位於希臘雅典。

info.description: Iron Horse Acquisition II Corp. operates as a blank check company. It was formed for the purpose of effecting a merger, amalgamation, share exchange, asset acquisition, share purchase, reorganization or similar business combination with one or more businesses. The company was founded on November 26, 2024 and is headquartered in Boca Raton, FL.
info.description_zh: Iron Horse Acquisition II Corp. 作為一家空白支票公司運作。它的成立目的是與一個或多個企業進行合併、合併、股份交換、資產收購、股份購買、重組或類似的業務合併。該公司成立於 2024 年 11 月 26 日，總部位於佛羅裡達州博卡拉頓。

info.description: F/m Compoundr U.S. Aggregate Bond ETF seeks investment results, that correspond (before fees and expenses) generally to the Nasdaq Compoundr 10-Year U.S. Treasury Note Index. The index is designed to offer exposure consistent with the total return of U.S. investment-grade aggregate bonds, without receiving and reinvesting dividend income, by investing in ETFs. Under normal market conditions, F/m Investments LLC (the "Adviser") seeks to achieve the fund's objective by investing at least 80% of the fund's net assets (plus any borrowings for investment purposes) in underlying funds that primarily invest in U.S. dollar denominated investment-grade bonds.
info.description_zh: F/m 複合美國綜合債券 ETF 追求的投資結果通常與納斯達克複合 10 年期美國公債指數相對應（未計費用和開支）。該指數旨在透過投資 ETF 提供與美國投資等級總債券總回報一致的風險敞口，而無需接收股息收入並進行再投資。在正常市場條件下，F/m Investments LLC（「顧問」）尋求透過將至少 80% 的基金淨資產（加上任何用於投資目的的借款）投資於主要投資於以美元計價的投資級債券的基礎基金來實現基金的目標。

info.description: Vanguard Core Bond ETF seeks to provide total return while generating a moderate level of income. The fund invests in fixed income securities of various maturities, yields, and qualities. Under normal circumstances, the fund will invest at least 80% of its assets in bonds, which include fixed income securities such as corporate bonds; U.S. Treasury obligations and other U.S. government and agency securities; and asset-backed, mortgage-backed, and mortgage-related securities.
info.description_zh: Vanguard Core Bond ETF 尋求提供總回報，同時產生適度的收入水準。該基金投資於各種期限、收益率和品質的固定收益證券。一般情況下，基金將至少80%的資產投資於債券，其中包括公司債等固定收益證券；美國財政部債務和其他美國政府和機構證券；以及資產支持、抵押貸款支持和抵押相關證券。

info.description: Invesco BulletShares 2030 Corporate Bond ETF seeks to track the investment results (before fees and expenses) of the Nasdaq BulletShares USD Corporate Bond 2030 Index. The fund generally will invest at least 80% of its total assets in securities that comprise the underlying index. The underlying index seeks to measure the performance of a portfolio of U.S. dollar-denominated investment grade corporate bonds with maturities or, in some cases, "effective maturities" in the year 2030. It does not purchase all of the securities in the index; instead, the fund utilizes a "sampling" methodology to seek to achieve its investment objective. It is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Invesco BulletShares 2030 Corporate Bond ETF 旨在追蹤納斯達克 BulletShares USD Corporate Bond 2030 指數的投資結果（未計費用和支出）。該基金通常將至少 80% 的總資產投資於構成標的指數的證券。該指數旨在衡量 2030 年到期（或在某些情況下為「有效到期」）的以美元計價的投資等級公司債投資組合的表現。它不會購買指數中的所有證券；相反，該基金採用"抽樣"方法來尋求實現其投資目標。它是非多元化的。

info.description: Vanguard Mortgage-Backed Securities Index Fund ETF Shares seeks to track the performance of a market-weighted mortgage-backed securities index. The fund employs an indexing investment approach designed to track the performance of the Bloomberg U.S. MBS Float Adjusted Index. This index covers U.S. agency mortgage-backed pass-through securities issued by the GNMA, the FNMA, and the FHLMC. To be included in the index, pool aggregates must have at least $1 billion currently outstanding and a weighted average maturity of at least 1 year. All of the fund's investments will be selected through the sampling process, and at least 80% of the fund's assets will be invested in bonds included in the index.
info.description_zh: Vanguard 抵押貸款支持證券指數基金 ETF 股票旨在追蹤市場加權抵押貸款支持證券指數的表現。該基金採用指數投資方法，旨在追蹤彭博美國MBS浮動調整指數的表現。該指數涵蓋 GNMA、FNMA 和 FHLMC 發行的美國機構抵押貸款支持傳遞證券。要納入該指數，資金池總計必須擁有至少 10 億美元的當前未償還資金，且加權平均期限至少為 1 年。基金的所有投資將透過抽樣過程進行篩選，基金資產的至少80%將投資於指數納入的債券。

info.description: MercadoLibre, Inc. engages in the development of an online commerce platform with a focus on e-commerce and related services. It operates through the following geographical segments: Brazil, Argentina, Mexico, and Other Countries. The Other Countries segment refers to Chile, Colombia, Costa Rica, Dominican Republic, Ecuador, Panama, Peru, Bolivia, Honduras, Nicaragua, El Salvador, Guatemala, Paraguay, Uruguay, and the United States of America. Its products provide a mechanism for buying, selling, and paying as well as collecting, generating leads, and comparing lists through e-commerce transactions. The company was founded by Marcos Eduardo Galperin on October 15, 1999 and is headquartered in Montevideo, Uruguay.

info.description: Art Technology Acquisition Corp. operates as a blank check company. It was formed for the purpose of effecting a merger, capital stock exchange, asset acquisition, stock purchase, reorganization, or similar business combination with one or more businesses. The company was founded on August 22, 2025 and is headquartered in Philadelphia, PA.
info.description_zh: Art Technology Acquisition Corp. 作為一家空白支票公司運作。它的成立目的是與一個或多個企業進行合併、股本交換、資產收購、股票購買、重組或類似的業務合併。該公司成立於2025年8月22日，總部位於賓州費城。

info.description: Atara Biotherapeutics, Inc. is an allogeneic T-cell immunotherapy company, which engages in the development of transformative therapies for patients with serious diseases including solid tumors, hematologic cancers, and autoimmune diseases. It also delivers off-the-shelf treatments to patients with high unmet medical need. Its product pipeline includes Tab-cel, ATA188, ATA2271/ATA3271, and ATA3219. The company was founded by Isaac E. Ciechanover on August 22, 2012 and is headquartered in Thousand Oaks, CA.
info.description_zh: Atara Biotherapeutics, Inc.是一家同種異體T細胞免疫療法公司，致力於為實體腫瘤、血液癌症和自體免疫疾病等嚴重疾病患者開發轉化療法。它也為醫療需求未被滿足的患者提供現成的治療方案。其產品線包括Tab-cel、ATA188、ATA2271/ATA3271和ATA3219。該公司由 Isaac E. Ciechanover 於 2012 年 8 月 22 日創立，總部位於加州千橡市。

info.description: Avos Global Equities ETF is an actively managed fund that targets long-term capital appreciation by investing in a diversified portfolio of global equity securities, including common and preferred stocks, depositary receipts, REITs, and underlying ETFs. The investment strategy utilizes a proprietary multi-step process that evaluates countries and companies based on long-term structural valuations and short-term market dynamics, ensuring exposure to at least three countries with a significant allocation to non-U.S. developed and emerging markets.
info.description_zh: Avos 全球股票 ETF 是一檔積極管理的基金，透過投資於全球股票證券的多元化投資組合（包括普通股和優先股、存託憑證、房地產投資信託基金和基礎 ETF）來實現長期資本增值。此投資策略採用專有的多步驟流程，根據長期結構性估值和短期市場動態對國家和公司進行評估，確保投資於至少三個國家，並在非美國已開發市場和新興市場上有大量配置。

info.description: Bitcoin Infrastructure Acquisition Corp. Ltd. operates as a blank check company. It was formed for the purpose of effecting a merger, amalgamation, share exchange, asset acquisition, share purchase, reorganization or similar business combination with one or more businesses, which refer to throughout this prospectus as initial business combination. The company was founded on June 9, 2025 and is headquartered in Boca Raton, FL.
info.description_zh: Bitcoin Infrastructure Acquisition Corp. Ltd. 作為一家空白支票公司運作。其成立的目的是与一个或多个企业进行合并、合并、股份交换、资产收购、股份购买、重组或类似的业务合并，在本招股说明书中将其称为初始业务合并。該公司成立於 2025 年 6 月 9 日，總部位於佛羅裡達州博卡拉頓。

info.description: Vanguard Total Bond Market Index Fund ETF Shares seeks to track the performance of the Bloomberg U.S. Aggregate Float Adjusted Index. This index measures the performance of a wide spectrum of public, investment-grade, taxable, fixed income securities in the United States-including government, corporate, and international dollar-denominated bonds, as well as mortgage-backed and asset-backed securities-all with maturities of more than 1 year. All of the fund's investments will be selected through the sampling process, and at least 80% of its assets will be invested in bonds held in the index.
info.description_zh: Vanguard Total Bond Market Index Fund ETF Shares 旨在追蹤彭博美國總流通量調整指數的表現。 This index measures the performance of a wide spectrum of public, investment-grade, taxable, fixed income securities in the United States-including government, corporate, and international dollar-denominated bonds, Y 1 year. All of the fund's investments will be selected through the sampling process, and at least 80% of its assets will be invested in bonds held in the index.

info.description: BRBI BR Partners SA engages in the provision of banking services. It operates through the finance segment. The company was founded by Ricardo Fleury Cavalcanti de Albuquerque Lacerda in 2009 and is headquartered in Sao Paulo, Brazil.
info.description_zh: BRBI BR Partners SA 從事提供銀行服務。它透過金融部門運作。該公司由 Ricardo Fleury Cavalcanti de Albuquerque Lacerda 於 2009 年創立，總部位於巴西聖保羅。

info.description: AB Core Plus Bond ETF seeks to maximize total return through current income and long-term capital appreciation. The fund pursues its objective by investing, under normal circumstances, at least 80% of its net assets, including any borrowings for investment purposes, in fixed-income securities. It may invest in a broad range of debt securities, including corporate bonds and debt and mortgage- and other asset-backed securities issued by U.S. government-sponsored entities and federal agencies and instrumentalities that are not backed by the full faith and credit of the U.S. government.

info.description: Caribou Biosciences, Inc. engages in the development of an internal pipeline of off-the-shelf CAR-T and CAR-NK cell therapies. Its tools and technologies provide transformative capabilities to basic and applied biological research, therapeutic development, agricultural biotechnology, and industrial biotechnology. The company was founded by Jennifer A. Doudna, Rachel E. Haurwitz, Martin Jinek and James Berger on October 28, 2011 and is headquartered in Berkeley, CA.
info.description_zh: Caribou Biosciences, Inc. 致力於開發現成的 CAR-T 和 CAR-NK 細胞療法的內部管道。其工具和技術為基礎和應用生物學研究、治療開發、農業生物技術和工業生物技術提供變革能力。該公司由 Jennifer A. Doudna、Rachel E. Haurwitz、Martin Jinek 和 James Berger 於 2011 年 10 月 28 日創立，總部位於加州伯克利。

info.description: Leverage Shares 2x Long CRML Daily ETF is an actively managed, non-diversified exchange-traded fund that seeks to provide daily investment results, before fees and expenses, that correspond to two times (200%) the daily performance of the common stock of Critical Metals Corp. (CRML). The fund is designed as a short-term trading tool for sophisticated investors seeking amplified bullish exposure to a specific mineral mining asset, utilizing financial derivatives to achieve its daily leverage target.

info.description: iShares Emerging Markets Infrastructure ETF seeks to track the investment results of the S&P Emerging Markets Infrastructure IndexTM, which is designed to track the performance of 30 of the largest publicly listed companies in the infrastructure industry in emerging markets. The fund generally will invest at least 80% of its assets in the component securities of the index and in investments that have economic characteristics that are substantially identical to the component securities of the index and may invest up to 20% of its assets in certain futures, options and swap contracts, cash and cash equivalents, as well as in securities not included in the index. It is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: iShares 新興市場基礎設施​​ ETF 旨在追蹤標普新興市場基礎設施​​指數™的投資結果，該指數旨在追蹤新興市場基礎設施​​產業 30 家最大的上市公司的表現。該基金通常將至少 80% 的資產投資於指數的組成證券以及具有與指數的組成證券基本相同的經濟特徵的投資，並可能將最多 20% 的資產投資於某些期貨、期權和掉期合約、現金和現金等價物以及未納入指數的證券。它是非多元化的。

info.description: iShares ESG Aware MSCI EM ETF seeks to track the investment results of the MSCI Emerging Markets Extended ESG Focus Index. The fund generally will invest at least 90% of its assets in the component securities of the underlying index and in investments that have economic characteristics that are substantially identical to the component securities of the underlying index. The index is an optimized equity index designed to reflect the equity performance of companies that have favorable ESG characteristics, while exhibiting risk and return characteristics similar to those of the MSCI Emerging Markets Index (the "parent index").
info.description_zh: iShares ESG Aware MSCI EM ETF 旨在追踪 MSCI 新兴市场扩展 ESG 焦点指数的投资结果。該基金通常將至少 90% 的資產投資於標的指數的組成證券以及具有與標的指數的組成證券基本相同的經濟特徵的投資。該指數是優化的股票指數，旨在反映具有良好 ESG 特徵的公司的股票表現，同時表現出與 MSCI 新興市場指數（「母指數」）類似的風險和回報特徵。

info.description: enCore Energy Corp. engages in the acquisition and exploration of resource properties. Its projects portfolio includes the Kingsville Dome, Rosita, Vasquez, Butler Ranch in Texas, Crownpoint & Hosta Butte, Nose Rock, Cebolleta, Juan Tafoya, West Largo, Ambrosia Lake-Treeline, Marquez, Checkerboard Mineral Rights in New Mexico, Moonshine Springs in Arizona, and White Canyon District in Utah. The company was founded on October 30, 2009 and is headquartered in Corpus Christi, TX.
info.description_zh: enCore Energy Corp. 從事資源資產的收購和勘探。其項目組合包括德克薩斯州的 Kingsville Dome、Rosita、Vasquez、Butler Ranch、Crownpoint & Hosta Butte、Nose Rock、Cebolleta、Juan Tafoya、West Largo、Ambrosia Lake-Treeline、Marquez、新墨西哥州的 Checkerboard Mineral Rights、亞利桑那州的 White Districtshine Springs 和猶他州的 White Canyon。該公司成立於2009年10月30日，總部位於德克薩斯州科珀斯克里斯蒂。

info.description: Exelixis, Inc. is an oncology company, which focuses on discovering, developing, and commercialization of new medicines for difficult-to-treat cancers. Its products include cabometyx, cometriq, and cotellic. The company was founded by Stelios Papadopoulos on November 15, 1994, and is headquartered in Alameda, CA.

The fund is non-diversified.

info.description: Leverage Shares 2X Long GEMI Daily ETF seeks daily levered investment results, before fees and expenses, of two times (200%) of the daily percentage change in the price of the common stock of GEMI. The fund is an actively managed ETF. The fund invests at least 80% of its net assets (plus borrowings for investment purposes) in the Underlying Security and financial instruments with economic characteristics that, in combination, provide 200% daily leveraged exposure to the price of GEMI, consistent with the fund's investment objective. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: 槓桿股票 2 倍多頭 GEMI 每日 ETF 尋求每日槓桿投資結果（未計費用和開支）為 GEMI 普通股價格每日百分比變化的兩倍 (200%)。該基金是主動式管理ETF。該基金將至少 80% 的淨資產（加上用於投資目的的借款）投資於標的證券和具有經濟特徵的金融工具，這些金融工具結合起來提供 GEMI 價格的 200% 每日槓桿敞口，這與基金的投資目標一致。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Gemini Space Station, Inc. is a holding company, which engages in building secure financial infrastructure for the next generation of money and markets, providing access for individuals and institutions to a financial future that is more open, fair, and secure. The firm offers a mobile and web based crypto asset exchange platform, proprietary wallet infrastructure and custody solutions, over-the-counter trading solutions tailored to institutions and professionals, a digital art auction platform, a proprietary United States dollar backed stablecoin, and a credit card product that offers crypto asset rewards on customer purchases. The company was founded by Tyler Winklevoss and Cameron Winklevoss in 2014 and is headquartered in New York, NY.

info.description: Invesco Equal Weight 0-30 Year Treasury ETF seeks to track the investment results (before fees and expenses) of the ICE 1-30 Year Laddered Maturity U.S. Treasury Index. The fund generally will invest at least 80% of its total assets in the components of the index. The index provider compiles, maintains and calculates the underlying index, which is designed to track the performance of up to 30 U.S. Treasury Notes or Bonds representing the annual February maturity ladder across the yield curve.
info.description_zh: Invesco 等權重 0-30 年期公債 ETF 旨在追蹤 ICE 1-30 年階梯式到期美國國債指數的投資結果（扣除費用和開支之前）。該基金一般會將至少80%的總資產投資於該指數的成分股。指數提供者編制、維護和計算基礎指數，該指數旨在追蹤最多 30 種美國國債或債券的表現，代表每年 2 月殖利率曲線上的到期階梯。

info.description: KraneShares 2x Long MELI Daily ETF seeks daily investment results, before fees and expenses, of 2 times (200%) the daily percentage change of the ADR of MercadoLibre, Inc. Under normal circumstances, the fund invests at least 80% of its net assets (plus any borrowings for investment purposes) in the underlying stock and financial instruments, such as swap agreements and options, that, in combination, provide investment exposure to 2 times (200%) the performance of the underlying stock. The fund is non-diversified.

The company was founded in 2015 and is headquartered in Lexington, MA.

The company was founded on February 23, 2010 and is headquartered in Hallandale Beach, FL.

info.description: Monro, Inc. engages in the operation of chain stores that provide automotive undercar repair and tire services. It also offers services for brakes, mufflers and exhaust systems, and steering, drive train, suspension and wheel alignment. It operates under the brand names Monro Auto Service and Tire Centers, Tire Choice Auto Service Centers, Mr. Tire Auto Service Centers, Car-X Tire & Auto, Tire Warehouse Tires for Less, Ken Towery's Tire & Auto Care, Tire Barn Warehouse, and Free Service Tire and Auto Centers. The company was founded by Charles J. August in 1957 and is headquartered in Fairport, NY.

info.description: Prime Medicine, Inc. is a biotechnology company, which engages in developing one-time curative genetic therapies. The company was founded by David R. Liu on September 13, 2019 and is headquartered in Cambridge, MA.
info.description_zh: Prime Medicine, Inc. 是一家生技公司，致力於開發一次性治療性基因療法。該公司由 David R. Liu 於 2019 年 9 月 13 日創立，總部位於馬薩諸塞州劍橋。

info.description: Rocket Pharmaceuticals, Inc. is a clinical-stage biotechnology company, which engages in the development of gene therapy treatment options for rare and devastating pediatric diseases. The firm's multi-platform development approach applies the lentiviral vector and adeno-associated viral vector gene therapy platforms. Its clinical program is an LVV-based gene therapy for the treatment of Fanconi Anemia (FA), a difficult to treat genetic disease that leads to bone marrow failure and potentially cancer. The company was founded on July 7, 1999 and is headquartered in Cranbury, NJ.
info.description_zh: Rocket Pharmaceuticals, Inc.是一家臨床階段的生物技術公司，致力於開發針對罕見和毀滅性兒科疾病的基因療法。該公司的多平台開發方法應用了慢病毒載體和腺相關病毒載體基因治療平台。其臨床計畫是基於 LVV 的基因療法，用於治療範可尼貧血 (FA)，這是一種難以治療的遺傳性疾病，會導致骨髓衰竭和潛在的癌症。該公司成立於1999年7月7日，總部位於新澤西州克蘭伯里。

info.description: SNDL, Inc. is a licensed producer that crafts small-batch cannabis using state-of-the-art indoor facilities. It operates through the following segments: Liquor Retail, Cannabis Retail, Cannabis Operations, and Investments. The Liquor Retail segment consists of wines, beers, and spirits through owned liquor stores. The Cannabis Retail segment comprises of the private sale of adult-use cannabis through owned and franchise retail cannabis stores. The Cannabis Operations covers the cultivation, distribution and sale of cannabis for the adult-use, and medical markets domestically and for export. The Investments segment includes the deployment of capital to investment opportunities. The company was founded by Stanley J. Swiatek on August 19, 2006 and is headquartered in Calgary, Canada.
info.industry_zh: 飲料 - 釀酒廠和釀酒廠
info.description_zh: SNDL, Inc. 是一家獲得許可的生產商，使用最先進的室內設施生產小批量大麻。它透過以下部門運作：酒類零售、大麻零售、大麻營運和投資。酒類零售部門透過自有酒類商店銷售葡萄酒、啤酒和烈酒。大麻零售部門包括透過自營和特許零售大麻商店私人銷售成人用大麻。大麻業務涵蓋供成人使用以及國內和出口醫療市場使用的大麻的種植、分銷和銷售。投資部門包括將資本部署到投資機會。該公司由Stanley J. Swiatek於2006年8月19日創立，總部位於加拿大卡加利。

info.description: Taylor Devices, Inc. engages in the design, development, manufacture, and marketing of shock absorption, rate control, and energy storage devices. Its products include metal bellows dampers, fluid viscous dampers, landing and arresting gear, pumpkin mounts, isolation systems, custom applications, crane buffers, shock absorbers, liquid die springs, lock up devices, machined springs, and actuators. The company was founded by Paul H. Taylor on July 22, 1955 and is headquartered in North Tonawanda, NY.
info.description_zh: Taylor Devices, Inc. 從事減震、速率控制和儲能設備的設計、開發、製造和行銷。其產品包括金屬波紋管阻尼器、流體黏性阻尼器、著陸和煞車裝置、南瓜支架、隔離系統、客製化應用、起重機緩衝器、避震器、液體模具彈簧、鎖定裝置、機械加工彈簧和執行器。該公司由 Paul H. Taylor 於 1955 年 7 月 22 日創立，總部位於紐約州北托納旺達。

info.description: iShares 20+ Year Treasury Bond ETF seeks to track the investment results of the ICE U.S. Treasury 20+ Year Bond Index (the "underlying index"). The fund will invest at least 80% of its assets in the component securities of the underlying index, and it will invest at least 90% of its assets in U.S. Treasury securities that the advisor believes will help the fund track the underlying index. The underlying index measures the performance of public obligations of the U.S. Treasury that have a remaining maturity greater than or equal to twenty years.
info.description_zh: iShares 20+ 年期公債 ETF 旨在追蹤 ICE 美國 20+ 年期公債指數（「基礎指數」）的投資結果。該基金將至少 80% 的資產投資於標的指數的組成證券，並將至少 90% 的資產投資於顧問認為將有助於基金追蹤標的指數的美國國債。基礎指數衡量剩餘期限大於或等於二十年的美國財政部公共債務的履行。

info.description: VictoryShares Core Intermediate Bond ETF seeks high current income without undue risk to principal. Under normal circumstances, the fund invests at least 80% of its assets in debt securities and in derivatives and other instruments that have economic characteristics similar to such securities. The fund may invest up to 20% of its net assets in foreign debt securities, including non-U.S. dollar- denominated securities and securities of companies in emerging market countries (i.e., those that are in the early stages of their industrial cycles).
info.description_zh: VictoryShares Core Intermediate Bond ETF 追求高当期收入，且不对本金造成不当风险。一般情况下，基金至少80%的资产投资于债务证券以及具有与此类证券类似经济特征的衍生品和其他工具。該基金最多可將其淨資產的20%投資於外債證券，包括非美元計價的證券和新興市場國家（即處於工業週期早期階段的國家）公司的證券。

info.description: Vanguard Target Maturity 2033 Corporate Bond ETF tracks a market-weighted index of U.S. dollar-denominated, investment-grade corporate bonds scheduled to mature within the calendar year 2033. This term fund employs a passive sampling strategy designed to provide predictable monthly income and a return of principal upon its scheduled liquidation on or about December 15, 2033.
info.description_zh: Vanguard Target Maturity 2033 Corporate Bond ETF 追蹤計畫於 2033 年到期的以美元計價的投資等級公司債的市場加權指數。該定期基金採用被動抽樣策略，旨在在 2033 年 12 月 15 日左右的預定清算時提供可預測的月收入和本金回報。

info.description: Vanguard Target Maturity 2035 Corporate Bond ETF tracks a market-weighted index of U.S. dollar-denominated, investment-grade corporate bonds scheduled to mature within the calendar year 2035. This term fund employs a passive sampling strategy designed to provide predictable monthly income and a return of principal upon its scheduled liquidation on or about December 15, 2035.
info.description_zh: Vanguard Target Maturity 2035 Corporate Bond ETF 追蹤計畫於 2035 年到期的以美元計價的投資等級公司債的市場加權指數。該定期基金採用被動抽樣策略，旨在在 2035 年 12 月 15 日左右的預定清算時提供可預測的月收入和本金回報。

info.description: Vertex, Inc. engages in the provision of tax compliance software solutions. The firm offers comprehensive solutions that automate end-to-end indirect tax processes for enterprises and mid-market companies with complex tax transactions. Its software enables tax determination, data management, compliance and reporting, and document management. The company was founded by Ray Westphal and Antoinette Westphal in 1978 and is headquartered in King of Prussia, PA.
info.description_zh: Vertex, Inc. 從事提供稅務合規軟體解決方案。該公司提供全面的解決方案，為具有複雜稅務交易的企業和中型市場公司實現端到端間接稅務流程的自動化。其軟體支援稅務確定、資料管理、合規性和報告以及文件管理。該公司由 Ray Westphal 和 Antoinette Westphal 於 1978 年創立，總部位於賓夕法尼亞州普魯士國王。

info.description: Vanguard Long-Term Treasury Index Fund ETF Shares seeks to track the performance of a market-weighted Treasury index with a long-term dollar-weighted average maturity. The fund employs an indexing investment approach designed to track the performance of the Bloomberg U.S. Long Treasury Index. This index includes fixed income securities issued by the U.S. Treasury (not including inflation-protected bonds, floating rate securities and certain other security types), with maturities greater than 10 years. Under normal circumstances, at least 80% of the fund's assets will be invested in bonds included in the index.
info.description_zh: Vanguard長期公債指數基金ETF份額旨在追蹤具有長期美元加權平均期限的市場加權國債指數的表現。該基金採用指數投資方法，旨在追蹤彭博美國長期國債指數的表現。該指數包括美國財政部發行的期限超過 10 年的固定收益證券（不包括通膨保值債券、浮動利率證券和某些其他證券類型）。一般情況下，基金資產至少80%會投資於指數納入的債券。

info.description: Vendome Acquisition Corp. I operates as a blank check company. It was formed for the purpose of effecting a merger, capital stock exchange, asset acquisition, stock purchase, reorganization, or similar business combination with one or more businesses. The company was founded on January 28, 2025 and is headquartered in Park City, UT.

info.description: Vanguard Core-Plus Bond ETF seeks to provide total return while generating a moderate to high level of current income. The fund invests in fixed income securities of various maturities, yields, and qualities. Under normal circumstances, the fund will invest at least 80% of its assets in bonds, which include fixed income securities such as corporate bonds; U.S. Treasury obligations and other U.S. government and agency securities; and asset-backed, mortgage-backed, and mortgage-related securities.
info.description_zh: Vanguard Core-Plus Bond ETF 尋求提供總回報，同時產生中等到高水準的當前收入。該基金投資於各種期限、收益率和品質的固定收益證券。一般情況下，基金將至少80%的資產投資於債券，其中包括公司債等固定收益證券；美國財政部債務和其他美國政府和機構證券；以及資產支持、抵押貸款支持和抵押相關證券。

info.description: XP, Inc. engages in the operation of technology-driven financial services platform. The firm provides customers with two principal types of offerings, financial advisory services for retail clients in Brazil, high-net-worth clients, international clients and corporate and institutional clients, and an open financial product platform providing access to over 800 investment products including equity and fixed income securities, mutual and hedge funds, structured products, life insurance, pension plans, real-estate investment funds (REITs) and others from XP, its partners and competitors. he company was founded by Guilherme Dias Fernandes Benchimol in 2001 and is headquartered in Vila Olimpia, Brazil.

info.description: GraniteShares YieldBOOST Ether ETF is an actively managed fund that employs a synthetic income-generation strategy by selling put options on leveraged exchange-traded funds linked to the daily performance of Ether. The fund seeks to achieve 200% of the income derived from standard option strategies on the reference asset while maintaining exposure to the underlying leveraged instrument, albeit constrained by a cap on potential capital appreciation.
info.description_zh: GraniteShares YieldBOOST 以太 ETF 是一檔主動式管理基金，透過出售與以太每日表現掛鉤的槓桿交易所交易基金看跌期權，採用合成創收策略。該基金力求實現參考資產的標準選擇權策略所產生的 200% 的收入，同時保持對基礎槓桿工具的曝險，儘管受到潛在資本增值上限的限制。

info.description: Emmis Acquisition Corp. operates as a blank check company. It was formed for the purpose of effecting a merger, amalgamation, share exchange, asset acquisition, share purchase, reorganization or similar business combination with one or more businesses. The company was founded on March 21, 2025 and is headquartered in Fort Lauderdale, FL.
info.description_zh: Emmis Acquisition Corp. 以空白支票公司經營。它的成立目的是與一個或多個企業進行合併、合併、股份交換、資產收購、股份購買、重組或類似的業務合併。該公司成立於2025年3月21日，總部位於佛羅裡達州勞德代爾堡。

info.description: Leverage Shares 2X Long DUOL Daily ETF seeks daily levered investment results, before fees and expenses, of two times (200%) of the daily percentage change in the price of the common stock of DUOL. The fund is an actively managed ETF. The fund invests at least 80% of its net assets (plus borrowings for investment purposes) in the Underlying Security and financial instruments with economic characteristics that, in combination, provide 200% daily leveraged exposure to the price of DUOL, consistent with the fund's investment objective. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: 槓桿股票 2 倍多頭 DUOL 每日 ETF 尋求每日槓桿投資結果（扣除費用和開支）為 DUOL 普通股價格每日百分比變化的兩倍 (200%)。該基金是主動式管理ETF。該基金將至少 80% 的淨資產（加上用於投資目的的借款）投資於標的證券和具有經濟特徵的金融工具，這些金融工具結合起來提供 DUOL 價格的 200% 每日槓桿敞口，這與基金的投資目標一致。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Biogen, Inc. is a biopharmaceutical company, which engages in discovering, developing, and delivering therapies for neurological and neurodegenerative diseases. Its products include TECFIDERA, VUMERITY, AVONEX, PLEGRIDY, TYSABRI, and FAMPYRA for the treatment of MS, SPINRAZA for the treatment of SMA, ADUHELM for the treatment of Alzheimer's disease, and FUMADERM for the treatment of severe plaque psoriasis. The company was founded by Charles Weissmann, Heinz Schaller, Kenneth Murray, Walter Gilbert, and Phillip Allen Sharp in 1978 and is headquartered in Cambridge, MA.
info.description_zh: Biogen, Inc. 是一家生物製藥公司，致力於發現、開發和提供神經系統和神經退化性疾病的治療方法。其產品包括用於治療多發性硬化症的TECFIDERA、VUMERITY、AVONEX、PLEGRIDY、TYSABRI和FAMPYRA，用於治療SMA的SPINRAZA，用於治療阿茲海默症的ADUHELM，以及用於治療嚴重斑塊狀乾癬的FUMADERM。該公司由 Charles Weissmann、Heinz Schaller、Kenneth Murray、Walter Gilbert 和 Phillip Allen Sharp 於 1978 年創立，總部位於馬薩諸塞州劍橋。

info.description: Invesco Agriculture Commodity Strategy No K-1 ETF seeks long-term capital appreciation. The fund is an actively managed ETF that seeks to achieve its investment objective by investing in a combination of financial instruments that are economically linked to commodities drawn from the agriculture sector. It will not invest directly in physical commodities, Commodities Futures or Commodity-Linked Instruments. Instead, The Advisor attempts to obtain investment returns that are highly correlated to the agriculture commodities markets by investing in these instruments indirectly through its Subsidiary. It is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: 景順農業商品策略No K-1 ETF尋求長期資本增值。該基金是一檔主動管理的 ETF，旨在透過投資與農業部門商品經濟相關的金融工具組合來實現其投資目標。它不會直接投資於實體商品、商品期貨或商品相關工具。相反，顧問試圖透過其子公司間接投資於這些工具，以獲得與農產品市場高度相關的投資回報。它是非多元化的。

info.description: GraniteShares YieldBOOST TSLA ETF seeks current income; the secondary investment objective being exposure to the performance of one or more exchange-traded funds whose shares trade on a U.S.-regulated securities exchange and that seek daily leverage investment results of 2 times (200%) the daily percentage of the common stock of Tesla Inc. subject to a limit on potential investment gains. The fund will invest at least 80% of its net assets in derivatives contracts that utilize the underlying TSLA ETF as the reference asset. The fund is non-diversified.

The company was founded in 1999 and is headquartered in Austin, TX.
