info.description: GraniteShares YieldBOOST HIMS ETF seeks to achieve 2 times (200%) the income generated from selling options on Hims & Hers Health, Inc.'s common stock by selling options on leveraged exchange-traded funds designed to deliver 2 times (200%) the daily performance of the Underlying Stock and to gain exposure to the performance of the Underlying Leveraged ETF, subject to a cap on potential investment gains. The fund will invest at least 80% of its net assets (plus any borrowings for investment purposes) in derivatives contracts that utilize the Underlying Leveraged ETF as their reference asset. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: GraniteShares YieldBOOST HIMS ETF seeks to achieve 2 times (200%) the income generated from selling options on Hims & Hers Health, Inc.'s common stock by selling options on leveraged exchange-traded deliverd deliver 3個） of the Underlying Stock and to gain exposure to the performance of the Underlying Leveraged ETF, subject to a cap on potential investment gains.該基金將至少 80% 的淨資產（加上任何用於投資目的的借款）投資於以基礎槓桿 ETF 作為參考資產的衍生品合約。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Keurig Dr Pepper, Inc. engages in the manufacture, marketing, distribution, and sales of non-alcoholic beverages. It operates through the following segments: U.S. Refreshment Beverages, U.S. Coffee, and International. The U.S. Refreshment Beverages segment manufactures and distributes beverage concentrates, syrups, and finished beverages including the brands Dr Pepper, Canada Dry, Mott's, Snapple, A&W, 7UP, Sunkist soda, Squirt, Hawaiian Punch, Core Hydration, Bai, C4 Energy, Clamato, Evian, Yoo-Hoo, Big Red, and Vita Coco. The U.S. Coffee segment involves single serve brewers, specialty, hot and iced varieties, and ready-to-drink beverages. The International segment includes sales in Canada, Mexico, and other markets. The company was founded in 2018 and is headquartered in Frisco, TX.
info.description_zh: Keurig Dr Pepper, Inc. 從事非酒精飲料的製造、行銷、分銷和銷售。它透過以下部門運作：美國清涼飲料部門、美國咖啡部門和國際部門。美國清涼飲料部門生產和分銷濃縮飲料、糖漿和成品飲料，包括 Dr Pepper、Canada Dry、Mott's、Snapple、A&W、7UP、Sunkist 蘇打水、Squirt、Hawaiian Punch、Core Hydration、Bai、C4 Energy、Clamato、Evian、Yoo-Hoo、Big Red 和 Cococo 等品牌。美國咖啡部門涉及單杯咖啡、特色咖啡、熱飲和冰飲以及即飲飲料。國際部門包括加拿大、墨西哥和其他市場的銷售。該公司成立於 2018 年，總部位於德克薩斯州弗里斯科。

info.description: F/m Emerald Life Sciences Innovation ETF seeks long-term capital appreciation. The fund is an actively managed exchange-traded fund ("ETF") and invests primarily in equity securities of life science companies selected by Emerald Mutual Fund Advisers Trust, the fund's investment sub-adviser, under the supervision of the adviser. Under normal market conditions, the fund invests at least 80% of its net assets in equity securities issued by life science companies demonstrating innovation.
info.description_zh: F/m Emerald Life Sciences Innovation ETF 尋求長期資本增值。該基金為一檔主動式管理型交易所交易基金（「ETF」），主要投資於該基金的投資副顧問 Emerald Mutual Fund Advisers Trust 選擇的生命科學公司的股本證券，並接受顧問的監督。在正常市場條件下，該基金至少80%的淨資產投資於具有創新能力的生命科學公司發行的股本證券。

info.description: The Progressive Corp. is an insurance holding company, which engages in the provision of personal and commercial auto insurance, residential property insurance, and other specialty property-casualty insurance and related services. It operates through the following segments: Personal Lines and Commercial Lines. The Personal Lines segment includes agency and direct businesses. The Commercial Lines segment writes primary liability and physical damage insurance for automobiles and trucks owned and operated predominately by small businesses in the auto, for-hire transportation, contractor, for-hire specialty, tow, and for-hire livery markets. The company was founded on March 10, 1937 and is headquartered in Mayfield Village, OH.

info.description: Heritage Global, Inc. engages in the provision of corporate and financial asset liquidation transactions, valuations, and advisory services. It operates through the following segments: Auction and Liquidation, Refurbishment and Resale, Brokerage, and Specialty Lending. The Auction and Liquidation segment focuses on operating a global full-service auction, appraisal, and asset advisory firm, including the acquisition of turnkey manufacturing facilities and used industrial machinery and equipment. The Refurbishment and Resale segment acquires, refurbishes, and supplies specialized laboratory equipment. The Brokerage segment manages charged-off receivables in the U.S. and Canada on behalf of financial institutions. The Specialty Lending segment provides specialty financing solutions to investors in charged-off and non-performing asset portfolios. The company was founded in 1937 and is headquartered in San Diego, CA.
info.description_zh: Heritage Global, Inc. 從事提供企業和金融資產清算交易、估值和諮詢服務。它透過以下部門運作：拍賣和清算、翻新和轉售、經紀和專業貸款。拍賣和清算部門​​專注於經營一家全球全方位服務拍賣、評估和資產諮詢公司，包括收購交鑰匙製造設施和二手工業機械和設備。翻新和轉售部門收購、翻新和供應專業實驗室設備。經紀部門代表金融機構管理美國和加拿大的應收帳款。專業貸款部門為沖銷和不良資產組合的投資者提供專業融資解決方案。該公司成立於 1937 年，總部位於加利福尼亞州聖地亞哥。

info.description: Rhinebeck Bancorp, Inc. operates as a bank holding company, which engages in the provision of banking services. It operates through the following segments: Commercial Real Estate, Residential Real Estate, Commercial and Industrial, and Consumer. The Commercial Estate segment is involved in construction, non-residential, and multi-family. The Residential Real Estate Segment focuses on borrower's residential real estate generally in a first lien position. The Commercial and Industrial segment includes loans made for purposes of financing the activities of commercial customers. The Consumer segment engages in indirect automobile loans, home equity loans, and other consumer loans. The company was founded on August 30, 2018 and is headquartered in Poughkeepsie, NY.
info.description_zh: Rhinebeck Bancorp, Inc. 作為一家銀行控股公司運營，提供銀行服務。它透過以下部門運作：商業房地產、住宅房地產、商業和工業以及消費者。商業地產部門涉及建築、非住宅和多戶住宅。住宅房地產部分主要關注借款人的住宅房地產，通常處於第一留置權位置。商業和工業部門包括為商業客戶活動融資而發放的貸款。消費者部門從事間接汽車貸款、房屋淨值貸款和其他消費貸款。該公司成立於2018年8月30日，總部位於紐約州波基普西。

info.description: TG Therapeutics, Inc. engages in the acquisition, development, and commercialization of novel treatments for B-cell malignancies and autoimmune diseases. Its product pipeline includes TG-1501, TG-1701, Ublituximab, and Umbralisib. The company was founded by Michael Sean Weiss and Laurence H. Shaw on May 18, 1993 and is headquartered in Morrisville, NC.
info.description_zh: TG Therapeutics, Inc. 從事 B 細胞惡性腫瘤和自體免疫疾病新型療法的收購、開發和商業化。其產品管線包括TG-1501、TG-1701、Ublituximab和Umbralisib。該公司由 Michael Sean Weiss 和 Laurence H. Shaw 於 1993 年 5 月 18 日創立，總部位於北卡羅來納州莫里斯維爾。

info.description: First Trust Alternative Absolute Return Strategy ETF seeks to provide investors with long-term total return. The fund is an actively managed exchange-traded fund that seeks to achieve long-term total return through long and short investments in exchange-traded commodity futures contracts ("Commodity Futures") through a wholly-owned subsidiary of the fund organized under the laws of the Cayman Islands (the "Subsidiary"). It does not invest directly in Commodity Futures. The advisor gains exposure to these investments exclusively by investing in the Subsidiary. The Subsidiary is advised by First Trust Advisors L.P., the fund's investment advisor.
info.description_zh: First Trust Alternative絕對回報策略ETF旨在為投資者提供長期總回報。該基金是一檔主動管理的交易所交易基金，旨在透過該基金根據開曼群島法律組成的全資子公司（「子公司」）對交易所交易商品期貨合約（「商品期貨」）進行多頭和空頭投資，以實現長期總回報。它不會直接投資於商品期貨。顧問僅透過投資子公司來獲得這些投資的機會。該子公司由該基金的投資顧問 First Trust Advisors L.P. 提供諮詢服務。

info.description: Rivian Automotive, Inc. engages in the design, development, and manufacture of category-defining electric vehicles and accessories. It operates through following segments: Automotive, Software and Services. The company was founded by Robert J. Scaringe in June 2009 and is headquartered in Irvine, CA.
info.description_zh: Rivian Automotive, Inc. 從事定義類別的電動車及配件的設計、開發和製造。它透過以下部門運作：汽車部門、軟體部門和服務部門。該公司由 Robert J. Scaringe 於 2009 年 6 月創立，總部位於加州歐文。

info.description: GraniteShares YieldBOOST MU ETF is an actively managed ETF designed to generate high levels of monthly and weekly income. The fund primarily employs an options-based strategy, selling put options on a leveraged ETF that tracks Micron Technology, Inc. (MU). By selling these options, the fund seeks to capture premium income, with secondary objectives of gaining exposure to the performance of the underlying leveraged ETF, subject to a cap on potential investment gains.

info.description_zh: GraniteShares YieldBOOST MU ETF 是一款主動管理的 ETF，旨在產生高水準的月度和周收入。該基金主要採用基於選擇權的策略，出售追蹤美光科技 (MU) 的槓桿 ETF 的看跌期權。透過出售這些選擇權，該基金尋求獲取溢價收入，次要目標是獲得基礎槓桿 ETF 表現的曝險，但須遵守潛在投資收益的上限。

info.description: PepsiCo, Inc. engages in the manufacture, marketing, distribution, and sale of beverages, food, and snacks. It operates through the following business segments: PepsiCo Foods North America (PFNA), PepsiCo Beverages North America (PBNA), International Beverages Franchise (IB Franchise), Europe, Middle East and Africa (EMEA), Latin America Foods (LatAm Foods), and Asia Pacific Foods. The PFNA segment refers to the food businesses in the United States and Canada. The PBNA segment includes beverage businesses in the United States and Canada. The IB Franchise segment involves the international franchise beverage businesses, as well as the SodaStream business. The EMEA segment pertains to food businesses and beverage businesses with company-owned bottlers in Europe, the Middle East, and Africa. The LatAm Foods segment consists of food businesses in Latin America. The Asia Pacific Foods segment is associated in food businesses in Asia Pacific, including China, Australia and New Zealand, as well as India. The company was founded by Donald M. Kendall, Sr. and Herman W. Lay in 1965 and is headquartered in Purchase, NY.

info.description_zh: 百事可樂公司從事飲料、食品和零食的製造、行銷、分銷和銷售。它透過以下業務部門運作：百事北美食品部 (PFNA)、百事北美飲料部 (PBNA)、國際飲料特許經營部 (IB Franchise)、歐洲、中東和非洲 (EMEA)、拉丁美洲食品部 (LatAm Foods) 和亞太食品部。 PFNA 部分是指美國和加拿大的食品企業。 PBNA 部門包括美國和加拿大的飲料業務。 IB特許經營部門涉及國際特許經營飲料業務以及SodaStream業務。歐洲、中東和非洲部門涉及歐洲、中東和非洲公司自有裝瓶商的食品業務和飲料業務。拉丁美洲食品部門由拉丁美洲的食品企業組成。亞太食品部門涉及亞太地區的食品業務，包括中國、澳洲和紐西蘭以及印度。該公司由 Donald M. Kendall, Sr. 和 Herman W. Lay 於 1965 年創立，總部位於紐約州普切斯。

info.description: Fidelity Managed Futurees ETF seeks capital appreciation. The und advisor seeks to achieve the fund's investment objective by pursuing a strategy intended to capture the persistence of price trends observed across equity, fixed income, currency and commodity markets. The fund's investment strategy utilizes a combination of equity, fixed income, currency and commodity derivatives, as well as certain direct investments, to provide exposure to these markets and price trends. The fund is non-diversified.

info.description: LKQ Corp. engages in the distribution of vehicle products and its parts to repair, maintain, and accessorize automobiles. It operates through the following segments: Wholesale-North America, Europe, and Specialty. The Wholesale-North America segment consists of aftermarket and salvage operations and sells five product types to professional collision and mechanical vehicle repair businesses. The Europe segment offers aftermarket operations. The Specialty segment distributes specialty vehicle aftermarket products and accessories in North America. The company was founded by Donald F. Flynn on February 13, 1998 and is headquartered in Antioch, TN.
info.description_zh: LKQ Corp. 從事汽車產品及其零件的分銷，以維修、保養和裝飾汽車。它透過以下部門運作：北美批發部門、歐洲部門和專業部門。北美批發部門包括售後市場和救助業務，並向專業碰撞和機械車輛維修企業銷售五種產品類型。歐洲部門提供售後業務。特種車輛部門在北美分銷特種車輛售後市場產品和配件。該公司由 Donald F. Flynn 於 1998 年 2 月 13 日創立，總部位於田納西州安提阿。

info.description: Roivant Sciences Ltd. engages in the biopharmaceutical business, which engages in the development of transformative medicine. Its product portfolio includes Vtama, Batoclimab, Brepocitinib, Namilumab, and RVT-2001, which aims to treat psoriasis, atopic dermatitis, thyroid eye disease, and other illnesses. The company was founded by Vivek Ramaswamy on April 7, 2014 and is headquartered in London, the United Kingdom.
info.description_zh: Roivant Sciences Ltd.從事生物製藥業務，致力於變革醫學的開發。其產品組合包括 Vtama、Batoclimab、Brepocitinib、Namilumab 和 RVT-2001，旨在治療牛皮癬、異位性皮膚炎、甲狀腺眼疾和其他疾病。該公司由Vivek Ramaswamy於2014年4月7日創立，總部位於英國倫敦。

info.description: IN8bio, Inc. operates as a clinical stage biopharmaceutical company, which focuses on the discovery, development and commercialization of gamma-delta T cellular therapy product candidates for solid and liquid tumors and gamma-delta T cell engagers for cancer and autoimmune diseases. The company was founded by Lawrence S. Lamb and William T. Ho on February 8, 2016 and is headquartered in New York, NY.
info.description_zh: IN8bio, Inc. 是一家臨床階段生物製藥公司，專注於實體和液體腫瘤的 γ-δ T 細胞治療候選產品以及癌症和自體免疫疾病的 γ-δ T 細胞接合劑的發現、開發和商業化。該公司由 Lawrence S. Lamb 和 William T. Ho 於 2016 年 2 月 8 日創立，總部位於紐約州紐約市。

info.description: Newmark Group, Inc. engages in the provision of commercial real estate services. It offers its services to commercial real estate tenants, investors, owners, occupiers, developers, leasing and corporate advisory, investment sales and real estate finance, consulting, origination and servicing of commercial mortgage loans, valuation, project and development management and property and facility management. The company was founded in 1929 and is headquartered in New York, NY.
info.description_zh: Newmark Group, Inc. 從事提供商業房地產服務。它為商業房地產租戶、投資者、業主、佔用者、開發商、租賃和企業諮詢、投資銷售和房地產金融、商業抵押貸款的諮詢、發放和服務、評估、專案和開發管理以及財產和設施管理提供服務。該公司成立於 1929 年，總部位於紐約州紐約市。

info.description: Deere & Co. engages in the manufacture and distribution of equipment used in agriculture, construction, forestry, and turf care. It operates through the following segments: Agriculture and Turf, Construction and Forestry, and Financial Services. The Agriculture and Turf segment focuses on the distribution and manufacture of a full line of agriculture and turf equipment and related service parts. The Construction and Forestry segment offers machines and service parts used in construction, earthmoving, road building, material handling and timber harvesting. The Financial Services segment finances sales and leases by John Deere dealers of new and used agriculture and turf equipment and construction and forestry equipment. The company was founded by John Deere in 1837 and is headquartered in Moline, IL.

info.description_zh: Deere & Co. 從事農業、建築、林業和草坪護理設備的製造和分銷。它透過以下部門運作：農業和草坪部門、建築和林業部門以及金融服務部門。農業和草坪部門專注於全系列農業和草坪設備及相關服務零件的分銷和製造。建築和林業部門提供用於建築、土方工程、道路建設、材料處理和木材採伐的機器和服務零件。金融服務部門為約翰迪爾經銷商銷售和租賃新的和二手的農業和草坪設備以及建築和林業設備提供融資。該公司由約翰迪爾於 1837 年創立，總部位於伊利諾伊州莫林。

info.description: Instil Bio, Inc. is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company, which engages in developing a cell therapy pipeline of autologous tumor infiltrating lymphocyte therapies for the treatment of patients with cancer. The company was founded in August 2018 and is headquartered in Dallas, TX.

info.description: Lumexa Imaging Holdings, Inc. engages in providing diagnostic imaging services. It focuses on its teleradiology platform, Connexia. It operates through the Outpatient Imaging Centers (Outpatient) and Professional Services (Professional) segments. The Outpatient segment performs imaging studies and provides radiologists' interpretations of those studies. The Professional segment relates to the interpretation of imaging studies. The company was founded on November 14, 2025 and is headquartered in NC, Raleigh.
info.description_zh: Lumexa Imaging Holdings, Inc. 從事提供診斷影像服務。它專注於其遠端放射學平台 Connexia。它透過門診影像中心（門診）和專業服務（專業）部門運作。門診部分進行影像學研究並提供放射科醫師對這些研究的解釋。專業部分涉及影像研究的解釋。該公司成立於2025年11月14日，總部位於北卡羅來納州羅利。

info.description: FirstCash Holdings, Inc. operates retail pawn stores in the United States and Latin America. Its pawn stores lend money on the collateral of pledged personal property, including jewelry, electronics, tools, appliances, sporting goods, and musical instruments, and retails merchandise acquired through collateral forfeitures on forfeited pawn loans and over-the-counter purchases of merchandise directly from customers. The firm is also involved in melting scrap jewelry, as well as selling gold, silver, and diamonds in commodity markets. The company was founded in 1988 and is headquartered in Fort Worth, Texas.

info.description_zh: FirstCash Holdings, Inc. 在美國和拉丁美洲經營零售當舖。 Its pawn stores lend money on the collateral of pledged personal property, including jewelry, electronics, tools, appliances, sporting goods, and musical instruments, and retails merchand？ purchases of merchandise directly from customers.該公司也參與熔化廢珠寶，以及在商品市場上銷售金、銀和鑽石。該公司成立於 1988 年，總部位於德克薩斯州沃思堡。

info.description: Aurinia Pharmaceuticals, Inc. is a clinical stage bio-pharmaceutical company, which engages in the research, development, and commercialization of therapeutic drugs. The company was founded by Robert Foster, Richard Glickman, and Michael Martin on June 16, 1993 and is headquartered in Edmonton, Canada.
info.description_zh: Aurinia Pharmaceuticals, Inc.是一家臨床階段生物製藥公司，從事治療藥物的研究、開發和商業化。該公司由 Robert Foster、Richard Glickman 和 Michael Martin 於 1993 年 6 月 16 日創立，總部位於加拿大埃德蒙頓。

info.description: Tesla, Inc. engages in the design, development, manufacture, and sale of electric vehicles and energy generation and storage systems. It operates through the Automotive and Energy Generation and Storage segments. The Automotive segment includes the design, development, manufacture, sale, and lease of electric vehicles as well as sales of automotive regulatory credits. The Energy Generation and Storage segment is involved in the design, manufacture, installation, sale, and lease of solar energy generation, energy storage products, and related services and sales of solar energy systems incentives. The company was founded by Jeffrey B. Straubel, Elon Reeve Musk, Martin Eberhard, and Marc Tarpenning on July 1, 2003 and is headquartered in Austin, TX.
info.description_zh: Tesla, Inc. 從事電動車以及能源產生和儲存系統的設計、開發、製造和銷售。它透過汽車、能源生產和儲存部門運作。汽車部門包括電動車的設計、開發、製造、銷售和租賃以及汽車監管積分的銷售。能源發電和儲存部門從事太陽能發電、儲能產品的設計、製造、安裝、銷售和租賃，以及太陽能係統激勵措施的相關服務和銷售。該公司由 Jeffrey B. Straubel、Elon Reeve Musk、Martin Eberhard 和 Marc Tarpenning 於 2003 年 7 月 1 日創立，總部位於德克薩斯州奧斯汀。

info.description: Halliburton Co. engages in the provision of products and services to the energy industry. It operates through the Completion and Production, and Drilling and Evaluation segments. The Completion and Production segment focuses on cementing, stimulation, specialty chemicals, intervention, pressure control, artificial lift, and completion products and services. The Drilling and Evaluation segment provides field and reservoir modeling, drilling, fluids, evaluation, and wellbore placement solutions that enable customers to model, measure, drill, and optimize well construction activities. The company was founded by Erle P. Halliburton in 1919 and is headquartered in Houston, TX.
info.industry_zh: 石油和天然氣設備與服務
info.description_zh: 哈里伯頓公司從事為能源產業提供產品和服務。它透過完井和生產以及鑽井和評估部門運作。完井和生產部門專注於固井、增產、特殊化學品、幹預、壓力控制、人工舉升以及完井產品和服務。鑽井和評估部門提供現場和油藏建模、鑽井、流體、評估和井眼佈置解決方案，使客戶能夠建模、測量、鑽井和優化建井活動。該公司由 Erle P. Halliburton 於 1919 年創立，總部位於德克薩斯州休斯頓。

info.description: Eli Lilly & Co. engages in the discovery, development, manufacture, and sale of pharmaceutical products. The firm's products include diabetes, oncology, immunology, neuroscience, and other products and therapies. The company was founded by Eli Lilly on May 10, 1876 and is headquartered in Indianapolis, IN.
info.description_zh: 禮來公司 (Eli Lilly & Co.) 從事醫藥產品的發現、開發、製造和銷售。該公司的產品包括糖尿病、腫瘤學、免疫學、神經科學以及其他產品和療法。該公司由禮來公司於 1876 年 5 月 10 日創立，總部位於印第安納州印第安納波利斯。

info.description: Targa Resources Corp. engages in the business of gathering, compressing, treating, processing, transporting, and purchasing and selling natural gas. It operates through the following segments: Gathering and Processing, and Logistics and Transportation, and Other. The Gathering and Processing segment includes assets used in the gathering, and purchase and sale of natural gas produced from oil and gas wells. The Logistics and Transportation segment refers to the activities and assets necessary to convert mixed natural gas liquids (NGLs) into NGL products. The Other contains the results of commodity derivative activity mark-to-market gains and losses related to derivative contracts. The company was founded on October 27, 2005 and is headquartered in Houston, TX.
info.description_zh: Targa Resources Corp. 從事天然氣採集、壓縮、處理、加工、運輸以及採購和銷售業務。它透過以下部門運作：收集和加工部門、物流和運輸部門以及其他部門。收集和加工部門包括用於收集、購買和銷售石油和天然氣井生產的天然氣的資產。物流和運輸部門是指將混合天然氣液體（NGL）轉化為 NGL 產品所需的活動和資產。其他包含與衍生性商品合約相關的商品衍生性商品活動以市價計價的損益結果。該公司成立於2005年10月27日，總部位於德州休士頓。

info.description: Sphere 3D Corp. is a bitcoin mining company. The firm is engaged in growing its digital asset mining operation through the capital-efficient procurement of next-generation mining equipment and partnering with data center operators. Its bitcoin mining business segment involves acquiring computer servers, which operate application-specific integrated circuit chips designed specifically to mine bitcoin, and deploy, such miners at-scale utilizing its hosting agreements. The company was founded on May 2, 2007 and is headquartered in Stamford, CT.
info.description_zh: Sphere 3D Corp. 是一家比特幣挖礦公司。該公司致力於透過資本高效的下一代採礦設備採購以及與資料中心營運商合作來發展其數位資產採礦業務。其比特幣挖礦業務部門涉及收購電腦伺服器，這些伺服器運行專門為挖掘比特幣而設計的專用集成電路晶片，並利用其託管協議大規模部署此類礦機。該公司成立於2007年5月2日，總部位於康乃狄克州斯坦福。

info.description: GraniteShares 1.25x Long Tsla Daily ETF seeks daily investment results, before fees and expenses, of 1.25 times (125%) the daily percentage change of the common stock of Tesla Inc. The fund is an actively managed etf that attempts to replicate 1.25 times (125%) the daily percentage change of the underlying stock by entering into a swap agreement on the underlying stock. The adviser will enter into one or more swap agreements with major financial institutions for a specified period ranging from a day to more than one year whereby the adviser and the financial institution will agree to exchange the return earned or realized on the underling stock. It is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: GraniteShares 1.25x Long Tsla Daily ETF 尋求未計費用和開支之前的每日投資結果，為特斯拉公司普通股每日百分比變化的 1.25 倍 (125%)。該基金是一檔主動管理的 ETF，試圖透過簽訂標的股票掉期協議來複製標的股票每日百分比變化的 1.25 倍 (125%)。顧問將與主要金融機構簽訂一項或多項互換協議，期限從一天到一年以上不等，顧問和金融機構將同意交換標的股票賺取或實現的回報。它是非多元化的。

info.description: Upstream Bio, Inc. is a clinical-stage biotechnology company, which engages in the development of treatments for inflammatory diseases, with an initial focus on severe respiratory disorders. It develops verekitug, the only known antagonist currently in clinical development that targets the receptor for Thymic Stromal Lymphopoietin. The company was founded in April 2021 and is headquartered in Waltham, MA.
info.description_zh: Upstream Bio, Inc.是一家臨床階段的生物技術公司，致力於開發發炎性疾病的治療方法，最初專注於嚴重的呼吸系統疾病。它開發了 verekitug，這是目前臨床開發中唯一已知的針對胸腺基質淋巴細胞生成素受體的拮抗劑。該公司成立於 2021 年 4 月，總部位於馬薩諸塞州沃爾瑟姆。

info.description: Methanex Corp. engages in the production and supply of methanol. The firm supplies in the international markets such as North America, Asia Pacific, Europe, and South America. It also operates the methanol ocean tanker fleet. The company was founded on March 11, 1968 and is headquartered in Vancouver, Canada.
info.description_zh: Macetex Corp. 從事甲醇的生產和供應。該公司向北美、亞太地區、歐洲和南美等國際市場供貨。它還經營甲醇遠洋油輪船隊。該公司成立於1968年3月11日，總部位於加拿大溫哥華。

info.description: Adicet Bio, Inc. is a clinical stage biotechnology company, which engages in discovering and developing allogeneic gamma delta T cell therapies for cancer. It also focuses on developing a pipeline of "off-the-shelf" gamma delta T cells. The company was founded by Aya Jakobovits in November 2014 and is headquartered in Boston, MA.
info.description_zh: Adicet Bio, Inc. 是一家臨床階段生物技術公司，致力於發現和開發癌症同種異體 γ δ T 細胞療法。它還專注於開發一系列「現成」的 γ δ T 細胞。該公司由 Aya Jakobovits 於 2014 年 11 月創立，總部位於馬薩諸塞州波士頓。

info.description: Corvus Pharmaceuticals, Inc. engages in the development of product candidates for the treatment of cancer and immune-mediated and inflammatory diseases. Its product candidates include soquelitinib, an ITK inhibitor, ciforadenant, an adenosine A2A receptor antagonist, and mupadolimab, a B cell-activating anti-CD73 antibody. The company was founded by Richard A. Miller, Peter A. Thompson, Joseph J. Buggy, and Erik Verner on January 27, 2014 and is headquartered in South San Francisco, CA.
info.description_zh: Corvus Pharmaceuticals, Inc. 致力於開發治療癌症、免疫介導疾病和發炎性疾病的候選產品。其候選產品包括ITK抑制劑soquelitinib、腺苷A2A受體拮抗劑ciforadenan和B細胞活化抗CD73抗體mupadolimab。該公司由 Richard A. Miller、Peter A. Thompson、Joseph J. Buggy 和 Erik Verner 於 2014 年 1 月 27 日創立，總部位於加州南舊金山。

info.description: WeRide, Inc. operates as an investment holding company. It engages in the sale of autonomous driving vehicles, primarily including robobuses, robotaxis, robosweepers and related sensor suites. The company was founded by Tony Xu Han and Yan Li in February 2017 and is headquartered in Guangzhou, China.
info.description_zh: 文遠知行文遠知行以投資控股公司經營。它從事自動駕駛車輛的銷售，主要包括機器人公車、機器人計程車、機器人掃地機和相關感測器套件。該公司由Tony Xu Han和Yan Li於2017年2月創立，總部位於中國廣州。

info.description: Reliance Global Group, Inc. is a diversified company, which engages in the business of insurance market and other relates sectors. It focuses on acquisition strategy, wholesale, and retail insurance agencies. The company was founded on August 2, 2013 and is headquartered in Lakewood, NJ.
info.description_zh: Reliance Global Group, Inc.是一家多元化公司，從事保險市場及其他相關行業的業務。它專注於收購策略、批發和零售保險機構。該公司成立於2013年8月2日，總部位於新澤西州萊克伍德。

info.description: Leverage Shares 2X Long PBR Daily ETF seeks daily levered investment results, before fees and expenses, of two times (200%) of the daily percentage change in the price of the ADR of PBR. The fund is an actively managed ETF. The fund invests at least 80% of its net assets (plus borrowings for investment purposes) in the Underlying Security and financial instruments with economic characteristics that, in combination, provide 200% daily leveraged exposure to the price of PBR, consistent with the fund's investment objective. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: 槓桿股票 2 倍多頭 PBR 每日 ETF 尋求每日槓桿投資結果（未計費用和開支）為 PBR ADR 價格每日百分比變化的兩倍 (200%)。該基金是主動式管理ETF。該基金將至少 80% 的淨資產（加上用於投資目的的借款）投資於標的證券和具有經濟特徵的金融工具，這些金融工具結合起來提供 PBR 價格的 200% 每日槓桿敞口，這與基金的投資目標一致。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Nanobiotix SA is a late-stage biotechnology company, which engages in the development of therapeutic approaches to the treatment of cancer. Its technologies include NanoXray that improves the efficacy of radiation therapy against tumor cells. The company was founded by Laurent Levy and Abdel Kader Boussaha on March 4, 2003 and is headquartered in Paris, France.
info.description_zh: Nanobiotix SA 是一家後期生物技術公司，致力於開發癌症治療方法。其技術包括 NanoXray，可提高放射治療對腫瘤細胞的功效。該公司由Laurent Levy和Abdel Kader Boussaha於2003年3月4日創立，總部位於法國巴黎。

info.description: Direxion Daily MRVL Bull 2X ETF is an aggressively managed single-stock leveraged exchange-traded fund that seeks daily investment results, before fees and expenses, of 200% of the daily price performance of the common shares of Marvell Technology, Inc. The fund is designed as a tactical tool for sophisticated investors to amplify short-term bullish views on a leading designer of infrastructure semiconductor solutions through the use of financial derivative instruments, requiring active daily monitoring due to the effects of compounding and leverage.
info.description_zh: Direxion Daily MRVL Bull 2X ETF 是一款積極管理的單股槓桿交易所交易基金，尋求 Marvell Technology, Inc. 普通股每日價格表現 200% 的每日投資結果（扣除費用和開支）。該基金被設計為成熟投資者的戰術工具，透過使用金融衍生工具來放大對基礎設施半導體解決方案領先設計商的短期看漲觀點，由於複利和槓桿的影響，需要進行主動日常監控。

info.description: AIR Global Plc engages in the provision of branded flavored molasses (commonly known as "hookah", "shisha" or "mu'assel"), a tobacco-based mixture that is commonly around 15% to 25% tobacco by weight and typically inhaled via a water pipe. It operates through the following segments: Core-Americas, Core-Europe, Core-Middle East, Africa, and Asia (MEAA), and New Growth Categories. The Core-Americas segment Includes the production and sale of traditional shisha tobacco and other non-New Growth Categories ("non-NGC") brands, distributed in the Americas through wholesale, retail, and direct-to-consumer channels. The Core-Europe segment refers to the production and sale of traditional shisha tobacco under the Al Fakher and other non-NGC brands, distributed throughout Europe through wholesale, retail, and direct-to-consumer channels. The Core-Middle East, Africa, and Asia segment focuses on the the production and sale of traditional shisha tobacco under the Al Fakher and other non-NGC brands, distributed throughout the Middle East through wholesale, retail, and direct-to-consumer channels. The New Growth Categories segment covers the Group's offering under the OOKA brand (including proprietary devices and related consumables), modern oral nicotine pouches, and both nicotine and non-nicotine inhalation devices under the VANT and Crown Switch brands. The company was founded on October 28, 2025 and is headquartered in Dubai, United Arab Emirates.
info.description_zh: AIR Global Plc 從事品牌風味糖蜜（通常稱為「水煙」、「水煙」或「mu'assel」）的供應，這是一種基於菸草的混合物，通常含有約 15% 至 25% 的菸草重量，通常透過水管吸入。它透過以下部門運作：核心美洲部門、核心歐洲部門、核心中東、非洲和亞洲部門 (MEAA) 以及新增長類別部門。核心美洲部門包括傳統水煙菸草和其他非新增長類別（「非NGC」）品牌的生產和銷售，透過批發、零售和直接面向消費者的管道在美洲分銷。核心歐洲部門是指生產和銷售 Al Fakher 和其他非 NGC 品牌的傳統水煙，透過批發、零售和直接面向消費者的管道分銷到整個歐洲。核心中東、非洲和亞洲部門專注於生產和銷售 Al Fakher 和其他非 NGC 品牌的傳統水煙，透過批發、零售和直接面向消費者的管道分銷到整個中東地區。新成長類別部門涵蓋集團以 OOKA 品牌提供的產品（包括專有設備和相關消耗品）、現代口服尼古丁袋，以及 VANT 和 Crown Switch 品牌下的尼古丁和非尼古丁吸入設備。該公司成立於2025年10月28日，總部位於阿拉伯聯合大公國杜拜。

info.description: Eva Live, Inc. engages in the entertainment, publishing, and interactive industries through its subsidiaries. Its operations include motion picture production, acquisition, and distribution, television production, acquisition, and distribution, digital content creation and distribution, and development of new entertainment products, services, and technologies on various platforms. The company was founded by David Boulette on August 27, 2002 and is headquartered in Las Vegas, NV.
info.description_zh: Eva Live, Inc. 透過其子公司從事娛樂、出版和互動產業。其業務包括電影製作、收購和發行、電視製作、收購和發行、數位內容創作和發行，以及在各種平台上開發新的娛樂產品、服務和技術。該公司由 David Boulette 於 2002 年 8 月 27 日創立，總部位於內華達州拉斯維加斯。

info.description: The9 Ltd. is engaged in the operation of online games. It operates through Cryptocurrency Mining, and Corporate and Others segments. The company was founded by Jun Zhu on December 22, 1999, and is headquartered in Shanghai, China.
info.description_zh: 九城有限公司從事網路遊戲營運。它透過加密貨幣挖礦、企業及其他部門運作。該公司由朱駿於1999年12月22日創立，總部位於中國上海。

info.description: RF Acquisition Corp. II operates as a blank check company. It was formed for the purpose of effecting a merger, capital stock exchange, asset acquisition, stock purchase, reorganization or similar business combination with one or more businesses. The company was founded on February 5, 2024, and is headquartered in Singapore.
info.description_zh: RF Acquisition Corp. II 作為一家空白支票公司運作。它的成立目的是與一個或多個企業進行合併、股本交換、資產收購、股票購買、重組或類似的業務合併。該公司成立於2024年2月5日，總部位於新加坡。

info.description: BTC Digital Ltd. is a blockchain technology company, with a long-term strategy to create value across the metaverse, blockchain and cryptocurrency mining industry. The company was founded by Yu Peng Guo in April 2006 and is headquartered in Singapore.
info.description_zh: BTC Digital Ltd.是一家區塊鏈技術公司，其長期戰略是在元宇宙、區塊鏈和加密貨幣挖礦行業創造價值。該公司由郭於鵬於2006年4月創立，總部位於新加坡。

info.description: CID Holdco, Inc. operates as an investment holding company. The firm through its subsidiary offers a differentiated asset tracking and workflow management solution for operations intensive enterprises. It helps businesses digitally transform their operations using IoT and AI technology. The company is headquartered in Las Vegas, NV.

info.description: Canaan, Inc. is a holding company, which engages in developing and selling Bitcoin mining machines and related services. It focuses on the development of green mining. The company was founded by Jia Xuan Li, Xiang Fu Liu and Nan Geng Zhang on January 19, 2013 and is headquartered in Singapore.
info.description_zh: Canaan, Inc.是一家控股公司，從事開發和銷售比特幣礦機及相關服務。重點發展綠色礦業。該公司由李嘉軒、劉向福和張南庚於2013年1月19日創立，總部位於新加坡。

info.description: DeFi Development Corp. provides business and commercial property financing services. It provides technology that connects commercial mortgage borrowers looking for debt to refinance, build, or buy commercial property including apartment buildings to commercial property lenders (including banks, credit unions, REITs, debt funds, and more) looking to deploy capital into commercial mortgages. The company was founded by Blake E. Janover on November 28, 2018 and is headquartered in Boca Raton, FL.
info.description_zh: DeFi Development Corp. 提供商業和商業房地產融資服務。它提供的技術將尋求債務再融資、建造或購買商業房地產（包括公寓大樓）的商業抵押貸款借款人與尋求將資本配置到商業抵押貸款的商業房地產貸款人（包括銀行、信用合作社、房地產投資信託基金、債務基金等）聯繫起來。該公司由 Blake E. Janover 於 2018 年 11 月 28 日創立，總部位於佛羅裡達州博卡拉頓。

info.description: ZeroStack Corp. engages in the production of organic cannabis and pharmaceutical-grade medical products. It operates through the House of Brands and Commercial and Wholesale segments. The House of Brands segment includes multiple categories including food and beverage, nutraceuticals, cannabis accessories and technology, personal care and wellness. The Commercial and Wholesale segment includes distribution of pharmaceutical products to international markets. The company was founded on March 13, 2019 and is headquartered in Toronto, Canada.
info.description_zh: ZeroStack Corp. 從事有機大麻和醫藥級醫療產品的生產。它透過品牌之家以及商業和批發部門運作。 House of Brands 部門包括多個類別，包括食品和飲料、營養保健品、大麻配件和技術、個人護理和健康。商業和批發部門包括向國際市場分銷藥品。該公司成立於2019年3月13日，總部位於加拿大多倫多。

info.description: Hyperliquid Strategies, Inc. is a holding and operating company, which engages in the business of crypto asset management. The firm operates as a digital asset treasury company which focuses on the Hyperliquid ecosystem. The company was founded on July 2, 2025 and is headquartered in New York, NY.
info.description_zh: Hyperliquid Strategies, Inc.是一家控股和營運公司，從事加密資產管理業務。該公司是一家專注於 Hyperliquid 生態系統的數位資產財務公司。該公司成立於2025年7月2日，總部位於紐約州紐約。

info.description: AI Financial Corp. is a fintech company which engages in blockchain-powered technologies for digital asset trading, payments processing and related payment card services. It provides regulated institutional-grade Crypto-as-a-Service infrastructure for the digital asset economy. The company was founded by Edward R. Cameron in 1976 and is headquartered in Las Vegas, NV.
info.description_zh: AI Financial Corp.是一家金融科技公司，從事數位資產交易、支付處理和相關支付卡服務的區塊鏈技術。它為數位資產經濟提供受監管的機構級加密即服務基礎設施。該公司由 Edward R. Cameron 於 1976 年創立，總部位於內華達州拉斯維加斯。

info.description: PS International Group Ltd. engages in providing logistics and supply chain solutions. The company was founded on September 12, 2023 and is headquartered in Hong Kong.
info.description_zh: PS International Group Ltd. 致力於提供物流和供應鏈解決方案。該公司成立於2023年9月12日，總部位於香港。

info.description: Generate Biomedicines, Inc. is a clinical-stage generative biology company pioneering the AI revolution in biotechnology and drug design and development. The company was founded in 2018, and is headquartered in Somerville, MA.
info.description_zh: Generate Biomedicines, Inc. 是一家臨床階段的生成生物學公司，引領生物技術和藥物設計與開發領域的人工智慧革命。該公司成立於 2018 年，總部位於馬薩諸塞州薩默維爾。

info.description: 21Shares 2x Long Dogecoin ETF seeks daily investment results, before fees and expenses, that correspond to two times (2x) the daily price performance of DOGE. Under normal circumstances, the fund will invest at least 80% of the fund's assets in, or provide exposure equal to, financial instruments that the Adviser and Sub-Adviser believe, in combination, should produce daily returns consistent with the fund's investment objective of seeking daily investment results, before fees and expenses, that correspond to two times (2x) the daily price performance of DOGE. The fund does not invest directly in DOGE. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: 21Shares 2x 多吉幣 ETF 尋求每日投資結果（扣除費用和開支），相當於 DOGE 每日價格表現的兩倍 (2x)。在正常情況下，基金將至少 80% 的基金資產投資於顧問和副顧問認為組合起來應產生與基金的投資目標一致的每日回報（不包括費用和開支）的金融工具，或提供相當於 DOGE 每日價格表現兩倍 (2x) 的每日投資結果（扣除費用和開支）。該基金不直接投資於 DOGE。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: BTCS, Inc. is a blockchain technology company. Its operations include Validator Node Operations, Block Building, and Decentralized Finance Operations. The company was founded by Timothy Sidie and Michal Handerhan on April 15, 2008 and is headquartered in Wayne, PA.
info.description_zh: BTCS, Inc.是一家區塊鏈技術公司。其營運包括驗證節點運營、區塊構建和去中心化金融運營。該公司由 Timothy Sidie 和 Michal Handerhan 於 2008 年 4 月 15 日創立，總部位於賓夕法尼亞州韋恩。

info.description: The Real Brokerage, Inc. engages in the provision of real estate brokerage services. It operates through the following segments: North American Brokerage, One Real Title, One Real Mortgage, and Real Wallet. The North American Brokerage segment generates revenue by processing real estate transactions which entitles the company to commissions. The One Real Title segment manages title insurance and closing services for residential and commercial transactions. The One Real Mortgage segment deals with mortgage transactions between borrowers and lenders. The Real Wallet segment offers interchange fees on company branded debit cards, interest income on certain deposit accounts, and interest income and various fees associated with credit lines. The company was founded by Tamir Poleg, Yuval Niv, and Gal Weiss on June 26, 2014 and is headquartered in Miami, FL.
info.description_zh: The Real Brokerage, Inc. 從事提供房地產經紀服務。它透過以下部門運作：北美經紀部門、One Real Title、One Real Mortgage 和 Real Wallet。北美經紀部門透過處理房地產交易產生收入，該交易使公司有權獲得佣金。 One Real Title 部門管理住宅和商業交易的產權保險和結算服務。 One Real Mortgage 部門處理借款人和貸方之間的抵押交易。 Real Wallet 部門提供公司品牌金融卡的交換費、某些存款帳戶的利息收入以及利息收入和與信用額度相關的各種費用。該公司由 Tamir Poleg、Yuval Niv 和 Gal Weiss 於 2014 年 6 月 26 日創立，總部位於佛羅裡達州邁阿密。

info.description: Aprea Therapeutics, Inc. is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company, which engages in the provision of cancer therapeutics. It is involved in the development and commercialization of novel cancer therapeutics that reactivate mutant p53 tumor suppressor protein. The company was founded by Vladimir Bykov, Klas Gota Wiman, Staffan Stromblad, Natalia Issaeva, Galina Selivanova, and Wen Jie Bao in 2002 and is headquartered in Doylestown, PA.

info.description_zh: Aprea Therapeutics, Inc.是一家臨床階段的生物製藥公司，從事提供癌症治療藥物。它參與重新活化突變型 p53 腫瘤抑制蛋白的新型癌症療法的開發和商業化。該公司由 Vladimir Bykov、Klas Gota Wiman、Staffan Stromblad、Natalia Issaeva、Galina Selivanova 和 Wen Jie Bao 於 2002 年創立，總部位於賓夕法尼亞州多伊爾斯敦。

info.description: eXoZymes, Inc. is a development stage synthetic biochemical company. Its synthetic biology platform would enable the scalable exploration of many molecules and properties found in nature. The company was founded by Tyler Korman and Paul Opgenorth in April 2019 and is headquartered in Monrovia, NV.
info.description_zh: eXoZymes, Inc. 是一家處於發展階段的合成生化公司。其合成生物學平台將使對自然界中發現的許多分子和特性的可擴展探索成為可能。該公司由 Tyler Korman 和 Paul Opgenorth 於 2019 年 4 月創立，總部位於內華達州蒙羅維亞。

info.description: Grayscale Hyperliquid Staking ETF is a passively managed exchange-traded product that is solely and passively invested in HYPE, the native token of the Hyperliquid blockchain protocol, aiming to reflect the value of the token held by the fund less expenses and liabilities. The strategy provides direct single-asset crypto exposure in an exchange-traded product wrapper, including capturing potential native protocol staking rewards generated by the underlying digital asset.
info.description_zh: Grayscale Hyperliquid Stake ETF 是一種被動管理的交易所交易產品，單獨被動投資於 Hyperliquid 區塊鏈協議的原生代幣 HYPE，旨在反映基金持有的代幣減去費用和負債後的價值。該策略在交易所交易產品包裝器中提供直接的單一資產加密貨幣敞口，包括捕獲基礎數位資產產生的潛在本機協議質押獎勵。

info.description: Leverage Shares 2X Long COIN Daily ETF seeks daily levered investment results, before fees and expenses, of two times (200%) of the daily percentage change in the price of the common stock of COIN. The fund is an actively managed ETF. It invests at least 80% of its net assets (plus borrowings for investment purposes) in financial instruments with economic characteristics, that, in combination, provide 200% daily leveraged exposure to COIN, consistent with the fund's investment objective. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: 槓桿股份 2 倍多頭 COIN 每日 ETF 尋求每日槓桿投資結果（未計費用和開支）為 COIN 普通股價格每日百分比變化的兩倍 (200%)。該基金是主動式管理ETF。它將至少 80% 的淨資產（加上用於投資目的的借款）投資於具有經濟特徵的金融工具，這些金融工具組合起來可提供 200% 的 COIN 每日槓桿敞口，這與基金的投資目標一致。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: GraniteShares 1.5x Long COIN Daily ETF seeks daily investment results, before fees and expenses, of 1.5 times (150%) the daily percentage change of the common stock of Coinbase Global, Inc. Class A. The fund is a passively managed etf that attempts to replicate 1.5 times (150%) the daily percentage change the underlying stock by entering into a swap agreement on the underlying stock. The adviser will enter into one or more swap agreements with major financial institutions for a specified period ranging from a day to more than one year whereby the adviser and the financial institution will agree to exchange the return earned or realized on the underlying stock. It is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: GraniteShares 1.5 倍多頭 COIN 每日 ETF 尋求未計費用和開支的每日投資結果，為 Coinbase Global, Inc. A 類普通股每日百分比變化的 1.5 倍 (150%)。該基金是被動管理的 ETF，試圖透過簽訂標的股票掉期協議來複製標的股票每日百分比變化的 1.5 倍 (150%)。顧問將與主要金融機構簽訂一項或多項互換協議，期限從一天到一年以上不等，顧問和金融機構將同意交換標的股票賺取或實現的回報。它是非多元化的。

info.description: Strategy, Inc. engages in the development of fixed-income instruments that provide investors varying degrees of economic exposure to bitcoin. It executes bitcoin acquisition, capital management, and capital markets strategies. The company was founded by Michael J. Saylor and Sanjeev K. Bansal on November 17, 1989, and is headquartered in Tysons Corner, VA.
info.description_zh: Strategy, Inc. 致力於開發固定收益工具，為投資者提供不同程度的比特幣經濟風險。它執行比特幣收購、資本管理和資本市場策略。該公司由 Michael J. Saylor 和 Sanjeev K. Bansal 於 1989 年 11 月 17 日創立，總部位於維吉尼亞州泰森斯角。

info.description: InflaRx NV is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company, which engages in the discovery and development of inhibitors of the complement activation factor known as C5a and its receptor C5aR. Its primary product candidate is Vilobelimab. The company was founded by Niels Christoph Riedemann, Renfeng Guo, and Nicolas Fulpius in December 2007 and is headquartered in Jena, Germany.
info.description_zh: InflaRx NV 是一家臨床階段的生物製藥公司，致力於補體活化因子 C5a 及其受體 C5aR 抑制劑的發現和開發。其主要候選產品為 Vilobelimab。該公司由 Niels Christoph Riedemann、RenfengGuo 和 Nicolas Fulpius 於 2007 年 12 月創立，總部位於德國耶拿。

info.description: 21Shares 2x Long Sui ETF seeks daily investment results, before fees and expenses, that correspond to two times (2x) the daily price performance of SUI. Under normal circumstances, the fund will invest at least 80% of the fund's assets in, or provide exposure equal to, financial instruments that the Adviser and Sub-Adviser believe, in combination, should produce daily returns consistent with the fund's investment objective of seeking daily investment results, before fees and expenses, that correspond to two times (2x) the daily price performance of SUI. The fund does not invest directly in SUI. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: 21Shares 2x Long Sui ETF 尋求每日投資結果（扣除費用和開支），相當於 SUI 每日價格表現的兩倍 (2x)。在正常情況下，基金將至少 80% 的基金資產投資於顧問和副顧問認為組合起來應產生與基金的投資目標一致的每日回報（不包括費用和開支）的金融工具，或提供相當於 SUI 每日價格表現兩倍 (2x) 的每日投資結果（扣除費用和開支）。該基金不直接投資於 SUI。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Beam Global provides sustainable products and technologies for electric vehicle (EV) charging, energy storage, energy security and outdoor media. It develops, patents, designs, engineers and manufactures unique and advanced clean mobility solutions that protect the environment, save customers time and money, empower communities and keep people moving. The firm's core platforms include Beam EV ARC and Solar Tree sustainable EV charging systems, Beam AllCell high-performance energy storage solutions, energy resiliency and disaster preparedness products and a deep patent library. The company was founded by Robert Lane Noble on June 12, 2006 and is headquartered in San Diego, CA.
info.description_zh: Beam Global 為電動車 (EV) 充電、能源儲存、能源安全和戶外媒體提供永續產品和技術。它開發、專利、設計、工程和製造獨特且先進的清潔行動解決方案，以保護環境、節省客戶時間和金錢、增強社區能力並讓人們繼續旅行。該公司的核心平台包括 Beam EV ARC 和 Solar Tree 永續電動車充電系統、Beam AllCell 高性能儲能解決方案、能源彈性和備災產品以及深厚的專利庫。該公司由 Robert Lane Noble 於 2006 年 6 月 12 日創立，總部位於加州聖地牙哥。

info.description: Hyperion DeFi, Inc. is a long-term strategic treasury of Hyperliquid's native token HYPE. The firm provides investors with streamlined access to the Hyperliquid ecosystem and is also developing its proprietary Optejet user-filled device, designed for use with a variety of topical ophthalmic liquids, including artificial tears and lens rewetting products. It operates through the following segments: Ophthalmic Technology and Digital Assets. The Ophthalmic Technology segment focuses on developing eye-care devices and delivery systems for ophthalmic liquids. The Digital Assets segment focuses on managing a strategic treasury of blockchain-based assets and exposure to the Hyperliquid ecosystem. The company was founded by Sean Ianchulev on March 12, 2014 and is headquartered in Laguna Hills, CA.
info.description_zh: Hyperion DeFi, Inc. 是 Hyperliquid 原生代幣 HYPE 的長期策略金庫。該公司為投資者提供了進入 Hyperliquid 生態系統的簡化途徑，並且還在開發其專有的 Optejet 用戶填充設備，該設備設計用於各種局部眼科液體，包括人工淚液和鏡片再潤濕產品。它透過以下部門運作：眼科技術部門和數位資產部門。眼科技術部門專注於開發眼科護理設備和眼科液體輸送系統。數位資產部門專注於管理基於區塊鏈的資產的策略金庫以及對 Hyperliquid 生態系統的投資。該公司由 Sean Ianchulev 於 2014 年 3 月 12 日創立，總部位於加利福尼亞州拉古納山。

info.description: NIP Group, Inc. is a digital entertainment company, which engages in the growing global audience of gaming and esports fans. It operates through the PRC and Other Subsidiaries and Ninjas in Pyjamas segments. It includes talent management, event production, hospitality, and game publishing businesses. It has operations in Sweden, China, Abu Dhabi, and Brazil, and its esports rosters participate across multiple game titles. The company was founded by Yau Kwan Ho and Hicham Chahine on February 5, 2021 and is headquartered in Stockholm, Sweden.
info.description_zh: NIP Group, Inc. 是一家數位娛樂公司，面向全球不斷成長的遊戲和電競粉絲群。它透過中國及其他子公司和Ninjas in Pyjamas 部門運作。它包括人才管理、活動製作、酒店和遊戲發行業務。該公司在瑞典、中國、阿布達比和巴西都有業務，其電子競技陣容參與了多種遊戲。該公司由 Yau Kwan Ho 和 Hicham Chahine 於 2021 年 2 月 5 日創立，總部位於瑞典斯德哥爾摩。

info.description: Precipio, Inc.is a cancer diagnostics and reagent technology company, which provides diagnostic products and services to the oncology market. It operates through the following business divisions: Pathology Services and Products. The Pathology Services division provides specialized cancer diagnostic testing services to physicians, hospitals, and laboratories. The Products divisions develops and commercializes proprietary assays designed for use by clinical laboratories. The company was founded on March 6, 1997 and is headquartered in New Haven, CT.
info.description_zh: Precipio, Inc.是一家癌症診斷和試劑技術公司，為腫瘤市場提供診斷產品和服務。它透過以下業務部門運作：病理服務和產品。病理學服務部門為醫生、醫院和實驗室提供專業的癌症診斷測試​​服務。產品部門開發並商業化專為臨床實驗室使用而設計的專有檢測方法。該公司成立於1997年3月6日，總部位於康乃狄克州紐黑文。

info.description: Celsius Holdings, Inc. engages in the development, marketing, sale, and distribution of functional drinks and liquid supplements. It also offers post-workout functional energy drinks and protein bars. The company was founded in April 2004 and is headquartered in Boca Raton, FL.
info.description_zh: Celeste Holdings, Inc. 從事功能性飲料和液體補充劑的開發、行銷、銷售和分銷。它還提供鍛煉後功能性能量飲料和蛋白質棒。該公司成立於 2004 年 4 月，總部位於佛羅裡達州博卡拉頓。

info.description: Personalis, Inc. engages in the provision of advanced genomic tests for cancer. The firm is also involved in providing sequencing and data analysis services to support population sequencing initiatives. The company was founded by Euan A. Ashley, Michael Snyder, Atul J. Butte, John S. West, and Russ B. Altman in February 2011 and is headquartered in Fremont, CA.
info.description_zh: Personalis, Inc. 致力於提供先進的癌症基因組測試。該公司還提供定序和數據分析服務，以支援群體定序計劃。該公司由 Euan A. Ashley、Michael Snyder、Atul J. Butte、John S. West 和 Russ B. Altman 於 2011 年 2 月創立，總部位於加州弗里蒙特。

info.description: Biomea Fusion, Inc. is a biopharmaceutical company, which engages in the discovery, development, and commercialization of covalent small molecule drugs to treat patients with genetically defined cancers and metabolic disorders, such as diabetes. It offers its lead product candidate, BMF-219, an orally bioavailable, potent, and selective covalent inhibitor of menin, a transcriptional regulator known to play a direct role in oncogenic signaling in multiple cancers. The company was founded by Thomas Butler and Ramses Erdtmann in August 2017 and is headquartered in San Carlos, CA.

info.description: Coinbase Global, Inc. engages in the provision of a trusted platform that serves as a compliant on-ramp to the onchain economy and enables users to engage in a wide variety of activities with their crypto assets in both proprietary and third-party product experiences enabled by access to decentralized applications. It offers consumers primary financial account for the cryptoeconomy, institutions a full-service prime brokerage platform with access to deep pools of liquidity across the crypto marketplace, and developers a suite of products granting access to build onchain. The company was founded by Brian Armstrong and Fred Ernest Ehrsam in May 2012 and is headquartered in New York, NY.
info.industry_zh: 財務數據和證券交易所
info.description_zh: Coinbase Global, Inc. 致力於提供一個值得信賴的平台，作為鏈上經濟的合規入口，使用戶能夠透過訪問去中心化應用程序，在專有和第三方產品體驗中使用其加密資產參與各種活動。它為消費者提供加密經濟的主要金融帳戶，為機構提供全方位服務的主要經紀平台，可以存取整個加密市場的深層流動性池，並為開發人員提供一套允許在鏈上構建的產品。該公司由 Brian Armstrong 和 Fred Ernest Ehrsam 於 2012 年 5 月創立，總部位於紐約州紐約市。

info.description: Invivyd, Inc. engages in the discovery, development and commercialization of antibody-based solutions for infectious diseases with pandemic potential. The firm develops antibodies that can neutralize SARS-CoV-2, SARS-CoV-1, and additional emergent coronaviruses. It offers ADG20, a monoclonal antibody, targeting the spike protein of SARS-CoV-2 and related coronaviruses. The company was founded by Tillman U. Gerngross, Ren Russo and Laura Walker on June 3, 2020 and is headquartered in New Haven, CT.
info.description_zh: Invivyd, Inc. 致力於針對具有大流行潛力的傳染病的基於抗體的解決方案的發現、開發和商業化。該公司開發的抗體可以中和 SARS-CoV-2、SARS-CoV-1 和其他新出現的冠狀病毒。它提供 ADG20，一種單株抗體，針對 SARS-CoV-2 和相關冠狀病毒的刺突蛋白。該公司由 Tillman U. Gerngross、Ren Russo 和 Laura Walker 於 2020 年 6 月 3 日創立，總部位於康乃狄克州紐黑文。

info.description: Eikon Therapeutics is a biopharmaceutical company. It engages in the development of medicines for unmet medical needs. The company was founded in 2019 and is headquartered in Millbrae, CA.
info.description_zh: Eikon Therapeutics 是一家生物製藥公司。它致力於開發藥物以滿足未滿足的醫療需求。該公司成立於 2019 年，總部位於加州米爾布雷。

info.description: Novavax, Inc. Is a biotechnology company, which engages in the discovery, development, and commercialization of recombinant vaccines. The company was founded in 1987 and is headquartered in Gaithersburg, MD.
info.description_zh: Novavax, Inc.是一家生技公司，從事重組疫苗的發現、開發和商業化。該公司成立於 1987 年，總部位於馬裡蘭州蓋瑟斯堡。

info.description: HeartSciences, Inc. is a medical technology company, which focuses on applying innovative AI-based technology to an electrocardiogram (ECG) to expand and improve an ECG's clinical usefulness. Its objective is to make an ECG a far more valuable cardiac screening tool, particularly in frontline or point-of-care clinical settings. The firm offers MyoVista, a resting 12-lead ECG that is also designed to provide diagnostic information related to cardiac dysfunction. The company was founded on August 16, 2007 and is headquartered in Southlake, TX.
info.description_zh: HeartSciences, Inc. 是一家醫療技術公司，專注於將基於人工智慧的創新技術應用於心電圖 (ECG)，以擴展和提高心電圖的臨床實用性。其目標是使心電圖成為更有價值的心臟篩檢工具，特別是在前線或護理點臨床環境中。該公司提供 MyoVista，一種靜息 12 導程心電圖，也旨在提供與心臟功能障礙相關的診斷資訊。該公司成立於2007年8月16日，總部位於德克薩斯州南湖。

info.description: IDEAYA Biosciences, Inc. engages in the research and development of oncology-focused precision medicine. The firm focuses on the targeted therapeutics for patients selected using molecular diagnostics. Its product candidate, IDE196, is a protein kinase C inhibitor for genetically defined cancers having GNAQ and GNA11 gene mutations. The company was founded by Yujiro S. Hata and Jeffrey Hager in June 2015 and is headquartered in South San Francisco, CA.
info.description_zh: IDEAYA Biosciences, Inc.從事以腫瘤學為重點的精準醫療的研發。該公司專注於為使用分子診斷選擇的患者提供標靶治療。其候選產品 IDE196 是一種蛋白激酶 C 抑制劑，用於治療具有 GNAQ 和 GNA11 基因突變的基因癌症。該公司由 Yujiro S. Hata 和 Jeffrey Hager 於 2015 年 6 月創立，總部位於加州南舊金山。

info.description: Defiance Daily Target 2X Long HOOD ETF seeks daily leveraged investment results of two times (200%) the daily percentage change in the share price of Robinhood Markets, Inc. (Nasdaq: HOOD). The fund is an actively managed exchange traded fund ("ETF") that attempts to achieve two times (200%) the daily percentage change in the share price of the Underlying Security by employing derivatives, namely swap agreements and/or listed options contracts. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Defiance Daily Target 2X Long HOOD ETF 尋求每日槓桿投資結果為 Robinhood Markets, Inc.（納斯達克股票代碼：HOOD）每日股價變化百分比的兩倍（200%）。該基金是一種主動管理的交易所交易基金（「ETF」），試圖透過使用衍生性商品（即掉期協議和/或上市選擇權合約）來實現基礎證券股價每日百分比變化的兩倍（200%）。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: BioCardia, Inc. is a clinical-stage biotherapeutic company, which engages in the business of developing cellular and cell-derived therapeutics for the treatment of cardiovascular and pulmonary diseases with significant unmet medical needs. Its pipeline includes CardiAMP, CardiALLO, PulmALLO, Helix Biotherapeutic Delivery System, and Morph DNA and AVANCE Steerable Introducers. The company was founded on January 12, 1994 and is headquartered in Sunnyvale, CA.

info.description: Leverage Shares 2X Long HOOD Daily ETF seeks daily levered investment results, before fees and expenses, of two times (200%) of the daily percentage change in the price of the common stock of HOOD. The fund invests at least 80% of its net assets (plus borrowings for investment purposes) in financial instruments with economic characteristics that, in combination, provide 200% daily leveraged exposure to the price of HOOD, consistent with the fund's investment objective. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: 槓桿股票 2 倍多頭 HOOD 每日 ETF 尋求每日槓桿投資結果（扣除費用和開支）為 HOOD 普通股價格每日百分比變化的兩倍 (200%)。該基金將至少 80% 的淨資產（加上投資目的借款）投資於具有經濟特徵的金融工具，這些金融工具組合起來可提供 HOOD 價格的 200% 每日槓桿敞口，與基金的投資目標一致。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Direxion Daily HOOD Bull 2X ETF seeks daily investment results, before fees and expenses, of 200% of the daily performance of HOOD. The fund, under normal circumstances, invests at least 80% of its net assets (plus any borrowings for investment purposes) in the securities of HOOD and financial instruments, such as swap agreements and options, that, in combination, provide 2X daily leveraged exposure to HOOD, consistent with the fund's investment objective. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Direxion Daily HOOD Bull 2X ETF 寻求每日投资结果（未计费用和开支）为 HOOD 每日业绩的 200%。在正常情況下，該基金將至少 80% 的淨資產（加上任何用於投資目的的借款）投資於 HOOD 證券和金融工具，例如掉期協議和期權，這些組合起來為 HOOD 提供 2 倍的每日槓桿敞口，這與基金的投資目標一致。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: ZJK Industrial Co., Ltd. engages in the manufacturing and sale of precision fasteners, structural parts and other precision metal parts products. Its products include standard screws, nuts, bolts, turning parts, stamping parts and computer numerical control machining parts. The company was founded in 2011 and is headquartered in Shenzhen, China.
info.description_zh: 中金康實業股份有限公司從事精密緊固件、結構件及其他精密金屬零件產品的製造及銷售。其產品包括標準螺絲、螺帽、螺栓、車削件、沖壓件和電腦數控加工件。公司成立於2011年，總部位於中國深圳。

info.description: Cingulate, Inc. operates as a clinical stage bio pharmaceutical company using a Precision Timed Release drug delivery platform technology to build a pipeline of next-generation pharmaceutical products. The firm initially focused on the treatment of Attention Deficit/Hyperactivity Disorder (ADHD). It identifies and evaluates additional therapeutic areas, PTR technology employed to develop future product candidates. Cingulate was founded by Shane J. Schaffer, Craig Steven Gilgallon, Raul R. Silva, Matthew N. Brams in May 2012 and is headquartered in Kansas City, KS.

info.description: Datacentrex, Inc. is a digital infrastructure and capital deployment company. It engages in the owning and operating of Scrypt to compute assets and evaluate strategic transactions across asset-backed operating businesses. The company was founded by Robert Steele and Daniel Lupinelli on October 27, 2019 and is headquartered in Salt Lake City, UT.
info.industry_zh: 財務數據和證券交易所
info.description_zh: Datacentrex, Inc. 是一家數位基礎架構和資本部署公司。它從事 Scrypt 的擁有和運營，以計算資產並評估資產支援營運業務的策略交易。該公司由 Robert Steele 和 Daniel Lupinelli 於 2019 年 10 月 27 日創立，總部位於猶他州鹽湖城。

info.description: Ionis Pharmaceuticals, Inc. engages in the development and commercialization of human therapeutic drugs using antisense technology. The company was founded by Stanley T. Crooke, David J. Ecker, Christopher K. Mirabelli, and Brett P. Monia on January 10, 1989 and is headquartered in Carlsbad, CA.
info.description_zh: Ionis Pharmaceuticals, Inc. 利用反義技術從事人類治療藥物的開發和商業化。該公司由 Stanley T. Crooke、David J. Ecker、Christopher K. Mirabelli 和 Brett P. Monia 於 1989 年 1 月 10 日創立，總部位於加州卡爾斯巴德。

info.description: Grayscale Avalanche Staking ETF is a physically-backed exchange-traded product designed to provide passive exposure to the market price of AVAX, the native token of the Avalanche network, by holding the digital asset directly. The strategy distinguishes itself by incorporating a staking component, whereby the fund participates in the network's Proof of Stake consensus mechanism to earn rewards, which are then reflected in the value of the shares alongside the underlying asset's price performance.
info.description_zh: Grayscale Avalanche Stake ETF 是一種實體支援的交易所交易產品，旨在透過直接持有數位資產，提供對 Avalanche 網路原生代幣 AVAX 市場價格的被動敞口。該策略的獨特之處在於納入了質押成分，即基金參與網絡的權益證明共識機制以賺取獎勵，然後這些獎勵會反映在股票價值以及標的資產的價格表現中。

info.description: Arbutus Biopharma Corp. is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company, which engages in developing novel therapeutics that target specific viral diseases. It focuses on the development of imdusiran (AB-729), proprietary, conjugated GalNAc, subcutaneously-delivered RNAi therapeutic, and AB-101, proprietary oral PD-L1 inhibitor, for the treatment of chronic hepatitis B (cHBV). The company was founded on October 6, 2005 and is headquartered in Warminster, PA.
info.description_zh: Arbutus Biopharma Corp.是一家臨床階段的生物製藥公司，致力於開發針對特定病毒性疾病的新型療法。它專注於開發imdusiran (AB-729)，一種專有的綴合GalNAc，皮下遞送的RNAi治療劑，以及AB-101，一種專有的口服PD-L1抑制劑，用於治療慢性乙型肝炎(cHBV)。該公司成立於2005年10月6日，總部位於賓州沃明斯特。

info.description: MicroCloud Hologram, Inc. engages in research, development, and application of holographic technology. It operates through the Holographic Solutions and Holographic Technology Service segments. The company was founded in 2020 and is headquartered in New York, NY.
info.description_zh: MicroCloud Hologram, Inc.從事全像技術的研究、開發與應用。它透過全息解決方案和全息技術服務部門運作。該公司成立於2020年，總部位於紐約州紐約。

info.description: Sensus Healthcare, Inc. is a medical device company, which engages in the provision of treatment for both oncological and non-oncological skin conditions. The company was founded by Joseph C. Sardano, Richard Golin, Kalman Fishman, and Stephen Cohen on May 7, 2010 and is headquartered in Boca Raton, FL.
info.description_zh: Sensus Healthcare, Inc. 是一家醫療器材公司，致力於為腫瘤和非腫瘤皮膚病提供治療。該公司由 Joseph C. Sardano、Richard Golin、Kalman Fishman 和 Stephen Cohen 於 2010 年 5 月 7 日創立，總部位於佛羅裡達州博卡拉頓。

info.description: NervGen Pharma Corp. operates as a clinical stage biotech company. It engages in the discovery, development and commercialization of neuroreparative therapeutics for spinal cord injury and other neurotraumatic and neurologic conditions. The company was founded by Harold Punnett and William Joseph Radvak on January 19, 2017 and is headquartered in Vancouver, Canada.

info.description: Capricor Therapeutics, Inc. is a clinical-stage biotechnology company, which focuses on the development of transformative cell and exosome-based therapeutics for treating Duchenne muscular dystrophy ("DMD"), a rare form of muscular dystrophy which results in muscle degeneration and premature death, and other diseases with unmet medical needs. Its product candidate consists of CAP-1002, Engineered Exosomes, CAP-2003, and Exosome-Based Vaccine. The company was founded on June 17, 1996 and is headquartered in San Diego, CA.
info.description_zh: Capricor Therapeutics, Inc.是一家臨床階段的生物技術公司，專注於開發基於轉化細胞和外泌體的療法，用於治療杜氏肌肉營養不良症（“DMD”），這是一種罕見的肌肉營養不良症，會導致肌肉退化和過早死亡，以及其他醫療需求未得到滿足的疾病。其候選產品包括 CAP-1002、工程外泌體、CAP-2003 和外泌體疫苗。該公司成立於1996年6月17日，總部位於加州聖地牙哥。

info.description: Guardforce AI Co., Ltd. engages in the provision of integrated security solutions. It operates through the following segments: Secured Logistics, AI and Robotics Solutions, General Security Solutions, and Corporate and Others. The Corporate and Others segment covers the non-operating activities supporting the company. The company was founded on April 20, 2018 and is headquartered in Singapore.
info.description_zh: 衛安人工智慧有限公司從事提供綜合安全解決方案。該公司透過以下部門運作：安全物流部門、人工智慧和機器人解決方案部門、通用安全解決方案部門以及企業及其他部門。本公司及其他部門涵蓋支援公司的非經營活動。該公司成立於2018年4月20日，總部位於新加坡。

info.description: Robinhood Markets, Inc is a financial services platform, which engages in the provision of retail brokerage and offers trading in U.S. listed stocks and Exchange Traded Funds, related options, and cryptocurrency trading, as well as cash management, which includes debit cards services. The company was founded by Vladimir Tenev and Baiju Prafulkumar Bhatt in 2013 and is headquartered in Menlo Park, CA.
info.description_zh: Robinhood Markets, Inc 是一家金融服務平台，從事提供零售經紀業務，並提供美國上市股票和交易所交易基金、相關選擇權、加密貨幣交易以及現金管理（包括金融卡服務）的交易。該公司由 Vladimir Tenev 和 Baiju Prafulkumar Bhatt 於 2013 年創立，總部位於加州門洛帕克。

info.description: Atlas Lithium Corp. operates as a U.S. mineral exploration and mining company with projects and properties in essentially all battery metals, including lithium, rare earths, graphite, nickel, cobalt, and titanium. The firm focuses on developing its hard-rock lithium project located in a premier pegmatitic district in Brazil Minas Gerais and Northeastern Brazil. Additionally, through subsidiaries, it participates in iron, gold, and quartzite projects and owns multiple mining concessions for gold, diamond, and industrial sand. The company was founded on December 15, 2011 and is headquartered in Minas Gerais,BR.
info.description_zh: Atlas Lithium Corp.是一家美國礦產勘探和採礦公司，擁有幾乎所有電池金屬的專案和財產，包括鋰、稀土、石墨、鎳、鈷和鈦。該公司專注於開發位於巴西米納斯吉拉斯州和巴西東北部首要偉晶岩地區的硬岩鋰計畫。此外，它還透過子公司參與鐵、金和石英岩項目，並擁有多個黃金、鑽石和工業砂的採礦特許權。該公司成立於2011年12月15日，總部位於巴西米納斯吉拉斯州。

info.description: Incannex Healthcare, Inc. is a biotech company, which engages in developing cannabinoid and psychedelic compound medicines. It focuses on the research and development for medicinal cannabis pharmaceutical products and psychedelic medicine therapies for treatment of a range of indications. The company was founded on April 27, 2001 and is headquartered in Norwest, Australia.
info.industry_zh: 藥品製造商 - 特用藥品和非專利藥品
info.description_zh: Incannex Healthcare, Inc.是一家生技公司，致力於開發大麻素和迷幻化合物藥物。它專注於藥用大麻藥物和用於治療一系列適應症的迷幻藥物療法的研究和開發。該公司成立於2001年4月27日，總部位於澳洲諾韋斯特。

info.description: Phio Pharmaceuticals Corp. is a biotechnology company, which engages in the development of immuno-oncology therapeutics. The company was founded on September 8, 2011 and is headquartered in Marlborough, MA.
info.description_zh: Phio Pharmaceuticals Corp. 是一家生技公司，從事免疫腫瘤療法的開發。該公司成立於2011年9月8日，總部位於麻薩諸塞州馬爾伯勒。

info.description: Myseum.AI, Inc. operates as a communication software company. Its product, DatChat Messenger & Private Social Network, is a mobile application that gives users the ability to communicate with privacy and protection. The company's DatChat application allows users to exercise control over their messages, even after they are sent. Through the application, users can delete messages that they have sent on their own device and the recipient's device as well. Its DatChat application also enables users to hide secret and encrypted messages behind a cover, which messages can only be unlocked by the recipient and which are automatically destroyed after a fixed number of views or fixed amount of time and also includes a screen shot protection system, which makes it virtually impossible for the recipient to screenshot a message or picture before it gets destroyed. Its application also integrates with iMessage, making private messages potentially available to hundreds of millions of users. The company was founded by Darin M. Myman and Peter Shelus on December 4, 2014 and is headquartered in New Brunswick, NJ.
info.description_zh: Myseum.AI, Inc. 是一家通訊軟體公司。其產品 DatChat Messenger & Private Social Network 是一款行動應用程序，使用戶能夠在隱私和保護的情況下進行通訊。該公司的 DatChat 應用程式允許用戶對其訊息進行控制，甚至在訊息發送後也是如此。透過該應用程序，用戶可以刪除他們在自己的裝置和收件人的裝置上發送的訊息。其 DatChat 應用程式還使用戶能夠將秘密和加密的訊息隱藏在封面後面，這些訊息只能由收件人解鎖，並且在固定的查看次數或固定的時間後自動銷毀，並且還包括螢幕截圖保護系統，這使得收件人幾乎不可能在訊息或圖片被銷毀之前對其進行螢幕截圖。其應用程式還與 iMessage 集成，使數億用戶可以使用私人訊息。該公司由 Darin M. Myman 和 Peter Shelus 於 2014 年 12 月 4 日創立，總部位於新澤西州新不倫瑞克。

info.description: Nicholas Bitcoin and Treasuries AfterDark ETF is an actively managed investment strategy designed to capture bitcoin's return profile specifically during U.S. overnight hours, from market close to the following market open. The fund maintains a dual-exposure structure, holding bitcoin-related instruments during the overnight session while rotating into short-term U.S. Treasuries and cash equivalents during U.S. daytime trading hours to potentially mitigate the volatility often associated with standard market sessions.
info.description_zh: Nicholas 比特幣與國債 AfterDark ETF 是一種主動管理的投資策略，旨在捕捉比特幣的回報情況，特別是在美國隔夜時段（從市場收盤到隨後的市場開盤）。該基金維持雙重曝險結構，在隔夜交易時段持有比特幣相關工具，同時在美國日間交易時段轉向短期美國國債和現金等價物，以潛在地減輕通常與標準市場交易時段相關的波動性。

info.description: MediciNova, Inc. is a biopharmaceutical company, which focuses on developing novel therapeutics for the treatment of serious diseases with unmet medical needs and a commercial focus. Its programs include MN-001, MN-166 neurology diseases, and MN-221 respiratory diseases. The company was founded by Yuichi Iwaki on September 26, 2000 and is headquartered in La Jolla, CA.

info.description: Cenntro, Inc. is a commercial electric vehicle technology company, which engages in the designing, manufacturing, distribution, and servicing of commercial vehicles powered by electricity and hydrogen energy sources. It provides support to city services, last-mile delivery, and other commercial applications. The company was founded in 2013 and is headquartered in Iselin, NJ.
info.description_zh: Centntro, Inc.是一家商用電動車技術公司，從事電力和氫能商用車輛的設計、製造、分銷和服務。它為城市服務、最後一哩交付和其他商業應用提供支援。該公司成立於 2013 年，總部位於新澤西州艾斯林。

info.description: Big Digital Energy, Inc. engages in the provision of digital asset infrastructure services. The company was founded on February 10, 2012 and is headquartered in Midland, PA.
info.description_zh: Big Digital Energy, Inc.從事提供數位資產基礎設施服務。該公司成立於2012年2月10日，總部位於賓州米德蘭市。

info.description: NexMetals Mining Corp. is a mineral exploration and development company. It engages in the exploration, evaluating and development of nickel, copper, cobalt, and platinum group metals resources. The company was founded on September 23, 1983 and is headquartered in Vancouver, Canada.

info.description: GraniteShares YieldBOOST HOOD ETF seeks to achieve 2 times (200%) the income generated from selling options on Robinhood Markets, Inc.'s common stock by selling options on leveraged exchange-traded funds designed to deliver 2 times the daily performance of the Underlying Stock and to gain exposure to the performance of the Underlying Leveraged ETF, subject to a cap on potential investment gains. A downside protection may be implemented which could affect the net income level. The fund will invest at least 80% of its net assets in derivatives contracts that utilize the Underlying Leveraged ETF as their reference asset. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: GraniteShares YieldBOOST HOOD ETF 旨在通过出售杠杆交易所交易基金的期权来实现 2 倍 (200%) 出售 Robinhood Markets, Inc. 普通股期权所产生的收入，该基金旨在实现基础股票每日表现的 2 倍，并获得基础杠杆 ETF 表现的敞口，但须遵守潜在投资收益的上限。可能会实施下行保护，这可能会影响净利润水平。该基金将至少80%的净资产投资于以标的杠杆ETF作为参考资产的衍生品合约。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: ZOOZ Strategy Ltd. engages in the development of kinetic energy storage technology. It offers ZOOZTER-100 battery free Power Booster that enables ultra-fast EV charging, while overcoming grid limitations. The company was founded by Ilan Ben David, David Pincu, and Nir Zohar in 2013 and is headquartered in St. Lod, Israel.

info.description: Eupraxia Pharmaceuticals, Inc. operates as a drug delivery technology company in Canada. It delivers drugs into body compartments, such as the joint without any of the common issues with body compartment injections, such as systemic exposure. The firm focuses on arthritis, diabetic macular edema, and chronic pain programs. The company was founded by James A. Helliwell, John Salvatore Montalbano and Amanda Malone on May 12, 2011 and is headquartered in Victoria, Canada.

info.description: Werewolf Therapeutics, Inc. is a biopharmaceutical company, which engages in the development of therapeutics engineered to stimulate the body's immune system for the treatment of cancer. The firm offers Predator Technology which focuses on immune targeting and activation. The company was founded by Daniel J. Hicklin, Patrick A. Baeuerle, and Luke B. Evnin on October 19, 2017 and is headquartered in Watertown, MA.
info.description_zh: Werewolf Therapeutics, Inc. 是一家生物製藥公司，致力於開發旨在刺激人體免疫系統以治療癌症的療法。該公司提供專注於免疫靶向和活化的 Predator 技術。該公司由 Daniel J. Hicklin、Patrick A. Baeuerle 和 Luke B. Evnin 於 2017 年 10 月 19 日創立，總部位於馬薩諸塞州沃特敦。

info.description: CRISPR Therapeutics AG is a gene editing company, which engages in the development of transformative gene-based medicines for serious diseases using its proprietary CRISPR/Cas9 platform. Its CRISPR/Cas9 platform is a gene editing technology that allows for precise, directed changes to genomic DNA. The firm offers a portfolio of therapeutic programs across a broad range of disease areas including hemoglobinopathies, oncology, regenerative medicine, and rare diseases. The company was founded by Rodger Novak, Emmanuelle Charpentier, Shaun Patrick Foy, Matthew Porteus, Daniel Anderson, Chad Cowan, and Craig Mellow on October 31, 2013 and is headquartered in Zug, Switzerland.
info.description_zh: CRISPR Therapeutics AG 是一家基因編輯公司，利用其專有的 CRISPR/Cas9 平台開發針對嚴重疾病的轉化基因藥物。其 CRISPR/Cas9 平台是一種基因編輯技術，可對基因組 DNA 進行精確、定向的改變。該公司提供涵蓋廣泛疾病領域的治療項目組合，包括血紅蛋白病、腫瘤學、再生醫學和罕見疾病。該公司由 Rodger Novak、Emmanuelle Charpentier、Shaun Patrick Foy、Matthew Porteus、Daniel Anderson、Chad Cowan 和 Craig Mellow 於 2013 年 10 月 31 日創立，總部位於瑞士楚格。

info.description: Pliant Therapeutics, Inc. engages in the discovery, development and commercialization of therapies for fibrotic diseases. It offers a product discovery engine. The company is pursuing drug development programs for a range of fibrotic diseases, focusing on tissue-specific integrin modulation and TGF-ß1 signaling inhibition. The company was founded by Bradley Backes, Bill De Grado, Hal Chapman, and Dean Sheppard in June 2015 and is headquartered in South San Francisco, CA.
info.description_zh: Pliant Therapeutics, Inc. 致力於纖維化疾病療法的發現、開發和商業化。它提供了一個產品發現引擎。該公司正在針對一系列纖維化疾病開展藥物開發計劃，重點關注組織特異性整合素調節和 TGF-ß1 訊號傳導抑制。該公司由 Bradley Backes、Bill De Grado、Hal Chapman 和 Dean Sheppard 於 2015 年 6 月創立，總部位於加州南舊金山。

info.description: Coya Therapeutics, Inc. is a clinical-stage biotechnology company which engages in developing proprietary medicinal products to modulate the function of regulatory T cells. The company was founded by Howard Berman in 2020 and is headquartered in Houston, TX.
info.description_zh: Coya Therapeutics, Inc.是一家臨床階段生物技術公司，致力於開發調節調節性T細胞功能的專有醫藥產品。該公司由 Howard Berman 於 2020 年創立，總部位於德克薩斯州休士頓。

info.description: OTG Latin America ETF seeks long-term capital appreciation through investments in the equity securities of companies located in Latin America. Under normal circumstances, the fund will invest at least 80% of its net assets (including any borrowings for investment purposes) in Latin American equity securities. These equity securities include the securities of Latin American companies and investment companies that primarily invest in the securities of issuers in, or seek to track the performance of indices based on, Latin American markets. It may invest up to 20% of its assets in countries other than Latin American countries.
info.description_zh: OTG拉丁美洲ETF透過投資位於拉丁美洲的公司的股本證券尋求長期資本增值。正常情況下，該基金將至少80%的淨資產（包括任何用於投資目的的借款）投資於拉丁美洲股票證券。這些股本證券包括拉丁美洲公司和投資公司的證券，這些公司和投資公司主要投資於拉丁美洲市場發行人的證券，或尋求追蹤基於拉丁美洲市場的指數的表現。它可以將最多20%的資產投資於拉丁美洲國家以外的國家。

info.description: Formula Systems (1985) Ltd. engages in the provision of software solutions and information technology professional services. It operates through the following segments: Matrix , Sapiens, Magic Software, Insync, Michpal, ZAP Group, and Other. The company was founded on April 2, 1985 and is headquartered in Or Yehuda, Israel.
info.description_zh: Formula Systems (1985) Ltd. 從事提供軟體解決方案和資訊科技專業服務。它透過以下部門運作：Matrix、Sapiens、Magic Software、Insync、Michpal、ZAP Group 和其他部門。該公司成立於1985年4月2日，總部位於以色列奧爾耶胡達。

info.description: CLPS, Inc. is a holding company, which engages in the provision of information technology, consulting, and solution services to banking, insurance, and financial sectors. It operates through the IT Services and Academic Education Services segments. The company was founded by Ming Hui Ling on August 30, 2005 and is headquartered in Hong Kong.
info.description_zh: CLPS, Inc.是一家控股公司，致力於為銀行、保險和金融業提供資訊科技、諮詢和解決方案服務。它透過 IT 服務和學術教育服務部門運作。該公司由明慧玲於2005年8月30日創立，總部位於香港。

info.description: A SPAC III Acquisition Corp. is a blank check company. The company was created for the purpose of effecting a merger, asset acquisition, share purchase, reorganization or similar business combination. The company was founded on September 3, 2021 and is headquartered in Hong Kong.
info.description_zh: SPAC III Acquisition Corp. 是一家空白支票公司。公司成立的目的是進行合併、資產收購、股份購買、重組或類似的業務合併。該公司成立於2021年9月3日，總部位於香港。

info.description: Editas Medicine, Inc. engages in the development and commercialization of genome editing technology. Its technology includes clustered, regularly interspaced short palindromic repeats (CRISPR), and CRISPR associated protein 9 (Cas9). The company was founded by Feng Zhang, Jennifer A. Doudna, George McDonald Church, J. Keith Joung and David R. Liu on September 3, 2013 and is headquartered in Cambridge, MA.
info.description_zh: Editas Medicine, Inc. 從事基因組編輯技術的開發和商業化。其技術包括成簇、規則間隔的短回文重複序列 (CRISPR) 和 CRISPR 相關蛋白 9 (Cas9)。該公司由 Feng Zhang、Jennifer A. Doudna、George McDonald Church、J. Keith Joung 和 David R. Liu 於 2013 年 9 月 3 日創立，總部位於馬薩諸塞州劍橋。

info.description: Lotus Technology, Inc. engages in the design, development, and sale of battery for electronic vehicles through its subsidiaries. It also sells luxury sports cars under the Lotus brand. The company was founded on August 9, 2021 and is headquartered in Shanghai, China.
info.description_zh: Lotus Technology, Inc.透過其子公司從事電動汽車電池的設計、開發和銷售。它還銷售蓮花品牌的豪華跑車。公司成立於2021年8月9日，總部位於中國上海。

info.description: QNB Corp. is a bank holding company, which engages in the provision of commercial, retail banking, and retail brokerage services. The company was founded in 1877 and is headquartered in Quakertown, PA.

info.description: iShares iBonds Dec 2056 Term Treasury ETF seeks to track the investment results of the ICE 2056 Maturity U.S. Treasury Index composed of U.S. Treasury bonds maturing in 2056. The fund seeks to meet its investment objective generally by investing in individual securities which satisfy the criteria of the underlying index. The underlying index consists of publicly-issued U.S. Treasury securities that are scheduled to mature between January 1, 2056 and December 15, 2056, inclusive. The fund will invest at least 80% of its assets in the component securities of the underlying index.
info.description_zh: iShares iBonds Dec 2056 Term Treasury ETF 旨在追蹤由 2056 年到期的美國國債組成的 ICE 2056 Maturity U.S. Treasury Index 的投資結果。該基金通常尋求透過投資滿足基礎指數標準的個別證券來實現其投資目標。標的指數由公開發行的美國國債組成，計劃於 2056 年 1 月 1 日至 2056 年 12 月 15 日（含）之間到期。該基金將至少 80% 的資產投資於相關指數的成分證券。

info.description: iShares iBonds Dec 2055 Term Treasury ETF seeks to track the investment results of the Bloomberg December 2055 Maturity Corporate Index. The index seeks to track the investment results of an index composed of U.S. dollar-denominated, investment-grade corporate bonds maturing in 2055. The fund will invest at least 80% of its assets in the component instruments of the underlying index, and the fund will invest at least 90% of its assets in fixed income securities of the types included in the underlying index that BFA believes will help the fund track the underlying index. The fund is non-diversified. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: iShares iBonds Dec 2055 定期公債 ETF 旨在追蹤彭博 2055 年 12 月到期企業指數的投資結果。該指數旨在追蹤由將於 2055 年到期的以美元計價的投資等級公司債組成的指數的投資結果。該基金將至少 80% 的資產投資於基礎指數的組成工具，而該基金將至少 90% 的資產投資於基礎指數中包含的固定收益證券類型，BFA 認為這些證券將有助於基金追蹤基礎指數。該基金是非多元化的。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Moody's Corp. engages in the provision of credit ratings, research, tools and analysis to the global capital markets. It operates through the Moody's Investors Service (MIS) and Moody's Analytics (MA) segments. The MIS segment is a credit rating agency, which publishes credit ratings on debt obligations and the entities, including various corporate and governmental obligations, structured finance securities, and commercial paper programs. The MA segment develops products and services, which support financial analysis and risk management activities of institutional participants in global financial markets.
