info.description: Aureus Greenway Holdings, Inc. engages in the ownership and operation of public golf country clubs, namely Kissimmee Bay Country Club and Remington Golf Club. It operates through the following segments: Golf Recreation, Retail Golf Products, and Equipment and Facilities Rental, Membership Dues, Food and Beverage Services, and Ancillary Services and Amenities. The Golf Recreation, Retail Golf Products, and Equipment and Facilities Rental segment is involved in the collection of fees for every round of eighteen holes, provision of driving ranges for practice, sale of golf apparel and equipment, and rental of golf products and cars. The Membership Dues segment refers to the membership fees for customers to access the club's facilities and services for a set period or daily at the point of sale. The Food and Beverage Services segment provides culinary services such as catering. The Ancillary Services and Amenities segment offers leisure activities hosted in an on-premises clubhouse, kitchen, bar, and dining area. The company was founded on December 22, 2023 and is headquartered in Kissimmee, FL.
info.description_zh: Aureus Greenway Holdings, Inc. 從事公共高爾夫鄉村俱樂部的所有權和運營，即基西米灣鄉村俱樂部和雷明頓高爾夫俱樂部。它透過以下部門運作：高爾夫娛樂部門、零售高爾夫產品部門、設備和設施租賃部門、會員費部門、餐飲服務部門以及輔助服務和便利設施部門。高爾夫娛樂、零售高爾夫產品以及設備和設施租賃分部涉及每輪十八洞收費、提供練習場、銷售高爾夫服裝和設備以及租賃高爾夫產品和汽車。會員費部分是指顧客在一定期限內或每天在銷售點使用俱樂部設施和服務所繳納的會員費。餐飲服務部門提供餐飲等烹飪服務。輔助服務和設施部分提供在內部俱樂部會所、廚房、酒吧和用餐區舉辦的休閒活動。該公司成立於2023年12月22日，總部位於佛羅裡達州基西米。

info.description: Sana Biotechnology, Inc. engages in the research and development of engineered cells as medicine. It focuses on identifying and developing potential product candidates, executing preclinical studies, and acquiring technology. The company was founded by Steven D. Harr, Noubar B. Afeyan, Robert Taylor Nelsen, and Hans Edgar Bishop on July 2018 and is headquartered in Seattle, WA.
info.description_zh: Sana Biotechnology, Inc. 從事工程細胞藥物的研究和開發。它專注於識別和開發潛在的候選產品、執行臨床前研究以及獲取技術。該公司由 Steven D. Harr、Noubar B. Afeyan、Robert Taylor Nelsen 和 Hans Edgar Bishop 於 2018 年 7 月創立，總部位於華盛頓州西雅圖。

info.description: Leverage Shares 2X Long SPOT Daily ETF seeks daily levered investment results, before fees and expenses, of two times (200%) of the daily percentage change in the price of the common stock. The fund is an actively managed ETF. The fund invests at least 80% of its net assets (plus borrowings for investment purposes) in the Underlying Security and financial instruments with economic characteristics that, in combination, provide 200% daily leveraged exposure to the price of SPOT, consistent with the fund's investment objective. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: 槓桿股票 2 倍多頭現貨每日 ETF 尋求每日槓桿投資結果（未計費用和開支）為普通股價格每日百分比變化的兩倍 (200%)。該基金是主動式管理ETF。該基金將至少 80% 的淨資產（加上用於投資目的的借款）投資於標的證券和具有經濟特徵的金融工具，這些金融工具結合起來提供 200% 每日槓桿敞口的 SPOT 價格，與基金的投資目標一致。該基金是非多元化的。

Krainer in June 2014 and is headquartered in Bedford, MA.

info.description: PIMCO Inflation PLUS Active ETF is an actively managed strategy designed to generate real returns and provide a direct hedge against rising inflation while minimizing the interest rate volatility typically associated with long-duration inflation-protected securities. The fund invests primarily in a diversified portfolio of short-term U.S. Treasury Inflation-Protected Securities (TIPS) and inflation-linked derivatives, utilizing PIMCO's macroeconomic research to tactically manage inflation breakeven positioning and duration.
info.description_zh: PIMCO Inflation PLUS Active ETF 是一種主動管理策略，旨在產生實際回報並提供對通膨上升的直接對沖，同時最大限度地減少通常與長期通膨保值證券相關的利率波動。該基金主要投資於短期美國國債通膨保值證券（TIPS）和通膨掛鉤衍生性商品的多元化投資組合，利用太平洋投資管理公司的宏觀經濟研究來戰術性地管理通膨盈虧平衡頭寸和久期。

It was created for the purpose of effecting a merger, amalgamation, share exchange, asset acquisition, share purchase or similar business combination. The company was founded on March 6, 2025 and is headquartered in Dallas, TX.
info.description_zh: Perimeter Acquisition Corp. I 是一家空白支票公司。它的創建目的是為了實現合併、合併、股份交換、資產收購、股份購買或類似的業務合併。該公司成立於2025年3月6日，總部位於德州達拉斯。

info.description: Xtrackers S&P 500 Diversified Sector Weight ETF seeks investment results that correspond generally to the performance, before fees and expenses, of the S&P 500 Diversified Sector Weight Index. The underlying index is designed to track the performance of the constituent securities of the S&P 500 Index reweighted to mitigate concentration risk and address sector imbalances. Under normal circumstances, the fund will invest at least 80% of its net assets, plus the amount of any borrowings for investment purposes, in component securities of the underlying index. It is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Xtrackers S&P 500 Diversified Sector Weight ETF 尋求整體上與 S&P 500 Diversified Sector Weight Index 的表現（未計費用和開支）相對應的投資結果。基礎指數旨在追蹤重新加權的標準普爾 500 指數成分證券的表現，以減輕集中風險並解決產業失衡問題。在正常情況下，該基金將至少 80% 的淨資產以及用於投資目的的任何借款金額投資於基礎指數的組成證券。它是非多元化的。

info.description: Aemetis, Inc. is a renewable fuels and biochemical company, which engages in the acquisition, development, and commercialization of technologies that replace traditional petroleum-based products. It operates through the North America and India geographical segments. The North America segment manages Keyes Plant in California, the cellulosic ethanol facility in Riverbank, the cluster of biogas digesters on dairies near Keyes, California, the Goodland Plant, Kansas and the research and development facility in Minnesota. The India segment refers to the Kakinada plant, administrative offices in Hyderabad, and holding companies in Nevada and Mauritius. Its products include glycerin, ethanol, food and feed, biodiesel, and edible oils. The company was founded by Eric Armstrong McAfee in 2006 and is headquartered in Cupertino, CA.
info.description_zh: Aemetis, Inc. 是一家再生燃料和生化公司，致力於替代傳統石油產品的技術的收購、開發和商業化。它透過北美和印度地理部門開展業務。北美部門管理加州凱斯工廠、Riverbank 的纖維素乙醇工廠、加州凱斯附近乳品廠的沼氣池集群、堪薩斯州古德蘭工廠以及明尼蘇達州的研發設施。印度部門是指卡基納達工廠、海得拉巴的行政辦公室以及內華達州和毛里求斯的控股公司。其產品包括甘油、乙醇、食品和飼料、生質柴油和食用油。該公司由 Eric Armstrong McAfee 於 2006 年創立，總部位於加州庫比蒂諾。

info.description: Gyrodyne LLC engages in the management of a portfolio of medical office and industrial properties. Its properties include Flowerfield, Port Jefferson Professional Park, Courtland Medical Center, and Grove. The company was founded by Peter James Papadakos in 1946 and is headquartered in St. James, NY.

info.description: Evolution Metals & Technologies Corp. is a U.S. based critical materials and advanced manufacturing company for rare earth permanent magnets, battery materials, and related critical minerals and technologies. The firm's commercial-scale operations, advanced processing technologies, and strategic partnerships operate what it believes is the only vertically integrated critical materials supply chain spanning end-of-life electronics and batteries, high-grade concentrates, and the manufacture of finished rare earth magnets and battery materials. The company is headquartered in Miami, FL.
info.description_zh: Evolution Metals & Technologies Corp. 是一家美國關鍵材料和先進製造公司，生產稀土永久磁鐵、電池材料以及相關關​​鍵礦物和技術。該公司的商業規模運營、先進的加工技術和戰略合作夥伴關係運營著其認為唯一垂直整合的關鍵材料供應鏈，涵蓋報廢電子產品和電池、高品位精礦以及成品稀土磁體和電池材料的製造。該公司總部位於佛羅裡達州邁阿密。

info.description: CEA Industries, Inc. engages in in the development, design, and distribution of cultivation technologies for controlled environment agriculture, primarily for cannabis crops. It operates through the following segments: BNB Treasury Management and Retail and Industry. The BNB Treasury Management segment operates directly related to the company's DAT strategy, including the acquisition, disposition, and management of the company's BNB holdings or other digital assets such as Airdrops. The Retail and Industry segment deals with the Fat Panda's retail and distribution operations along with revenue and operating costs related to designing, engineering, and selling industrial climate control systems for controlled environment agriculture. The company was founded by Brandy Marie Keen and Stephen Keen on October 15, 2009 and is headquartered in Louisville, CO.
info.description_zh: CEA Industries, Inc. 從事受控環境農業（主要針對大麻作物）種植技術的開發、設計和分銷。它透過以下部門運作：BNB 資金管理部門以及零售和工業部門。 BNB資金管理部門的營運與公司的DAT策略直接相關，包括收購、處置和管理公司持有的BNB或空投等其他數位資產。零售和工業部門負責 Fat Panda 的零售和分銷業務，以及與設計、工程和銷售用於受控環境農業的工業氣候控制系統相關的收入和營運成本。該公司由 Brandy Marie Keen 和 Stephen Keen 於 2009 年 10 月 15 日創立，總部位於科羅拉多州路易斯維爾。

info.description: First Trust Nasdaq Food & Beverage ETF seeks investment results that correspond generally to the price and yield (before the fund's fees and expenses) of an equity index called the Nasdaq US Smart Food & Beverage IndexTM. The fund will normally invest at least 90% of its net assets (including investment borrowings) in the common stocks and depository receipts that comprise the underlying index. The index is designed to provide exposure to U.S. companies comprising the food and beverage sector that have been selected based upon their liquidity and weighted based upon their cumulative score on three investing factors: volatility, value and growth. The fund is non-diversified.

info.description_zh: First Trust Nasdaq Food & Beverage ETF 尋求的投資結果通常與名為 Nasdaq US Smart Food & Beverage Index™ 的股票指數的價格和收益率（基金費用和開支之前）相對應。該基金通常將至少 90% 的淨資產（包括投資借款）投資於構成基礎指數的普通股和存託憑證。該指數旨在提供食品和飲料行業美國公司的投資機會，這些公司是根據其流動性進行選擇的，並根據其在三個投資因素（波動性、價值和增長）的累積得分進行加權。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Cartesian Therapeutics, Inc. is a clinical-stage biotechnology company, which engages in mRNA cell therapies for the treatment of autoimmune diseases. It operates in research and development of cell therapy product candidates. The company was founded on December 10, 2007 is headquartered in Frederick, MD.
info.description_zh: Cartesian Therapeutics, Inc.是一家臨床階段的生物技術公司，從事治療自體免疫疾病的 mRNA 細胞療法。它從事細胞治療產品候選產品的研究和開發。該公司成立於2007年12月10日，總部位於馬裡蘭州弗雷德里克。

info.description: Greenpro Capital Corp. engages in the provision of business solution services to small and medium-size enterprises. It operates through the following business segments: Service Business, Digital Business, and Real Estate Business. The Service Business segment offers advisory and business solution services. The Digital Business segment focuses on the digital platform and trading of digital assets. The Real Estate Business segment trades or leases commercial real estate properties in Hong Kong and Malaysia. The company was founded by Lee Chong Kuang on July 19, 2013 and is headquartered in Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia.
info.description_zh: 綠專資本致力於為中小企業提供商業解決方案服務。它透過以下業務部門運作：服務業務、數位業務和房地產業務。服務業務部門提供諮詢和業務解決方案服務。數位業務部門專注於數位平台和數位資產交易。房地產業務部門在香港和馬來西亞交易或租賃商業房地產。該公司由李宗光於2013年7月19日創立，總部位於馬來西亞吉隆坡。

info.description: Lisata Therapeutics, Inc. is a clinical-stage pharmaceutical company, which engages in the discovery, development, and commercialization of innovative therapies for the treatment of solid tumors and other major diseases. Its product, Certepetide, is designed to activate a novel uptake pathway that allows co-administered or tethered anti-cancer drugs to target and penetrate tumors. The company was founded in 1980 and is headquartered in Basking Ridge, NJ.
info.description_zh: Lisata Therapeutics, Inc.是一家臨床階段製藥公司，致力於治療實體瘤和其他重大疾病的創新療法的發現、開發和商業化。其產品 Certepetide 旨在激活一種新型攝取途徑，使聯合給藥或聯合抗癌藥物能夠靶向並滲透腫瘤。該公司成立於 1980 年，總部位於新澤西州巴斯金里奇。

info.description: Flag Ship Acquisition Corp. operates as a blank check company. It was formed for the purpose of effecting a merger, capital stock exchange, asset acquisition, stock purchase, reorganization, or similar business combination with one or more businesses. The company was founded on May 14, 2018 and is headquartered in New York, NY.
info.description_zh: Flag Ship Acquisition Corp. 作為一家空白支票公司運作。它的成立目的是與一個或多個企業進行合併、股本交換、資產收購、股票購買、重組或類似的業務合併。該公司成立於2018年5月14日，總部位於紐約州紐約。

info.description: PMV Pharmaceuticals, Inc. is a precision oncology company, which engages in the discovery and development of small molecule, tumor-agnostic therapies targeting p53. The company was founded by Arnold J. Levine, David Henry Mac, and Thomas E. Shenk in March 2013 and is headquartered in Princeton, NJ.

info.description_zh: PMV Pharmaceuticals, Inc. 是一家精準腫瘤學公司，致力於發現和開發針對 p53 的小分子腫瘤不可知療法。該公司由 Arnold J. Levine、David Henry Mac 和 Thomas E. Shenk 於 2013 年 3 月創立，總部位於新澤西州普林斯頓。

info.description: Precision BioSciences, Inc. is a biotechnology company, which engages in the development of genome editing technologies. It operates through the Therapeutics and Food segments. The Therapeutics segment focuses on the development of products in the field of immuno-oncology and of novel products outside immuno-oncology to treat human diseases. The Food segment applies ARCUS, the company's proprietary genome editing platform, to develop food and nutrition products through collaboration agreements with consumer-facing companies. The company was founded by Derek N. Jantz, Jeff Smith, and Matthew R. Kane on January 26, 2006 and is headquartered in Durham, NC.
info.description_zh: Precision BioSciences, Inc.是一家生技公司，從事基因組編輯技術的開發。它透過治療和食品部門運作。治療部門專注於免疫腫瘤學領域的產品開發以及免疫腫瘤學以外治療人類疾病的新產品的開發。食品部門採用該公司專有的基因組編輯平台 ARCUS，透過與面向消費者的公司達成合作協議來開發食品和營養產品。該公司由 Derek N. Jantz、Jeff Smith 和 Matthew R. Kane 於 2006 年 1 月 26 日創立，總部位於北卡羅來納州達勒姆。

info.description: Ernexa Therapeutics, Inc. engages in the provision of cell engineering therapies. It is involved in the development of mRNA cell engineering technologies to repair cellular dysfunction and treat a range of therapeutic indications. The company was founded in 1984 and is headquartered in Cambridge, MA.
info.description_zh: Ernexa Therapeutics, Inc. 從事提供細胞工程療法。它參與開發 mRNA 細胞工程技術來修復細胞功能障礙並治療一系列治療適應症。該公司成立於 1984 年，總部位於馬薩諸塞州劍橋。

info.description: Sol Strategies, Inc. is an investment company. The firm is focused on the Solana ecosystem, which provides strategic investments and infrastructure solutions to enable decentralized finance. Its portfolio includes NGRAVE, Chia Network Inc., and zkSNACKS Limited. The company was founded on October 1, 2002 and is headquartered in Toronto, Canada.
info.description_zh: Sol Strategies, Inc. 是一家投資公司。該公司專注於 Solana 生態系統，該生態系統提供策略性投資和基礎設施解決方案以實現去中心化金融。其投資組合包括 NGRAVE、Chia Network Inc. 和 zkSNACKS Limited。該公司成立於2002年10月1日，總部位於加拿大多倫多。

info.description: BioVie, Inc. is a biopharmaceutical company, which engages in discovery, development, and marketing drug therapies for neurological and neurodegenerative disorders, and liver disease. The company was founded on April 10, 2013 and is headquartered in Carson City, NV.
info.description_zh: BioVie, Inc. 是一家生物製藥公司，致力於發現、開發和行銷神經系統和神經退化性疾病以及肝病的藥物療法。該公司成立於2013年4月10日，總部位於內華達州卡森市。

info.description: JX Luxventure Group, Inc. engages in the design, manufacture, distribution, and sale of casual menswear. It operates through the following segments: Tourism Products, Technology, and Cross-Board Merchandise. The The company was founded by Anna Polemis on January 26, 2012, and is headquartered in Haikou, China.

info.description: OceanPal, Inc. is a holding company, which engages in the provision of shipping transportation services. It also specializes in the ownership of vessels. The firm transports iron ore, coal and grains, and minor bulks such as bauxite, phosphate and fertilizers. The company was founded on April 15, 2021 and is headquartered in Athens, Greece.
info.description_zh: OceanPal, Inc.是一家控股公司，從事提供船舶運輸服務。它還專注於船舶的所有權。該公司運輸鐵礦石、煤炭和穀物，以及鋁土礦、磷酸鹽和化肥等小宗散裝貨物。該公司成立於2021年4月15日，總部位於希臘雅典。

info.description: Graniteshares YieldBOOST Baba ETF seeks current income; exposure to the performance of one or more exchange-traded funds whose shares trade on a U.S.-regulated securities exchange and that seek daily leverage investment results of 2 times (200%) the daily percentage of the ADR of Alibaba Group Holding Limited (NYSE: BABA) subject to a limit on potential investment gains. The fund will invest at least 80% of its net assets (plus any borrowings for investment purposes) in derivatives contracts that utilize the Underlying BABA ETF as the reference asset. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Graniteshares YieldBOOST Baba ETF 尋求當前收入；接觸一隻或多只交易所交易基金的業績，這些基金的股票在美國監管的證券交易所進行交易，並且尋求每日槓桿投資結果為阿里巴巴集團控股有限公司（紐約證券交易所股票代碼：BABA）每日美國存託憑證百分比的兩倍（200%），但受到潛在投資收益的限制。該基金將至少80%的淨資產（加上任何用於投資目的的借款）投資於以基礎BABA ETF作為參考資產的衍生性合約。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Clinuvel Pharmaceuticals Ltd. operates as a biopharmaceutical company. The firm engages in the development of SCENESSE, its proprietary photoprotective drug. It also offers drugs for the treatment of various skin disorders. The company was founded by Robert Thomas Dorr on December 14, 1999 and is headquartered in Melbourne, Australia.
info.description_zh: Clinuvel Pharmaceuticals Ltd. 是一家生物製藥公司。該公司致力於開發其專有的光保護藥物 SCENESSE。它還提供治療各種皮膚病的藥物。該公司由Robert Thomas Dorr於1999年12月14日創立，總部位於澳洲墨爾本。

info.description: Horizon Quantum Holdings Ltd. engages in the development of software tools. The company is headquartered in Singapore.

info.description: 9F, Inc. is an Internet technology company, which operates as a digital financial account platform integrating and personalizing financial services. It provides financial products and services across loan products, online wealth management products, and payment facilitation, all integrated under a single digital financial account. The company was founded by Lei Liu and Li Xing Chen in August 2006 and is headquartered in Beijing, China.
info.description_zh: 9F, Inc.是一家網路科技公司，致力於整合和個人化金融服務的數位金融帳戶平台。它提供涵蓋貸款產品、線上理財產品和支付便利的金融產品和服務，所有這些都整合在一個數位金融帳戶下。該公司由劉雷和陳李星於2006年8月創立，總部位於中國北京。

info.description: Amesite, Inc. is a technology company, which engages in the development and marketing of B2C and B2B AI-driven solutions for the healthcare sector. It provides tools and direct connection with working nurses and caregivers through its brand, NurseMagic. The company was founded by Ann Marie Sastry on November 14, 2017 and is headquartered in Detroit, MI.
info.description_zh: Amesite, Inc. 是一家科技公司，致力於醫療保健產業 B2C 和 B2B 人工智慧驅動解決方案的開發和行銷。它透過其品牌 NurseMagic 提供工具以及與工作護理師和護理人員的直接聯繫。該公司由 Ann Marie Sastry 於 2017 年 11 月 14 日創立，總部位於密西根州底特律。

info.description: Vaxcyte, Inc. engages in the development of vaccines for infectious diseases. It focuses on conjugate vaccines and protein-based vaccines developed through the Sutro Biopharma's Xpress CF Platform, a cell-free protein synthesis technology. The company was founded by Grant E. Pickering and Jeff Fairman on November 27, 2013, and is headquartered in San Carlos, CA.
info.description_zh: Vaxcyte, Inc. 從事傳染病疫苗的開發。它專注於透過 Sutro Biopharma 的 Xpress CF 平台（一種無細胞蛋白質合成技術）開發的結合疫苗和蛋白質疫苗。該公司由 Grant E. Pickering 和 Jeff Fairman 於 2013 年 11 月 27 日創立，總部位於加州聖卡洛斯。

info.description: Perma-Pipe International Holdings, Inc. engages in the design, manufacture, and sale of specialty piping and leak detection systems. Its products include industrial and secondary containment piping systems for transporting chemicals, hazardous fluids and petroleum products, insulated and jacketed district heating and cooling piping systems for efficient energy distribution to multiple locations from central energy plants, and the coating and/or insulation of oil and gas gathering flow and long lines for oil or mineral transportation. The company was founded on October 12, 1993 and is headquartered in The Woodlands, TX.
info.description_zh: Perma-Pipe International Holdings, Inc. 從事特種管道和洩漏檢測系統的設計、製造和銷售。其產品包括用於運輸化學品、危險流體和石油產品的工業和二次安全殼管道系統、用於從中央能源工廠向多個地點高效分配能源的隔熱和夾套區域供熱和冷卻管道系統，以及用於石油或礦物運輸的油氣集流和長管線的塗層和/或隔熱。該公司成立於1993年10月12日，總部位於德克薩斯州伍德蘭茲。

info.description: Newbury Street II Acquisition Corp. is a blank check company, which engages in the purpose of effecting a merger, share exchange, asset acquisition, share purchase, reorganization or similar business combination with one or more businesses. The company was founded on June 18, 2024 and is headquartered in Boston, MA.
info.description_zh: Newbury Street II Acquisition Corp. 是一家空白支票公司，其目的是與一個或多個企業進行合併、股份交換、資產收購、股份購買、重組或類似業務合併。該公司成立於2024年6月18日，總部位於麻薩諸塞州波士頓。

info.description: Bunge Global SA engages in agribusiness including food and ingredients. It operates through the following segments: Agribusiness, Refined & Specialty Oils, Milling, Sugar & Bioenergy, and Corporate & Other. The Agribusiness segment is an integrated, global business principally involved in the purchase, storage, transportation, processing and sale of agricultural commodities and commodity products. The Refined & Specialty Oils segment includes businesses that sell vegetable oils and fats, including cooking oils, shortenings, specialty ingredients, and renewable diesel feedstocks. The Milling segment refers to the businesses that sell wheat flours, bakery mixes, and corn-based products. The Sugar & Bioenergy segment consists of results from the company's previously owned 50% ownership interest in BP Bunge Bioenergia. The Corporate & Other segment focuses on the salaries and overhead for corporate functions that are not allocated to individual reporting segments because the operating performance of such reporting segments is evaluated. It connects farmers to consumers to deliver essential and sustainable food, feed and fuel. The company was founded on February 14, 2023 and is headquartered in Chesterfield, MO.
info.description_zh: Bunge Global SA 從事農業綜合業務，包括食品和配料。它透過以下部門運作：農業綜合企業、精煉和特種油、製粉、糖和生物能源以及企業和其他部門。農業綜合企業部門是一家綜合性、全球性企業，主要涉及農產品和大宗商品的採購、儲存、運輸、加工和銷售。精煉和特種油部門包括銷售植物油和脂肪的業務，包括食用油、起酥油、特殊成分和再生柴油原料。製粉部門是指銷售小麥麵粉、烘焙混合物和玉米產品的業務。糖業和生質能源部門包括該公司先前擁有 BP Bunge Bioenergia 50% 股權的表現。公司及其他分部重點關注公司職能的薪資和間接費用，這些職能未分配給各個報告分部，因為要評估此類報告分部的經營業績。它將農民與消費者聯繫起來，提供基本且永續的食品、飼料和燃料。該公司成立於 2023 年 2 月 14 日，總部位於密蘇裡州切斯特菲爾德。

info.description: Innovative Eyewear, Inc. retails eye glasses online. It designs and provides smart glasses enhanced with tech features such as built-in Bluetooth audio connectivity, phone control buttons and instant AI voice assistant access. The company was founded by Harrison Gross, Konrad Dabrowski and David Eric Cohen in 2019 and is headquartered in Miami, FL.

info.description: Oculis Holding AG is a global biopharmaceutical company, which engages in sight and improving eye care. The firm's pipeline includes multiple product candidates in development such as, OCS-01, a topical retinal candidate for diabetic macular edema, OCS-02, a topical biologic candidate for dry eye disease, and OCS-05, a disease modifying candidate for acute optic neuritis and other neuro-ophtha disorders such as glaucoma, diabetic retinopathy, geographic atrophy, and neurotrophic keratitis. The company was founded in 2016 and is headquartered in Zug, Switzerland.
info.description_zh: Oculis Holding AG 是一家全球生物製藥公司，致力於視力和改善眼部護理。該公司的產品線包括多種正在開發的候選產品，例如 OCS-01（一種治療糖尿病黃斑水腫的局部視網膜候選藥物）、OCS-02（一種治療乾眼症的局部生物候選藥物）和 OCS-05（一種治療急性視神經炎和其他神經眼病（如青光眼、糖尿病視網膜病變、地圖樣萎縮和神經營養性角膜炎）。該公司成立於2016年，總部位於瑞士楚格。

info.description: Intelligent Protection Management Corp. engages in the development of communications software to enhance security and privacy solutions for multimedia communication and data transmission. Its solutions include blockchain strategy consulting, blockchain implementation, white label video solutions, and technology licensing. The firm's product portfolio includes Paltalk and Camfrog. The company was founded by Clifford Lerner and Darrell Lerner on July 19, 2005 and is headquartered in Jericho, NY.
info.description_zh: Intelligence Protection Management Corp. 從事通訊軟體開發，以增強多媒體通訊和資料傳輸的安全和隱私解決方案。其解決方案包括區塊鏈戰略諮詢、區塊鏈實施、白標視訊解決方案和技術許可。該公司的產品組合包括 Paltalk 和 Camfrog。該公司由 Clifford Lerner 和 Darrell Lerner 於 2005 年 7 月 19 日創立，總部位於紐約州傑里科。

info.description: TOP Financial Group Ltd. is a holding company, which engages in providing financial market and securities services. It focuses on futures brokerage and other financial services through a trading platform. The company was founded by Jun Li Yang on August 1, 2019 and is headquartered in Hong Kong.
info.description_zh: TOP Financial Group Ltd.是一家控股公司，從事提供金融市場和證券服務。它專注於透過交易平台提供期貨經紀和其他金融服務。該公司由楊麗君於2019年8月1日創立，總部位於香港。

info.description: Ocugen, Inc. is a biopharmaceutical company, which engages in the development and commercialization of therapies to cure eye diseases. Its product pipeline candidates include OCU400, OCU410, OCU200, and COVAXIN. The firm's modifier gene therapy platform is engaged in addressing retinal diseases, including retinitis pigmentosa, leber congenital amaurosis, and dry age-related macular degeneration. The company was founded by Shankar Musunuri and Uday B. Kompella in 2013 and is headquartered in Malvern, PA.
info.description_zh: Ocugen, Inc. 是一家生物製藥公司，致力於眼部疾病療法的開發和商業化。其候選產品包括OCU400、OCU410、OCU200和COVAXIN。該公司的修飾基因治療平台致力於解決視網膜疾病，包括色素性視網膜炎、萊伯先天性黑蒙和乾性老年黃斑部病變。該公司由 Shankar Musunuri 和 Uday B. Kompella 於 2013 年創立，總部位於賓夕法尼亞州馬爾文。

info.description: BitFuFu Inc. engages in providing digital asset mining and cloud-mining services. The firm fosters a secure, compliant, and transparent blockchain infrastructure, providing a variety of stable and intelligent digital asset mining solutions to a global customer base. It leverages a global mining facility network and strategic partnership with Bitmain, which enables institutional customers and digital asset enthusiasts to mine digital assets. The company was founded by Leo Lu in December 2020 and is headquartered in Singapore.

info.description: T Stamp, Inc. engages in development of proprietary artificial intelligence-powered solutions. It also focuses on researching and leveraging machine learning artificial intelligence, including computer vision, cryptography, and data mining, to process and protect data for identification against fraud. The company was founded by Gareth Genner, Andrew Gowasack, Catherine Lambert and Mike Lindenau on November 9, 2015 and is headquartered in Atlanta, GA.
info.description_zh: T Stamp, Inc. 致力於開發專有的人工智慧驅動解決方案。它還專注於研究和利用機器學習人工智慧，包括電腦視覺、密碼學和資料探勘，來處理和保護資料以防止詐欺。該公司由 Gareth Genner、Andrew Gowasack、Catherine Lambert 和 Mike Lindenau 於 2015 年 11 月 9 日創立，總部位於喬治亞州亞特蘭大。

info.description: Top KingWin Ltd. is a holding company that engages in the provision of corporate business training, corporate consulting, and advisory and transaction services. It provides customized software development, technology solutions, and peripheral hardware to clients, and focusing on fields such as intelligent manufacturing, urban construction, and healthcare industry. The company was founded by Rui Lin Xu in 2020 and is headquartered in Guangzhou, China.
info.description_zh: Top KingWin Ltd.是一家控股公司，從事提供企業業務培訓、企業諮詢以及諮詢和交易服務。為客戶提供客製化軟體開發、技術解決方案及週邊硬件，重點在於智慧製造、城市建設、醫療健康等領域。該公司由徐瑞林於2020年創立，總部位於中國廣州。

info.description: Direxion Daily LLY Bull 2X Shares seeks daily investment results, before fees and expenses, of 200% of the daily performance of LLY. The fund, under normal circumstances, invests at least 80% of its net assets (plus any borrowings for investment purposes) in the securities of LLY and financial instruments, such as swap agreements and options, that, in combination, provide 2X daily leveraged exposure to LLY, consistent with the fund's investment objective. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Direxion Daily LLY Bull 2X Shares 尋求每日投資結果（扣除費用和開支）為 LLY 每日表現的 200%。在正常情況下，該基金將至少 80% 的淨資產（加上任何用於投資目的的借款）投資於 LLY 證券以及掉期協議和期權等金融工具，這些金融工具結合起來為 LLY 提供 2 倍的每日槓桿敞口，這與基金的投資目標一致。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Flux Power Holdings, Inc. engages in the design, development, manufacturing, and sale of rechargeable lithium-ion energy storage systems for industrial applications. It focuses on electric forklifts and airport ground support equipment. The company was founded by Christopher L. Anthony and Michael Johnson on September 21, 1998 and is headquartered in Vista, CA.

info.description: SELLAS Life Sciences Group, Inc. is a clinical stage biopharmaceutical company, which engages in the development and commercialization of immunotherapeutic for cancer indications. Its product pipeline includes galinpepimut-S. The company was founded by Angelos M. Stergiou on April 3, 2006 and is headquartered in New York, NY.
info.description_zh: SELLAS Life Sciences Group, Inc.是一家臨床階段生物製藥公司，致力於癌症適應症免疫療法的開發和商業化。其產品線包括galinpepimut-S。該公司由 Angelos M. Stergiou 於 2006 年 4 月 3 日創立，總部位於紐約州紐約市。

info.description: Moderna, Inc. engages in the development of transformative medicines based on messenger ribonucleic acid. The firm's product pipeline includes the following modalities: prophylactic vaccines, cancer vaccines, intratumoral immuno-oncology, localized regenerative therapeutics, systemic secreted therapeutics, inhaled pulmonary therapeutics and systemic intracellular therapeutics. It operates through the following geographical segments: United States, Europe, and Rest of World. The company was founded by Noubar B. Afeyan, Robert S. Langer, Jr., Derrick J. Rossi, and Kenneth R. Chien in 2010 and is headquartered in Cambridge, MA.
info.description_zh: Moderna, Inc. 致力於開發基於信使核糖核酸的轉化藥物。該公司的產品線包括以下模式：預防性疫苗、癌症疫苗、腫瘤內免疫腫瘤學、局部再生療法、全身性分泌療法、吸入性肺部療法和全身性細胞內療法。它透過以下地理區域開展業務：美國、歐洲和世界其他地區。該公司由 Noubar B. Afeyan、Robert S. Langer, Jr.、Derrick J. Rossi 和 Kenneth R. Chien 於 2010 年創立，總部位於麻薩諸塞州劍橋。

info.description: GraniteShares 2x Long MRVL Daily ETF seeks daily investment results, before fees and expenses, of 2 times (200%) the daily percentage change of the common stock of Marvell Technology, Inc. (NASDAQ: MRVL). The fund is an actively managed exchange traded fund that attempts to replicate 2 times (200%) the daily percentage change the underlying stock by entering into financial instruments such as swaps and options underlying stock as well as directly purchasing the underlying stock. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: GraniteShares 2x Long MRVL Daily ETF 尋求每日投資結果（扣除費用和開支）為 Marvell Technology, Inc.（納斯達克股票代碼：MRVL）普通股每日百分比變化的 2 倍（200%）。該基金是一檔主動管理的交易所交易基金，試圖透過進入掉期和選擇權標的股票等金融工具以及直接購買標的股票來複製標的股票每日百分比變化的兩倍（200%）。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Anteris Technologies Global Corp. is a structural heart company, which engages in the development and commercialization of medical devices for heart diseases. It operates through the following geographical segments: United States, Germany, Australia, Switzerland, and Sweden. The company was founded in 1999 and is headquartered in Eagan, MN.
info.description_zh: Anteris Technologies Global Corp.是一家結構心臟公司，從事心臟病醫療設備的開發和商業化。它透過以下地理區域運作：美國、德國、澳洲、瑞士和瑞典。該公司成立於 1999 年，總部位於明尼蘇達州伊根。

info.description: Skillful Craftsman Education Technology Ltd. is a holding company, which engages in the provision of online education and technology services. Its online education services are comprised of online vocational training and virtual simulation experimental training. It also operates the following education platforms: lifelong education public service platform, online vocational training platform, and virtual simulation experimental training platform. The company was founded by Xiao Feng Gao and Lu Gang Hua in 2013 and is headquartered in Shenzhen, China.
info.description_zh: 巧匠教育科技有限公司是一家控股公司，從事提供線上教育和技術服務。其線上教育服務包括線上職業培訓和虛擬模擬實驗培訓。也經營終身教育公共服務平台、線上職業培訓平台、虛擬模擬實驗實務平台等教育平台。該公司由高曉峰和盧剛華於2013年創立，總部位於中國深圳。

info.description: Decent Holding, Inc. engages in the provision of wastewater treatment by cleansing the industrial wastewater, ecological river restoration, and river ecosystem management. Its products and services include river water quality management and microbial products for water quality enhancement and pollutant cleansing purposes. The company was founded by Ding Xin Sun on January 6, 2022 and is headquartered in Yantai, China.
info.description_zh: Decent Holding, Inc. 從事工業廢水淨化、河川生態修復和河川生態系統管理等廢水處理業務。其產品和服務包括河流水質管理以及用於水質提高和污染物淨化的微生物產品。該公司由孫鼎新於2022年1月6日創立，總部位於中國煙台。

info.description: Scinai Immunotherapeutics Ltd. is a clinical stage biopharmaceutical company, which engages in the development and commercialization of immunomodulation therapies for infectious diseases. It focuses on the flu vaccine candidate that was designed to provide multi-strain and multi-season protection against seasonal and pandemic influenza. The company was founded by Ronald Babecoff and Rami Epstein on July 21, 2003 and is headquartered in Jerusalem, Israel.
info.description_zh: ScinaiImmunotherapeutics Ltd.是一家臨床階段的生物製藥公司，從事傳染病免疫調節療法的開發和商業化。它重點關注候選流感疫苗，該疫苗旨在提供季節性和大流行性流感的多株和多季節保護。該公司由 Ronald Babecoff 和 Rami Epstein 於 2003 年 7 月 21 日創立，總部位於以色列耶路撒冷。

info.description: AIOS Tech, Inc. engages in the strategic transformation plan, is repositioning itself as a provider of artificial intelligence and technology-driven professional services. The firm delivering innovative information technology solutions, advanced data services, and AI-powered offerings to a diverse range of commercial client base. The core business encompasses digital transformation services, customized IT solutions for the financial sector, enterprise data solutions, and the development of artificial intelligence platforms and infrastructure, aiming to enhance operational efficiency and drive growth for clients across multiple industries. The company was founded on May 29, 2012 and is headquartered in Shanghai, China.
info.description_zh: AIOS Tech, Inc.正在進行策略轉型計劃，將自身重新定位為人工智慧和技術驅動的專業服務提供者。該公司為各種商業客戶群提供創新的資訊技術解決方案、先進的數據服務和人工智慧驅動的產品。核心業務涵蓋數位轉型服務、金融業客製化IT解決方案、企業數據解決方案以及人工智慧平台和基礎設施開發，旨在提升各產業客戶的營運效率並推動成長。公司成立於2012年5月29日，總部位於中國上海。

info.description: Greenlane Holdings, Inc. engages in acquisition, staking, validator participation, and strategic deployment of digital assets. It operates through the following segments: Wholesale and Distribution and Digital Assets. The Wholesale and Distribution segment includes legacy e-commerce and drop-ship operations. The Digital Assets segment focuses on activities including acquisition, staking and validator participation. The company was founded by Aaron LoCascio in 2005 and is headquartered in Boca Raton, FL.
info.description_zh: Greenlane Holdings, Inc. 從事數位資產的收購、質押、驗證者參與和策略部署。它透過以下部門運作：批發和分銷部門以及數位資產部門。批發和分銷部門包括傳統的電子商務和代發貨業務。數位資產部門專注於收購、質押和驗證者參與等活動。該公司由 Aaron LoCascio 於 2005 年創立，總部位於佛羅裡達州博卡拉頓。

info.description: EpicQuest Education Group International Ltd. engages in the provision of education solutions for domestic and international university students. It operates through the Foreign Language Education and Professional Training Programs. The company was founded by Jian Bo Zhang on December 13, 2017 and is headquartered in Toledo, OH.
info.description_zh: EpicQuest Education Group International Ltd.致力於為國內外大學生提供教育解決方案。它透過外語教育和專業培訓計畫運作。該公司由張建波於2017年12月13日創立，總部位於俄亥俄州托萊多。

info.description: Expion360, Inc. engages in the design, assembly, manufacturing and sale of lithium iron phosphate batteries and supporting accessories. It primarily focuses on the recreational vehicles and marine industries. The company was founded by John Yozamp and Paul Shoun on June 16, 2016 and is headquartered in Redmond, OR.
info.description_zh: Expion360, Inc.從事磷酸鐵鋰電池及配套配件的設計、組裝、製造和銷售。它主要專注於休閒車和海洋工業。該公司由 John Yozamp 和 Paul Shoun 於 2016 年 6 月 16 日創立，總部位於俄勒岡州雷德蒙德。

info.description: ARB IOT Group Ltd. is a holding company that engages in the provision of solutions for the integration of IoT systems and devices. It operates through the Internet of Things and Investment Holding and Others segments. The company was founded on March 1, 2022 and is headquartered in Singapore.
info.description_zh: ARB IOT Group Ltd.是一家控股公司，致力於提供物聯網系統和設備整合解決方案。它透過物聯網和投資控股及其他部門運作。該公司成立於2022年3月1日，總部位於新加坡。

info.description: Republic Power Group Ltd. operates as a provider of ERP software solutions, consulting and technical support services, and peripheral hardware to large and SME clients and government agencies based in Singapore and Malaysia. It is focused on delivering customized ERP systems for airports, cruise terminals, technology companies. The company was founded on November 17, 2021 and is headquartered in Singapore.
info.description_zh: Republic Power Group Ltd. 是一家為新加坡和馬來西亞的大型和中小企業客戶以及政府機構提供 ERP 軟體解決方案、諮詢和技術支援服務以及外圍硬體的供應商。它專注於為機場、郵輪碼頭、科技公司提供客製化的 ERP 系統。該公司成立於2021年11月17日，總部位於新加坡。

info.description: Xos, Inc. is a provider of energy storage and fleet electrification solutions. It develops battery-electric commercial vehicles and mobile power systems designed for rapid deployment charging and lower total cost of ownership compared to internal combustion engine vehicles. The company was founded by Dakota Semler and Giordano Sordoni on July 29, 2020 and is headquartered in Los Angeles, CA.
info.description_zh: Xos, Inc. 是一家能源儲存和車隊電氣化解決方案提供商。該公司開發電池電動商用車和行動電源系統，旨在實現快速部署充電並比內燃機車降低總擁有成本。該公司由 Dakota Semler 和 Giordano Sordoni 於 2020 年 7 月 29 日創立，總部位於加州洛杉磯。

info.description: Autozi Internet Technology (Global) Ltd. is a holding company, which engages in the provision of lifecycle automotive services. It operates through the following segments: New Car Sales, Auto Parts and Auto Accessories Sales, and Automotive Insurance Related Services. The New Car Sales segment offers parallel import car and new energy vehicle (NEV). The Auto Parts and Auto Accessories Sales segment conducts business primarily to auto part dealers and gradually upgrade to directly connect to local multiple-brand-service (MBS) stores. The Automotive Insurance Related Services segment refers to the value-added maintenance, claim and repair, and insurance intermediation services. The company was founded by Hou Qi Zhang in 2010 and is headquartered in Beijing, China.
info.description_zh: Autozi互聯網科技（全球）有限公司是一家控股公司，從事提供汽車全生命週期服務。它透過以下部門運作：新車銷售、汽車零件和汽車配件銷售以及汽車保險相關服務。新車銷售部門提供平行進口汽車和新能源汽車（NEV）。汽車零配件銷售板塊主要針對汽車零配件經銷商開展業務，並逐步升級為直連當地多品牌服務（MBS）店。汽車保險相關服務部門是指加值保養、索賠和維修以及保險中介服務。該公司由張侯奇於2010年創立，總部位於中國北京。

info.description: FreeCast, Inc. operates an online video streaming platform. Its cloud entertainment platform comprises the largest aggregated library of free and pay-per-view video-on-demand, streaming channels, live events, radio stations, music videos and online games. The company was founded by William A. Mobley, Jr. on June 21, 2011 and is headquartered in Orlando, FL.
info.description_zh: FreeCast, Inc. 經營一個線上影片串流平台。其雲端娛樂平台包括最大的免費和按次付費視訊點播、串流頻道、現場活動、廣播電台、音樂視訊和線上遊戲的聚合庫。該公司由 William A. Mobley, Jr. 於 2011 年 6 月 21 日創立，總部位於佛羅裡達州奧蘭多。

info.description: SKK Holdings Ltd. operates as a holding company, which engages in the provision of civil engineering services in subsurface utility works, including power and telecommunication cable laying, water pipeline and sewer rehabilitation works. The company was founded by Chun Seong Ng and Koon Kiat Sze on October 16, 2013 and is headquartered in Singapore.
info.description_zh: SKK Holdings Ltd.作為一家控股公司運營，從事提供地下公用事業工程的土木工程服務，包括電力和電信電纜鋪設、供水管道和下水道修復工程。該公司由Chun Seong Ng和Koon Kiat Sze於2013年10月16日創立，總部位於新加坡。

info.description: Borealis Foods, Inc. is an integrated food manufacturing company, which engages in the production of ready-to-eat meals and dry soup products. The company offers ramen noodle brands including Chef Woo, Ramen Express, and Woodles. It partners with national and international food producers, retailers, and distributors. Borealis Foods was founded by Reza Soltanzadeh and Barthelemy Helg in July 2019 and is headquartered in Oakville, Canada.
info.description_zh: Borealis Foods, Inc.是一家綜合食品製造公司，從事即食食品和乾湯產品的生產。該公司提供拉麵品牌，包括 Chef Woo、Ramen Express 和 Woodles。它與國內外食品生產商、零售商和分銷商合作。 Borealis Foods 由 Reza Soltanzadeh 和 Barthelemy Helg 於 2019 年 7 月創立，總部位於加拿大奧克維爾。

info.description: Super League Enterprise, Inc. creates innovative and immersive entertainment experiences, platform and audience monetization and dynamic content feeding channels across the world's top gaming platforms. Fueled by an insatiable desire to stay on the forefront of this ever-evolving meta landscape, Super League pioneer's proprietary digital solutions provide unparalleled access to the global gaming audience. It also creates vibrant in-game communities through the development of innovative experiences and custom content, delivering powerful opportunities for brands and advertisers to achieve impactful insights, and marketing outcomes with audiences of all ages. The company was founded by John C. Miller, David Steigelfest, and Brett Morris on October 1, 2014 and is headquartered in Santa Monica, CA.
info.description_zh: Super League Enterprise, Inc. 在全球頂級遊戲平台上創造創新和沈浸式娛樂體驗、平台和受眾貨幣化以及動態內容供給管道。在不斷發展的元景觀中保持領先地位的永不滿足的願望的推動下，超級聯賽先鋒的專有數位解決方案為全球遊戲觀眾提供了無與倫比的訪問機會。它還透過開發創新體驗和客製化內容來創建充滿活力的遊戲內社區，為品牌和廣告商提供強大的機會，以獲得有影響力的見解，並為所有年齡段的受眾帶來行銷成果。該公司由 John C. Miller、David Steigelfest 和 Brett Morris 於 2014 年 10 月 1 日創立，總部位於加州聖莫尼卡。

info.description: Generation Income Properties, Inc. is a real estate investment company, which engages in the acquisition and management of retail, office, and industrial properties net leased to tenants. The company was founded by David Sobelman in September 2015 and is headquartered in Tampa, FL.
info.industry_zh: 房地產投資信託基金 - 多元化
info.description_zh: Generation Income Properties, Inc.是一家房地產投資公司，從事收購和管理淨租賃給租戶的零售、辦公和工業房地產。該公司由 David Sobelman 於 2015 年 9 月創立，總部位於佛羅裡達州坦帕。

info.description: Sadot Group, Inc. is a global food supply chain company that helps connect agricultural producers and consumers worldwide. It sources and trades commodities such as soybean meal, wheat, and corn, while also operating farms that produce grains and tree crops in Southern Africa. The company procures products from regions including the Americas, Africa, and the Black Sea, and supplies them to markets across Southeast Asia, China, and the Middle East and North Africa (MENA) region. The company was founded by Rodney C. Silva on October 25, 2019 and is headquartered in Burleson, TX.

Its core products include the BesTrade DeAI Agent and the AIxC ecosystem products. The company was founded on March 29, 2004 and is headquartered in Carlsbad, CA.
info.description_zh: AIxCrypto Holdings, Inc.致力於建立一個融合人工智慧和區塊鏈、連接Web2和Web3的生態系統。其核心產品包括BesTrade DeAI Agent和AIxC生態產品。該公司成立於2004年3月29日，總部位於加州卡爾斯巴德。

info.description: iSpecimen, Inc. is a healthcare organization that engages in procurement of human biospecimen. It collects biofluids, human tissue, hematopoietic stem, and immune cells. The company was founded by Christopher Ianelli in 2009 and is headquartered in Woburn, MA.
info.description_zh: iSpecimen, Inc. 是一家從事人體生物樣本採購的醫療保健組織。它收集生物體液、人體組織、造血幹細胞和免疫細胞。該公司由 Christopher Ianelli 於 2009 年創立，總部位於馬薩諸塞州沃本。

info.description: Jianzhi Education Technology Group Co., Ltd. engages in the provision of educational content and information technology (IT) solutions. It operates through the IT Related Solution Services and Educational Content Service segments. The IT Related Solutions Services segment offers IT related solution services such as software solutions and customizes intelligent solutions, and related services including maintenance and technical support services. The Educational Content segment covers the provision and licensing of educational content. The company was founded by Pei Xuan Wang in May 2011 and is headquartered in Beijing, China.
info.description_zh: 建智教育科技集團股份有限公司從事提供教育內容與資訊科技（IT）解決方案。它透過 IT 相關解決方案服務和教育內容服務部門運作。 IT相關解決方案服務部門提供軟體解決方案和客製化智慧解決方案等IT相關解決方案服務，以及維護和技術支援服務等相關服務。教育內容部門涵蓋教育內容的提供與許可。該公司由王培軒於2011年5月創立，總部位於中國北京。

info.description: E-Home Household Service Holdings Ltd. engages in the operation of household services. It operates through the following segments: Installation and Maintenance Services, Housekeeping Services, Senior Care Services, and Educational Consulting Services. The company was founded by Wen Shan Xie in 2014 and is headquartered in Fuzhou City, China.
info.description_zh: 易家家居服務控股有限公司從事家居服務經營。它透過以下部門運作：安裝和維護服務、家事服務、高級護理服務和教育諮詢服務。該公司由謝文山於2014年創立，總部位於中國福州市。

info.description: Rising Dragon Acquisition Corp. is a blank check company. It was formed for the purpose of entering into a merger, share exchange, asset acquisition, share purchase, recapitalization, reorganization or similar business combination with one or more businesses. The company was founded on March 8, 2024 and is headquartered in Taiyuan, China.
info.description_zh: Rising Dragon Acquisition Corp. 是一家空白支票公司。它的成立目的是與一個或多個企業進行合併、股份交換、資產收購、股份購買、資本重組、重組或類似的業務合併。該公司成立於2024年3月8日，總部位於中國太原。

info.description: Tenon Medical, Inc. is a medical device company, which engages in the development of a minimally invasive approach to the sacroiliac joint (SI joint) using a single titanium implant for treatment of the most common types of SI Joint disorders. The company was founded by Richard Ferrari and Richard Ginn on June 19, 2012 and is headquartered in Los Gatos, CA.
info.description_zh: Tenon Medical, Inc. 是一家醫療器材公司，致力於開發骶髂關節（SI 關節）微創方法，使用單一鈦植入物來治療最常見的 SI 關節疾病。該公司由 Richard Ferrari 和 Richard Ginn 於 2012 年 6 月 19 日創立，總部位於加利福尼亞州洛斯加托斯。

info.description: Canary XRP ETF seeks to provide exposure to the value of XRP held by the Trust, less the expenses of the Trust's operations and other liabilities and establish its net asset value ("NAV") by reference to the CoinDesk XRP CCIXber 60m New York Rate. The Trust intends to provide direct exposure to the value of XRP held by the Trust with Gemini Trust Company, LLC (the "Gemini Custodian") and BitGo Trust Company, Inc. The Gemini Custodian is a New York limited purpose trust company regulated by the New York Department of Financial Services that provides custody services for digital assets.
info.description_zh: Canary XRP ETF 旨在提供信託持有的 XRP 價值的曝險，減去信託營運費用和其他負債，並參考 CoinDesk XRP CCIXber 60m 紐約匯率確定其資產淨值（「NAV」）。該信託計劃與 Gemini Trust Company, LLC（「Gemini Custodian」）和 BitGo Trust Company, Inc. 直接接觸該信託持有的 XRP 價值。 Gemini Custodian 是一家受紐約金融服務部監管的紐約有限目的信託公司，為數位資產提供託管服務。

info.description: XRP ETF seeks long-term capital appreciation. The fund is an exchange-traded fund ("ETF") that seeks to achieve its investment objective primarily though managed exposure to XRP futures contracts that trade only on an exchange registered with the Commodity Futures Trading Commission ("XRP Futures Contracts"), and cash, cash-like instruments or high quality securities that serve as collateral to the fund's investments in XRP Futures Contracts ("Collateral Investments"). The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: XRP ETF 尋求長期資本增值。該基金是一檔交易所交易基金（「ETF」），主要透過管理 XRP 期貨合約（僅在商品期貨交易委員會註冊的交易所交易）（「XRP 期貨合約」）以及作為基金 XRP 期貨合約投資抵押品的現金、類現金工具或高品質證券（「抵押投資」）來實現其投資目標。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Modular Medical, Inc. is a development stage company, which engages in the provision of insulin pump technology. It focuses on the design, development, and commercialization of insulin pumps to serve the diabetes market. The company was founded by Paul M. DiPerna on October 22, 1998 and is headquartered in San Diego, CA.
info.description_zh: Modular Medical, Inc. 是一家處於開發階段的公司，致力於提供胰島素幫浦技術。它專注於胰島素幫浦的設計、開發和商業化，以服務糖尿病市場。該公司由 Paul M. DiPerna 於 1998 年 10 月 22 日創立，總部位於加利福尼亞州聖地亞哥。

info.description: 21Shares Dogecoin ETF is a passively managed exchange-traded fund that provides direct, physically backed exposure to the digital asset Dogecoin (DOGE). The Trust functions as a transparent investment vehicle, holding Dogecoin in institutional-grade custody to allow investors to participate in the price movements of the cryptocurrency without the complexities of managing digital wallets or private keys.
info.description_zh: 21Shares Dogecoin ETF 是一種被動管理的交易所交易基金，提供直接、實物支持的數位資產狗狗幣 (DOGE) 曝險。該信託基金作為一種透明的投資工具，以機構級託管方式持有狗狗幣，使投資者能夠參與加密貨幣的價格變動，而無需管理數位錢包或私鑰的複雜性。

info.description: 21Shares Canton Network ETF seeks investment results, before fees and expenses, that correspond to the price performance of Canton Coin (CC), the native utility token used to pay traffic fees on the Canton Network. The fund executes its strategy by allocating at least 80% of net assets directly to Canton Coin or related financial instruments that mirror its spot performance, including a minimum 40% structural floor dedicated to registered and non-U.S. exchange-traded products providing direct cryptocurrency exposure.
info.description_zh: 21Shares Canton Network ETF 尋求在費用和支出之前與 Canton Coin (CC) 的價格表現相對應的投資結果，Canton Coin (CC) 是用於支付 Canton Network 流量費的原生實用代幣。該基金透過將至少 80% 的淨資產直接分配給 Canton Coin 或反映其現貨表現的相關金融工具來執行其策略，其中至少 40% 的結構底線專門用於提供直接加密貨幣敞口的註冊和非美國交易所交易產品。

info.description: Nuvectis Pharma, Inc. is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company, which focuses on the development of innovative precision medicines for the treatment of serious conditions of unmet medical need in oncology. Its product pipeline includes NXP800 and NXP900. The company was founded by Ronald E. Bentsur, Enrique Poradosu, and Shay Shemesh on July 27, 2020 and is headquartered in Fort Lee, NJ.
info.description_zh: Nuvectis Pharma, Inc.是一家臨床階段的生物製藥公司，專注於開發創新精準藥物，用於治療腫瘤學中未滿足醫療需求的嚴重病症。其產品線包括NXP800和NXP900。該公司由 Ronald E. Bentsur、Enrique Poradosu 和 Shay Shemesh 於 2020 年 7 月 27 日創立，總部位於新澤西州李堡。

info.description: Leverage Shares 2X Long VALE Daily ETF is an actively managed fund targeting 200% of the daily performance of the common stock of Vale S.A. (VALE). The strategy is a tactical instrument for sophisticated traders, utilizing financial derivatives to provide magnified daily exposure to the underlying global leader in iron ore and nickel production.
info.description_zh: Leverage Shares 2X Long VALE Daily ETF 是一檔主動式管理基金，目標為 Vale S.A. (VALE) 普通股每日表現的 200%。該策略是成熟交易者的戰術工具，利用金融衍生性商品來擴大每日對鐵礦石和鎳生產的全球領導者的曝險。

info.description: EZCORP, Inc. engages in the provision of pawn services. The firm also sells merchandise, primarily collateral forfeited from pawn lending operations and used merchandise purchased from customers. It operates through the following segments: U.S. Pawn, Latin America Pawn, and Other Investments. The U.S. Pawn segment includes EZPAWN, Value Pawn and Jewelry, and other branded pawn operations. The Latin America Pawn segment consists of Empeno Facil, Cash Apoyo Efectivo, and other branded pawn operations in Mexico, as well as GuatePrenda and MaxiEfectivo pawn operations in Guatemala, El Salvador, and Honduras. The company was founded in 1989 and is headquartered in Rollingwood, TX.
info.description_zh: EZCORP, Inc. 從事提供當鋪服務。該公司還銷售商品，主要是典當貸款業務中沒收的抵押品和從客戶那裡購買的二手商品。它透過以下部門運作：美國典當部門、拉丁美洲典當部門和其他投資部門。美國典當部門包括 EZPAWN、Value Pawn and Jewelry 以及其他品牌典當業務。拉丁美洲典當部門包括墨西哥的 Empeno Facil、Cash Apoyo Efectivo 和其他品牌典當業務，以及危地馬拉、薩爾瓦多和洪都拉斯的 GuatePrenda 和 MaxiEfectivo 典當業務。該公司成立於 1989 年，總部位於德克薩斯州羅林伍德。

info.description: Canary Staked SUI ETF is a spot digital asset exchange-traded product that provides regulated exposure to the price of SUI, the native token of the Sui Layer-1 blockchain, while simultaneously participating in the network's proof-of-stake validation process. The fund enables investors to capture both the price performance of SUI and net in-kind staking rewards, which are reflected in the fund's net asset value (NAV) without the need for direct digital wallet management.
info.description_zh: Canary Staked SUI ETF 是一種現貨數位資產交易所交易產品，提供受監管的 SUI（Sui Layer-1 區塊鏈的原生代幣）價格曝險，同時參與網路的權益證明驗證過程。該基金使投資者能夠捕獲 SUI 的價格表現和淨實物質押獎勵，這些獎勵反映在基金的資產淨值（NAV）中，而無需直接數位錢包管理。

info.description: GraniteShares Autocallable COIN ETF seeks to generate current monthly income while providing limited downside protection by investing in a laddered, rolling portfolio of single-stock autocallable option-linked derivatives. The fund executes its defined-income strategy primarily through over-the-counter or exchange-traded derivatives that utilize the common stock of Coinbase Global, Inc. as their single reference asset.
info.description_zh: GraniteShares Autocallable COIN ETF 旨在透過投資單股可自動贖回選擇權掛鉤衍生性商品的階梯式滾動投資組合，在產生當前每月收入的同時提供有限的下行保護。該基金主要透過場外交易或交易所交易的衍生性商品來執行其固定收益策略，這些衍生性商品利用 Coinbase Global, Inc. 的普通股作為其單一參考資產。

info.description: Able View Global, Inc. is a brand management company, which engages in marketing strategy, branding, digital and social marketing, omni-channel sales, customer service, and overseas logistics. The company was founded in 2022 and is headquartered in Shanghai, China.
info.description_zh: Able View Global, Inc.是一家品牌管理公司，從事行銷策略、品牌推廣、數位和社交行銷、全通路銷售、客戶服務和海外物流。該公司成立於2022年，總部位於中國上海。

info.description: Black Rock Coffee Bar, Inc. is a holding company, which engages in the provision of caffeinated beverages. It offers roasted coffees, teas, smoothies, and flavorful energy drinks. The company was founded by Daniel Brand, Jeff Hernandez, Jake Spellmeyer, and Bryan Pereboom in 2008 and is headquartered in Scottsdale, AZ.
info.description_zh: Black Rock Coffee Bar, Inc. 是一家控股公司，從事含咖啡因飲料的供應業務。它提供烘焙咖啡、茶、冰沙和美味的能量飲料。該公司由 Daniel Brand、Jeff Hernandez、Jake Spellmeyer 和 Bryan Pereboom 於 2008 年創立，總部位於亞利桑那州斯科茨代爾。

info.description: Horizon Kinetics Medical ETF seeks to provide long-term growth of capital. The fund is an actively-managed exchange-traded fund ("ETF") that pursues its investment objective by investing, under normal circumstances, at least 80% of its net assets plus any borrowings for investment purposes in common stocks, convertible securities, warrants and other equity securities having the characteristics of common stocks of U.S. and foreign companies engaged in medical research, pharmaceutical and medical technology industries and related technology industries. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Horizo​​n Kinetics Medical ETF 致力於提供長期的資本成長。該基金是一種主動管理的交易所交易基金（「ETF」），在正常情況下，透過將至少80%的淨資產加上任何用於投資目的的借款投資於從事醫學研究、製藥和醫療技術行業及相關技術行業的美國和外國公司的普通股、可轉換證券、認股權證和其他具有普通股特徵的股本證券來實現其投資目標。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Gladstone Land Corp. is an agricultural real estate investment trust, which engages in the business of owning and leasing farmland. It also includes farm-related facilities, such as cooling facilities, packinghouses, processing facilities, and various storage facilities. The company was founded by David John Gladstone on June 14, 1997 and is headquartered in McLean, VA.
info.industry_zh: 房地產投資信託基金 - 專業
info.description_zh: Gladstone Land Corp.是一家農業房地產投資信託公司，從事擁有和租賃農地的業務。它還包括與農場相關的設施，如冷卻設施、包裝廠、加工設施和各種儲存設施。該公司由 David John Gladstone 於 1997 年 6 月 14 日創立，總部位於維吉尼亞州麥克萊恩。

info.description: Intellia Therapeutics, Inc. is a biopharmaceutical company, which engages in the development of curative therapeutics using the CRISPR/Cas9 system. Its CRISPR/Cas9 system transforms medicine by both producing therapeutics that permanently edit and/or correct disease-associated genes in the human body with a single treatment course and creates engineered cells that can treat oncological and immunological diseases. The company was founded by Andrew May, Luciano Marraffini, Rodolphe Barrangou, Nessan Bermingham, Rachel Haurwitz, Erik Sontheimer, Jennifer Doudna and Derrick Rossi in May 2014 and is headquartered in Cambridge, MA.

info.description: Chipotle Mexican Grill, Inc. engages in the business of developing and operating restaurants that serve a relevant menu of burritos, burrito bowls, quesadillas, tacos, and salads made using fresh, high-quality ingredients. The company was founded by Steve Ells in 1993 and is headquartered in Newport Beach, CA.
info.description_zh: Chipotle Mexican Grill, Inc. 從事開發和經營餐廳業務，這些餐廳提供墨西哥捲餅、墨西哥捲餅碗、墨西哥玉米餅、炸玉米餅和沙拉等相關菜單，均採用新鮮優質原料製成。該公司由 Steve Ells 於 1993 年創立，總部位於加州紐波特海灘。

info.description: Johnson & Johnson is a holding company, which engages in the research, development, manufacture, and sale of products in the healthcare field. It operates through the Innovative Medicine and MedTech segments. The Innovative Medicine segment focuses on immunology, infectious diseases, neuroscience, oncology, cardiovascular and metabolism, and pulmonary hypertension. The MedTech segment includes a portfolio of products used in interventional solutions, orthopaedics, surgery, and vision categories. The company was founded by Robert Wood Johnson I, James Wood Johnson, and Edward Mead Johnson Sr. in 1887 and is headquartered in New Brunswick, NJ.
info.description_zh: 強生公司是一家控股公司，從事醫療保健領域產品的研究、開發、製造和銷售。它透過創新醫學和醫療技術部門運作。創新醫學部門專注於免疫學、傳染病、神經科學、腫瘤學、心血管和代謝以及肺動脈高壓。醫療技術部門包括用於介入解決方案、骨科、手術和視覺類別的產品組合。該公司由 Robert Wood Johnson I、James Wood Johnson 和 Edward Mead Johnson Sr. 於 1887 年創立，總部位於新澤西州新不倫瑞克省。

info.description: First Trust Latin America AlphaDEX Fund seeks investment results that correspond generally to the price and yield (before the fund's fees and expenses) of an equity index called the NASDAQ AlphaDEX Latin America Index. The fund will normally invest at least 90% of its net assets (including investment borrowings) in the securities that comprise the index. The index is designed to select stocks from the NASDAQ Latin America Index (the "base index") that may generate positive alpha, or risk-adjusted returns, relative to traditional indices through the use of the AlphaDEX selection methodology.

info.description: GraniteShares YieldBOOST MARA ETF seeks to achieve 2 times (200%) the income generated from selling options on MARA Holdings Inc.'s common stock (NASDAQ: MARA) (the "Underlying Stock") by selling options on leveraged exchange-traded funds designed to deliver 2 times (200%) the daily performance of the Underlying Stock and to gain exposure to the performance of the Underlying Leveraged ETF, subject to a cap on potential investment gains. The fund will invest at least 80% of its net assets (plus any borrowings for investment purposes) in derivatives contracts that utilize the Underlying Leveraged ETF as their reference asset. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: GraniteShares YieldBOOST MARA ETF 尋求透過出售槓桿交易所交易基金的選擇權來實現 2 倍 (200%) 的收入，該收益是透過出售 MARA Holdings Inc. 普通股（NASDAQ：MARA）（「基礎股票」）選擇權產生的，該基金旨在實現基礎股票每日表現的 2 倍（200%）金額（200%）的風險該基金將至少 80% 的淨資產（加上任何用於投資目的的借款）投資於以基礎槓桿 ETF 作為參考資產的衍生性合約。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: First Trust Emerging Markets Equity Select ETF seeks investment results that correspond generally to the price and yield (before the fund's fees and expenses) of an equity index called the Nasdaq Riskalyze Emerging Markets TM Index. The fund will normally invest at least 90% of its net assets in the securities that comprise the index. The index is designed to select low volatility securities issued by companies operating in emerging market countries.
info.description_zh: First Trust Emerging Markets Equity Select ETF 尋求的投資結果通常與名為 Nasdaq Riskalyze Emerging Markets TM Index 的股票指數的價格和收益率（基金費用和開支之前）相對應。該基金通常將至少 90% 的淨資產投資於構成該指數的證券。該指數旨在選擇在新興市場國家營運的公司發行的低波動性證券。

info.description: iShares iBonds Dec 2054 Term Treasury ETF seeks to track the investment results of the ICE 2054 Maturity US Treasury Index. The fund seeks to meet its investment objective generally by investing in individual securities which satisfy the criteria of the index. The underlying index consists of publicly-issued U.S. Treasury securities that are scheduled to mature between January 1, 2054 and December 15, 2054, inclusive.
info.description_zh: iShares iBonds Dec 2054 定期公債 ETF 旨在追蹤 ICE 2054 年到期美國公債指數的投資結果。該基金通常透過投資於滿足指數標準的個別證券來實現其投資目標。標的指數由公開發行的美國國債組成，計劃於 2054 年 1 月 1 日至 2054 年 12 月 15 日（含）之間到期。

info.description: GraniteShares Autocallable MARA ETF is an actively managed exchange-traded fund that seeks current income by investing at least 80% of its net assets in derivative contracts utilizing autocallable instruments that reference the common stock of MARA Holdings, Inc. The strategy aims to deliver monthly distributions while managing cash balances through U.S. government securities, money market funds, short-term bond ETFs, investment-grade corporate debt, repurchase agreements, or national exchange-listed U.S. large-cap equities.
info.description_zh: GraniteShares Autocallable MARA ETF 是一款主動管理的交易所交易基金，透過將至少 80% 的淨資產投資於利用可自動贖回工具（參考 MARA Holdings, Inc. 普通股）的衍生性商品合約來尋求當期收入。該策略旨在透過美國政府證券、貨幣市場基金、短期債券 ETF、投資等級公司債務、回購協議或在國家交易所上市的美國大盤股管理現金餘額，同時提供每月分配股票。

info.description: Intensity Therapeutics, Inc. is a clinical-stage biotechnology company, which develops novel immune-based therapeutic products for cancer treatment. Its product, INT230-6, is a formulation consisting of an amphiphilic cell penetration enhancer molecule combined with cisplatin and vinblastine. The company was founded by Lewis H. Bender in 2012 and is headquartered in Shelton, CT.
info.description_zh: Intensity Therapeutics, Inc.是一家臨床階段生物技術公司，開發用於癌症治療的新型免疫治療產品。其產物INT230-6是一種由兩親性細胞滲透增強劑分子與順鉑和長春花鹼組合而成的製劑。該公司由 Lewis H. Bender 於 2012 年創立，總部位於康乃狄克州謝爾頓。

info.description: WEBs Defined Volatility XLF ETF seeks to provide investment results that, before fees and expenses, correspond to the performance of the Syntax Defined Volatility XLF Index. The index is a rules-based strategy that seeks to track the net asset value of a portfolio of securities of companies in the financial sector of the large-cap U.S. equity market. The fund implements its investment objective by investing, under normal market conditions, at least 80% of its net assets (including borrowings for investment purposes) in financial instruments that achieve the investment results of the index. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: WEBs Defined Volatility XLF ETF 力求提供扣除費用和開支先前與 Syntax Defined Volatility XLF 指數表現相對應的投資結果。該指數是一種基於規則的策略，旨在追蹤美國大型股票市場金融領域公司的證券投資組合的資產淨值。該基金透過在正常市場條件下將至少80%的淨資產（包括用於投資目的的借款）投資於實現指數投資結果的金融工具來實現其投資目標。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: PIMCO Mortgage-Backed Securities Active Exchange-Traded Fund seeks maximum total return, consistent with preservation of capital and prudent investment management. The fund seeks to achieve its investment objective by investing under normal circumstances at least 80% of its assets in a diversified portfolio of mortgage-related fixed income instruments of varying maturities, which may be represented by forwards or derivatives such as options, futures contracts or swap agreements.
info.description_zh: PIMCO 抵押貸款支援證券活躍交易所交易基金尋求最大總回報，與資本保全和審慎投資管理一致。該基金尋求透過在正常情況下將至少 80% 的資產投資於不同期限的抵押貸款相關固定收益工具的多元化投資組合來實現其投資目標，這些投資組合可能以遠期或衍生性商品（如選擇權、期貨合約或掉期協議）為代表。

info.description: Vanguard Core-Plus Bond Index ETF seeks to track the performance of the Bloomberg U.S. Universal Float Adjusted Index. The fund employs an indexing investment approach designed to track the performance of the index, which measures the performance of U.S. dollar-denominated, taxable bonds that are rated either investment-grade or high-yield as determined by the index provider. The fund invests by sampling the index, meaning that it holds a range of securities that, in the aggregate, approximates the full index in terms of key risk factors and other characteristics. The fund seeks to maintain a dollar-weighted average maturity consistent with that of the index.
info.description_zh: Vanguard Core-Plus Bond Index ETF 旨在追蹤彭博美國通用浮動調整指數的表現。該基金採用指數投資方法，旨在追蹤指數的表現，該方法衡量以美元計價的應稅債券的表現，這些債券的評級由指數提供者確定為投資級或高收益。該基金透過對指數進行抽樣進行投資，這意味著它持有一系列證券，這些證券總體上在關鍵風險因素和其他特徵方面接近完整指數。該基金力求維持與指數一致的美元加權平均期限。

info.description: VanEck Financials TruSector ETF is an actively managed exchange-traded fund designed to provide comprehensive, uncapped exposure to the financials sector by utilizing a hybrid investment approach. The fund addresses the limitations of traditional market-cap-weighted sector indexes-which often underweight the largest constituents to maintain regulatory compliance-by combining direct equity investments with targeted sector ETFs to more accurately reflect the sector's true market-capitalization composition.
info.description_zh: VanEck Financials TruSector ETF 是一款主動管理的交易所交易基金，旨在透過利用混合投資方式提供全面、無上限的金融業投資。該基金透過將直接股權投資與目標產業 ETF 結合，解決了傳統市值加權產業指數的局限性（該指數通常會低估最大的成分股以維持監管合規性），以更準確地反映該行業的真實市值組成。

info.description: ClearThink 1 Acquisition Corp. is a blank check company incorporated for the purpose of effecting a merger, amalgamation, share exchange, asset acquisition, share purchase, reorganization or similar business combination with one or more businesses or entities. The company was founded on September 11, 2025 and is headquartered in Boca Raton, FL.
info.description_zh: ClearThink 1 Acquisition Corp. 是一家空白支票公司，其註冊目的是與一個或多個企業或實體進行合併、合併、股份交換、資產收購、股份購買、重組或類似業務合併。該公司成立於 2025 年 9 月 11 日，總部位於佛羅裡達州博卡拉頓。

info.description: Beam Therapeutics, Inc. is a biotechnology company, which engages in the establishment of integrated platform for precision genetic medicines. Its pipeline includes BEAM-101, BEAM-302, Engineered Stem Cell Antibody Paired Evasion (ESCAPE), BEAM-301, and BEAM-201. The company was founded by David R. Liu, Feng Zhang, Alexis Komor, Nicole Gaudelli, and J. Keith Joung on January 25, 2017 and is headquartered in Cambridge, MA.
info.description_zh: Beam Therapeutics, Inc.是一家致力於精準基因藥物綜合平台建置的生物科技公司。其管道包括BEAM-101、BEAM-302、工程幹細胞抗體配對規避（ESCAPE）、BEAM-301和BEAM-201。該公司由 David R. Liu、Feng Zhang、Alexis Komor、Nicole Gaudelli 和 J. Keith Joung 於 2017 年 1 月 25 日創立，總部位於馬薩諸塞州劍橋。

info.description: iShares USD Green Bond ETF seeks to track the investment results of the Bloomberg MSCI USD Green Bond Select Index composed of U.S. dollar-denominated investment-grade green bonds that are issued by U.S. and non-U.S. issuers to fund environmental projects. The fund seeks to track the investment results of the underlying index, which measures the performance of U.S. dollar-denominated investment-grade green bonds issued by U.S. and non-U.S. issuers to fund projects with direct environmental benefits.
info.description_zh: iShares 美元綠色債券 ETF 旨在追蹤彭博 MSCI 美元綠色債券精選指數的投資結果，該指數由美國和非美國發行人發行的以美元計價的投資級綠色債券組成，為環保項目提供資金。該基金旨在追蹤基礎指數的投資結果，該指數衡量美國和非美國發行人為資助具有直接環境效益的項目而發行的以美元計價的投資級綠色債券的表現。

info.description: Blackrock Total Return ETF seeks to realize a total return that exceeds that of the Bloomberg U.S. Aggregate Bond Index. The fund typically invests more than 90% of its assets in a diversified portfolio of fixed-income securities such as corporate bonds and notes, mortgage-backed securities, asset-backed securities, convertible securities, preferred securities and government obligations. Both U.S. and foreign companies and governments may issue these securities. Under normal circumstances, the fund invests primarily in fixed-income securities. It may invest in fixed-income securities of any duration or maturity.
info.description_zh: 貝萊德總回報 ETF 力求實現超過彭博美國綜合債券指數的總回報。該基金通常將其90%以上的資產投資於固定收益證券的多元化投資組合，例如公司債和票據、抵押貸款支持證券、資產支持證券、可轉換證券、優先證券和政府債券。美国和外国公司和政府都可以发行这些证券。一般情況下，基金主要投資於固定收益證券。它可以投資於任何期限或期限的固定收益證券。

info.description: Invesco BulletShares 2034 Corporate Bond ETF seeks to track the investment results (before fees and expenses) of the Invesco BulletShares USD Corporate Bond 2034 Index. The fund generally will invest at least 80% of its total assets in securities that comprise the underlying index. The underlying index seeks to measure the performance of a portfolio of U.S. dollar-denominated investment grade corporate bonds with maturities or, in some cases, "effective maturities" in the year 2034. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Invesco BulletShares 2034 Corporate Bond ETF 旨在追蹤 Invesco BulletShares USD Corporate Bond 2034 指數的投資結果（未計費用和支出）。該基金通常將至少 80% 的總資產投資於構成標的指數的證券。相關指數旨在衡量 2034 年到期（或在某些情況下為「有效到期」）的以美元計價的投資等級公司債投資組合的表現。該基金是非多元化的。

Morgan EMBI Global Core Index composed of U.S. dollar-denominated, emerging market bonds. The index is a broad, diverse U.S. dollar-denominated emerging markets debt benchmark that tracks the total return of actively traded external debt instruments in emerging market countries.
info.description_zh: iShares 摩根大通美元新興市場債券 ETF 旨在追蹤由以美元計價的新興市場債券組成的摩根大通 EMBI 全球核心指數的投資結果。該基金將至少 80% 的資產投資於基礎指數的組成證券，並將至少 90% 的資產投資於基礎指數所包含類型的固定收益證券。該指數是一個廣泛、多樣化的以美元計價的新興市場債務基準，追蹤新興市場國家交易活躍的外債工具的總回報。

info.description: Telefonaktiebolaget LM Ericsson engages in the provision of telecommunications equipment and related services to mobile and fixed network operators. It operates through the following segments: Networks, Cloud Software, Services, Enterprise, and Other. The Networks segment supports all radio-access technologies and offers hardware, software and related services for both radio access and transport. The Cloud Software segment offers solutions for core networks, business and operational support systems, network design and optimization, and managed network services. The Other segment refers to the media business and other non-allocated business. Segment-level information has also been presented to Other. The company was founded by Lars Magnus Ericsson in 1876 and is headquartered in Kista, Sweden.
info.description_zh: Telefonaktiebolaget LM 愛立信致力於為行動和固定網路業者提供電信設備及相關服務。它透過以下部門運作：網路、雲端軟體、服務、企業和其他。網路部門支援所有無線電存取技術，並為無線電存取和傳輸提供硬體、軟體和相關服務。雲端軟體部門提供核心網路、業務和營運支援系統、網路設計和最佳化以及託管網路服務的解決方案。其他分部是指媒體業務和其他非分配業務。段級資訊也已提交給其他人。該公司由 Lars Magnus Ericsson 於 1876 年創立，總部位於瑞典希斯塔。

info.description: iShares MSCI Brazil Small-Cap ETF seeks to track the investment results of the MSCI Brazil Small Cap Index. The fund generally will invest at least 80% of its assets in the component securities of the underlying index and in investments that have economic characteristics that are substantially identical to the component securities of the underlying index. The index is a free float-adjusted market capitalization-weighted index designed to measure primarily the performance of equity securities of small capitalization companies listed on stock exchanges in Brazil.

info.description: iShares Core Total USD Bond Market ETF seeks to track the investment results of the Bloomberg U.S. Universal Index. The fund will invest at least 80% of its assets in the component securities of the underlying index and to-be-announced transactions ("TBAs") that have economic characteristics that are substantially identical to the economic characteristics of the component securities of the underlying index. The index measures the performance of U.S. dollar-denominated taxable bonds that are rated either investment-grade or high yield.

info.description: Thornburg Core Plus Bond ETF seeks total return, consisting of income and capital appreciation. Under normal conditions, the fund invests at least 80% of its net assets, plus the amount of any borrowings for investment purposes, in debt obligations or investments that provide exposure to such debt obligations. The fund may invest up to 25% of its net assets in debt obligations which, at the time of purchase, are rated by a nationally recognized statistical rating organization as below investment grade (sometimes called "junk" bonds or "high yield" bonds). The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Thornburg Core Plus Bond ETF 尋求總回報，包括收入和資本增值。在正常情況下，該基金將至少 80% 的淨資產以及用於投資目的的任何借款金額投資於債務或提供此類債務義務的投資。該基金最多可將其淨資產的 25% 投資於債務債券，這些債券在購買時被國家認可的統計評級機構評級為低於投資等級（有時稱為「垃圾」債券或「高收益」債券）。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Angel Oak Total Return ETF seeks total return. The fund will concentrate its investments in agency and non-agency RMBS and CMBS, mortgage loans, and other securities of issuers related to mortgages and real estate ("Mortgage Related Instruments"). This means that, under normal circumstances, the fund will invest more than 25% of its assets in Mortgage Related Instruments (measured at the time of purchase). The fund will not concentrate its investments in any other group of industries. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Angel Oak Total Return ETF 追求總回報。該基金將集中投資於機構和非機構 RMBS 和 CMBS、抵押貸款以及與抵押和房地產相關的發行人的其他證券（「抵押相關工具」）。這意味著，在正常情況下，基金會將25%以上的資產投資於抵押相關工具（以購買時計量）。該基金不會將投資集中於任何其他行業。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: VictoryShares Core Plus Intermediate Bond ETF seeks high current income without undue risk to principal. Under normal circumstances, the fund invests at least 80% of its net assets in debt securities and in derivatives and other instruments that have economic characteristics similar to such securities. The fund primarily invests in securities that have a dollar-weighted average portfolio maturity between three to 10 years. The fund will invest primarily in investment-grade securities, but may invest up to 20% of its net assets in below-investment-grade securities which are sometimes referred to as high-yield or "junk" bonds.
info.description_zh: VictoryShares Core Plus Intermediate Bond ETF 追求高當期收入，且不會對本金造成不當風險。一般情況下，基金將至少80%的淨資產投資於債務證券以及具有與此類證券類似經濟特徵的衍生性商品和其他工具。該基金主要投資於美元加權平均投資組合期限為三至十年的證券。该基金将主要投资于投资级证券，但最多可将其净资产的 20% 投资于低于投资级的证券，这些证券有时被称为高收益或“垃圾”债券。

info.description: iShares Broad USD Investment Grade Corporate Bond ETF seeks to track the investment results of the ICE BofA US Corporate Index (the "underlying index"). The fund will invest at least 80% of its assets in the component securities of the underlying index, and the fund will invest at least 90% of its assets in fixed income securities of the types included in the underlying index that the advisor believes will help the fund track the underlying index. The underlying index measures the performance of investment-grade corporate bonds of both U.S. and non-U.S. issuers that are U.S. dollar-denominated and publicly issued in the U.S. domestic market.
info.description_zh: iShares Broad 美元投資等級企業債券 ETF 旨在追蹤 ICE BofA 美國企業指數（「基礎指數」）的投資結果。該基金將至少 80% 的資產投資於標的指數的組成證券，並且該基金將至少 90% 的資產投資於標的指數中包含的固定收益證券類型，顧問認為這將有助於基金追蹤標的指數。該指數衡量美國和非美國發行人在美國國內市場公開發行的以美元計價的投資等級公司債的表現。

info.description: US Treasury 30 Year Bond ETF seeks investment results that correspond (before fees and expenses) generally to the price and yield performance of the ICE BofA Current 30-Year US Treasury Index (GA30). Under normal market conditions, The adviser seeks to achieve the fund's investment objective by investing at least 80% of the fund's net assets (plus any borrowings for investment purposes) in the component securities of the underlying index. The ICE BofA Current 30-Year US Treasury Index is a one-security index comprised of the most recently issued 30-year U.S. Treasury bond.
info.description_zh: 美國 30 年期公債 ETF 尋求與 ICE 美國銀行當前 30 年期美國國債指數 (GA30) 的價格和收益率表現大致相對應的投資結果（未計費用和開支）。在正常市場條件下，顧問尋求透過將至少 80% 的基金淨資產（加上任何用於投資目的的借款）投資於標的指數的成分證券來實現基金的投資目標。 ICE BofA 目前 30 年期美國國債指數是一種單一證券指數，由最近發行的 30 年期美國國債組成。

info.description: VCI Global Ltd. engages in the provision of business consulting services. It operates through the following segments: Business Strategy Consultancy, Technology Consultancy, and Others. The Business Strategy Consultancy segment offers services relating to listing solutions, investors relations, and boardroom strategies. The Technology Consultancy segment specializes in digital development and software solutions. The company was founded in 2013 and is headquartered in Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia.
info.description_zh: VCI Global Ltd. 從事提供商業諮詢服務。它透過以下部門運作：業務策略諮詢、技術諮詢和其他。業務策略諮詢部門提供與上市解決方案、投資者關係和董事會策略相關的服務。技術諮詢部門專注於數位開發和軟體解決方案。該公司成立於2013年，總部位於馬來西亞吉隆坡。

info.description: Wisdomtree Bianco Fixed Income Total Return Fund seeks to track the price and yield performance, before fees and expenses, of the Bianco Research Fixed Income Total Return Index. Under normal circumstances, the fund primarily invests in the constituent exchange-traded funds ("ETF") of the index. The index, created by Bianco Research Advisors LLC, is composed of approximately 5 to 20 fixed income ETFs that are specifically selected and weighted using a modified market-capitalization weighting scheme to achieve specified factor exposures.
info.description_zh: Wisdomtree Bianco 固定收益總回報基金旨在追蹤 Bianco Research 固定收益總回報指數（未計費用和支出）的價格和收益率表現。一般情況下，基金主要投資於指數成分股ETF（ETF）。該指數由 Bianco Research Advisors LLC 創建，由大約 5 至 20 個固定收益 ETF 組成，這些 ETF 是專門選擇的，並使用修改後的市值加權方案進行加權，以實現指定的因子暴露。

info.description: Republic Services, Inc. engages in the provision of environmental services. It provides collection, transfer, recycling, and disposal services for non-hazardous solid waste, as well as environmental solutions services. It operates through the following segments: Group 1, Group 2, and Group 3. The Group 1 segment focuses on the business of recycling and solid waste in geographic areas located in western United States. The Group 2 segment includes the recycling and solid waste business in geographic areas located in the southeastern and mid-western and the eastern seaboard of the United States and Canada. The Group 3 segment includes environmental solutions business in geographic areas located across the United States and Canada. The company was founded in 1996 and is headquartered in Phoenix, AZ.
info.description_zh: Republic Services, Inc. 從事提供環境服務。提供無害固體廢棄物的收集、轉運、回收、處置服務以及環境解決方案服務。該公司透過以下部門運作：第 1 組、第 2 組和第 3 組。第 1 組部門專注於美國西部地理區域的回收和固體廢棄物業務。第二組部門包括位於美國和加拿大東南部、中西部和東海岸地理區域的回收和固體廢物業務。第三組部門包括位於美國和加拿大地理區域的環境解決方案業務。該公司成立於 1996 年，總部位於亞利桑那州鳳凰城。

info.description: Wen Acquisition Corp. is a blank check company. It was formed for the purpose of effecting a merger, share exchange, asset acquisition, share purchase, reorganization or similar business combination with one or more businesses. The company was founded on January 13, 2025 and is headquartered in Oakland, CA.
info.description_zh: Wen Acquisition Corp. 是一家空白支票公司。它的成立目的是與一個或多個企業進行合併、股份交換、資產收購、股份購買、重組或類似的業務合併。該公司成立於2025年1月13日，總部位於加州奧克蘭。

info.description: AbbVie, Inc. is a research-based biopharmaceutical company, which engages in the development and sale of pharmaceutical products. It focuses on treating conditions such as chronic autoimmune diseases in rheumatology, gastroenterology, and dermatology, oncology, including blood cancers, virology, including hepatitis C virus (HCV) and human immunodeficiency virus (HIV), neurological disorders such as Parkinson's disease, metabolic disorders, including thyroid disease and complications associated with cystic fibrosis, pain associated with endometriosis, and other serious health conditions. The company was founded on October 19, 2011 and is headquartered in North Chicago, IL.
info.description_zh: 艾伯維公司是一家以研究為基礎的生物製藥公司，從事藥品的開發和銷售。它專注於治療風濕病、胃腸病和皮膚病等慢性自體免疫疾病、腫瘤學（包括血癌）、病毒學（包括丙型肝炎病毒（HCV）和人類免疫缺陷病毒（HIV））、帕金森氏症等神經系統疾病、代謝紊亂（包括甲狀腺疾病和囊性纖維化相關併發症、子宮內膜異位症相關疼痛以及其他嚴重健康狀況）。該公司成立於2011年10月19日，總部位於伊利諾州北芝加哥。

info.description: Alexandria Real Estate Equities, Inc. engages in the provision of space for lease. It offers properties for rent to life science, agriculture technology (agtech), and technology tenants. The company was founded by Alan D. Gold, Gary A. Kreitzer, Joel S. Marcus, and Jerry M. Sudarsky in October 1994 and is headquartered in Pasadena, CA.
info.industry_zh: 房地產投資信託基金 - 辦公室
info.description_zh: Alexandria Real Estate Equities, Inc. 從事提供租賃空間的業務。它為生命科學、農業技術 (agtech) 和技術租戶提供出租物業。該公司由 Alan D. Gold、Gary A. Kreitzer、Joel S. Marcus 和 Jerry M. Sudarsky 於 1994 年 10 月創立，總部位於加州帕薩迪納。

info.description: BGC Group, Inc. engages in the provision of brokerage and financial technology services. It offers trade execution and broker-dealer services specializing in Fixed Income (Rates and Credit), Foreign Exchange, Equities, Energy and Commodities, Shipping, and Futures. The company was founded in 2004 and is headquartered in New York, NY.
info.description_zh: BGC Group, Inc. 從事提供經紀和金融技術服務。它提供專門從事固定收益（利率和信貸）、外匯、股票、能源和大宗商品、航運和期貨領域的交易執行和經紀自營商服務。該公司成立於2004年，總部位於紐約州紐約市。

info.description: VerifyMe, Inc. engages in the provision of software driven predictive analytics logistics. It operates through the Precision Logistics and Authentication segments. The Precision Logistics segment specializes in predictive analytics for optimizing delivery of time and temperature sensitive perishable products. The Authentication segment focuses on the anti-counterfeit and brand protection. The company was founded by Norman A. Gardner on November 10, 1999 and is headquartered in Lake Mary, FL.

info.description: Invesco DWA Healthcare Momentum ETF seeks to track the investment results (before fees and expenses) of the Dorsey Wright Healthcare Technical Leaders Index (the "underlying index"). The fund generally will invest at least 90% of its total assets in the securities that comprise the underlying index. The underlying index is composed of at least 30 securities of companies in the healthcare sector that have powerful relative strength or "momentum" characteristics.
info.description_zh: Invesco DWA Healthcare Momentum ETF 旨在追蹤 Dorsey Wright Healthcare Technical Leaders Index（「基礎指數」）的投資結果（未計費用和支出）。該基金通常將至少 90% 的總資產投資於構成標的指數的證券。相關指數由至少 30 家醫療保健行業公司的證券組成，這些公司具有強大的相對實力或「動量」特徵。

info.description: Mount Logan Capital, Inc. operates as an investment company. It engages in the facilitation of business mergers. The company was founded on January 7, 2025 and is headquartered in Montclair, NJ.
