info.description: EOG Resources, Inc. engages in the exploration, development, production and marketing of crude oil and natural gas. It operates through the United States, Trinidad, and Other International geographical segments. The Other International segment includes China and Canada operations. The company was founded in 1985 and is headquartered in Houston, TX.
info.industry_zh: 石油和天然氣勘探與生產
info.description_zh: EOG Resources, Inc.從事原油和天然氣的勘探、開發、生產和行銷。它透過美國、特立尼達和其他國際地理部門開展業務。其他國際部門包括中國和加拿大業務。該公司成立於 1985 年，總部位於德克薩斯州休士頓。

info.description: FirstService Corp. engages in the provision of property services. It operates through the FirstService Residential and FirstService Brands segments. The FirstService Residential segment offers residential property management services in North America. The FirstService Brands segment covers residential and commercial customers through both franchise systems, and company-owned operations. The company was founded by Jay S. Hennick in 1989 and is headquartered in Toronto, Canada.
info.description_zh: FirstService Corp. 從事提供物業服務。它透過 FirstService Residential 和 FirstService Brands 部門運作。 FirstService Residential 部門在北美提供住宅物業管理服務。 FirstService Brands 部門透過特許經營系統和公司自營業務覆蓋住宅和商業客戶。該公司由 Jay S. Hennick 於 1989 年創立，總部位於加拿大多倫多。

info.description: CF Industries Holdings, Inc. engages in the manufacture and distribution of nitrogen fertilizer. The firm owns and operates nitrogen plants and serves agricultural and industrial customers through its distribution system. It operates through the following segments: Ammonia, Granular Urea, UAN, AN, and Other. The Ammonia segment produces anhydrous ammonia. The Granular Urea segment offers granular urea. The UAN segment focuses on urea ammonium nitrate solution. The AN segment refers to the production of ammonium nitrate. The Other segment includes diesel exhaust fluid, nitric acid, urea liquor, and aqua ammonia. The company was founded in 1946 and is headquartered in Northbrook, IL.
info.description_zh: ？ Other.氨部門生產無水氨。顆粒尿素部門提供顆粒尿素。 The UAN segment focuses on urea ammonium nitrate solution. AN 部門是指硝酸銨的生產。 The Other segment includes diesel exhaust fluid, nitric acid, urea liquor, and aqua ammonia. The company was founded in 1946 and is headquartered in Northbrook, IL.

info.description: Bleichroeder Acquisition Corp. II operates as a blank check company formed for the purpose of effecting a merger, amalgamation, share exchange, asset acquisition, share purchase, reorganization or similar business combination with one or more businesses. The company was founded by Andrew Stephen Gundlach and Michel Combes on August 27, 2025 and is headquartered in New York, NY.
info.description_zh: Bleichroeder Acquisition Corp. II 作為一家空白支票公司運營，其成立目的是與一個或多個企業實現合併、合併、股份交換、資產收購、股份購買、重組或類似業務合併。該公司由 Andrew Stephen Gundlach 和 Michel Combes 於 2025 年 8 月 27 日創立，總部位於紐約州紐約。

info.description: Viper Energy, Inc. engages in the acquisition of oil and natural gas properties. It owns, acquires, and exploits oil and natural gas properties in North America. The company was founded on September 18, 2013 and is headquartered in Midland, TX.
info.description_zh: Viper Energy, Inc. 從事石油和天然氣資產的收購。它在北美擁有、收購和開採石油和天然氣資產。該公司成立於2013年9月18日，總部位於德克薩斯州米德蘭。

info.description: GraniteShares 2x Long RIVN Daily ETF seeks daily investment results of 2 times (200%) the daily percentage change of the performance of the common stock of Rivian Automotive, Inc. The fund is an actively managed exchange traded fund that attempts to replicate 2 times (200%) the daily percentage change the underlying stock by entering into a swap agreement on the underlying stock. The fund aims to generate 2 times the daily performances of the underlying stock for a single day. A "single day" is defined as being calculated "from the close of regular trading on one trading day to the close on the next trading day."
info.description_zh: GraniteShares 2x Long RIVN Daily ETF 尋求 Rivian Automotive, Inc. 普通股績效每日百分比變動 2 倍 (200%) 的每日投資結果。該基金是一檔主動管理的交易所交易基金，試圖透過簽訂標的股票掉期協議來複製標的股票每日百分比變化 2 倍 (200%) 的結果。該基金的目標是單日產生標的股票日表現兩倍的收益。 「單日」的定義是「從一個交易日常規交易收盤起至下一交易日收盤止」計算。

info.description: Titan Machinery, Inc. engages in the management of agricultural and construction equipment stores. It operates through the following segments: Agriculture, Construction, Europe, and Australian. The Agriculture segment sells services and rents machinery and related parts and attachments, for uses from large-scale farming to home and garden use in North America. The Construction segment focuses on machinery and related parts and attachments, for uses from heavy construction to light industrial machinery. The Europe segment manages ancillary sales and services related to agricultural activities and products in Eastern Europe and Germany. The Australian segments offer products such as equipment transportation, GPS signal subscriptions, and finance and insurance products in Southeastern Australia. The company was founded by David Joseph Meyer in 1980 and is headquartered in West Fargo, ND.
info.description_zh: Titan Machinery, Inc. 從事農業和建築設備商店的管理。它透過以下部門運作：農業、建築、歐洲和澳洲。農業部門銷售服務並租賃機械及相關零件和配件，用於北美的大規模農業以及家庭和花園用途。建築部門專注於機械及相關零件和附件，適用於從重型建築到輕工業機械的用途。歐洲部門管理與東歐和德國農業活動和產品相關的輔助銷售和服務。澳洲分部在澳洲東南部提供設備運輸、GPS 訊號訂閱以及金融和保險產品等產品。該公司由 David Joseph Meyer 於 1980 年創立，總部位於北達科他州西法戈。

info.description: CytoMed Therapeutics Ltd. is a biopharmaceutical company, which engages in the business of innate immune cell-based immunotherapy, pluripotent stem cell-based therapy, and undertaking the research and development of immune cell and stem cell-based therapy. It operates through the Malaysia and Singapore geographical segments. The company was founded by Chee Kong Choo on March 9, 2018 and is headquartered in Singapore.
info.description_zh: CytoMed Therapeutics Ltd.是一家生物製藥公司，從事天然免疫細胞免疫療法、多能幹細胞療法業務，並承擔免疫細胞和幹細胞療法的研發。它透過馬來西亞和新加坡地理部門運作。該公司由Chee Kong Choo於2018年3月9日創立，總部位於新加坡。

info.description: AMC Robotics Corp. engages in developing and deploying AI-enabled robotics and smart security solutions, especially for warehouse automation, enterprise security, robotics patrol/incident-response and logistics automation. The company was founded on January 14, 2022 and is headquartered in New York, NY.
